description: What is Zombie Cell Cleanser? Zombie Cell Cleanser | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a stabilized formula combining 10mg of fisetin – a natural flavonoid with senolytic activity – and 30 billion exosomes derived from MUSE MSC stem cells. The formula is pre-mixed and distributed into 300 uni
bodyHtml:
What is Zombie Cell Cleanser?

Zombie Cell Cleanser | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a stabilized formula combining 10mg of fisetin – a natural flavonoid with senolytic activity – and 30 billion exosomes derived from MUSE MSC stem cells. The formula is pre-mixed and distributed into 300 units, designed for research applications focused on eliminating senescent cells, enhancing tissue regeneration, and restoring cellular communication.

Senescent cells – also known as "zombie cells" – are metabolically active but non-functional cells that accumulate in the body with age and chronic inflammation. They secrete harmful signals (SASP) that damage surrounding tissues, suppress regeneration, and accelerate aging processes. Zombie Cell Cleanser is developed to target and eliminate these cells, while also providing regenerative support through exosomes carrying active RNAs, microRNAs, and proteins that assist in recovery processes.

What makes this formula unique?

Zombie Cell Cleanser combines two completely different yet synergistically acting molecules – fisetin, which exhibits senolytic effects on damaged and aging cells, and exosomes from MUSE MSC, which stimulate regeneration through intercellular communication reactivation. This makes the product particularly suitable for research models of cellular aging, post-injury recovery, and chronic inflammation.

Fisetin acts as a natural agent that clears damaged cells by inducing apoptosis (programmed cell death) in senescent cells without affecting healthy tissue. Studies show that it acts on pathways related to p53, p21, and BCL-2, helping restore tissue homeostasis and reduce systemic inflammation.

The exosomes in the formula are derived from MUSE MSC – a unique type of stem cell with both regenerative and anti-inflammatory profiles. These exosomes transport signaling molecules required to reactivate repair processes, improve microcirculation, stimulate neovascularization, and promote cellular differentiation.

Key Components and Mechanism of Action

Fisetin (10mg)

Fisetin is a polyphenolic flavonoid found in fruits like strawberries and apples, known for its powerful senolytic activity. Unlike many antioxidants, fisetin selectively eliminates damaged and non-functional cells by suppressing SASP (senescence-associated secretory phenotype), reducing inflammation, and restoring proper cellular signaling. Research shows that fisetin may improve cognitive function, support vascular elasticity, and reduce the risk of age-related chronic conditions.

Exosomes from MUSE MSC (30 Billion)

Exosomes are nanovesicles measuring 30–150 nm in diameter, carrying bioactive "cargo" of RNAs, proteins, and lipids specific to the donor cell. MUSE MSC cells are known for their unique ability to withstand cellular stress and directly differentiate into damaged tissues. Exosomes derived from them help restore intercellular communication, promote cellular migration, and reduce local inflammation, acting as highly precise biological signaling systems.

By combining cleansing and restorative functions, Zombie Cell Cleanser offers an innovative two-phase approach to addressing cellular aging—removing harmful cells and activating a new, functional tissue environment.

Synergistic Effect of the Formula

The formula of Zombie Cell Cleanser is designed to achieve a dual-phase effect:

  1. Selective elimination of senescent cells (via fisetin) – which frees tissues from inflammatory and non-functional cells that block regeneration.
  2. Molecular rebooting of tissue regulation (via MUSE MSC exosomes) – which "restore communication" between cells and activate natural regenerative signals.

This approach offers a unique model of biological cleansing and restoration, going far beyond the effects of traditional antioxidant or anti-inflammatory agents. The combination of selectivity, precision, and regenerative intelligence makes Zombie Cell Cleanser a unique tool in the context of modern senolytic biology.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits

The Zombie Cell Cleanser formula shows promising potential in modern research protocols aimed at improving cellular function and biological longevity. The combined senolytic and regenerative effects of fisetin and MUSE MSC exosomes may contribute to:

  • Selective elimination of senescent cells – clearing tissues of non-functional and pro-inflammatory cells that hinder repair mechanisms and accelerate aging.
  • Significant reduction in SASP mediators and low-grade chronic inflammation ("inflammaging") – a condition linked to most degenerative diseases, including cardiometabolic, neurodegenerative, and autoimmune disorders.
  • Improved cognitive function and neural protection – due to fisetin’s ability to cross the blood-brain barrier and reduce neuroinflammation, alongside the regenerative role of exosomes in nervous tissue.
  • Stimulation of tissue regeneration and enhanced cellular migration – MUSE MSC-derived exosomes contain signaling molecules that promote restorative cascades, angiogenesis, and remodeling of damaged zones.
  • Restoration of intercellular communication and functional homeostasis – by transferring regulatory RNAs and proteins that reestablish coordination between different cell populations in affected tissues.
  • Increased metabolic flexibility and cellular resilience – through reduced oxidative stress, normalized energy metabolism, and creation of an environment that supports functional cell rejuvenation.

Dosage and Application in Research Protocols

Recommended research protocol: 20 units once daily for 30 days, followed by a 45–60 day break before starting the next cycle.

Total pen content: 300 units

Shake the pen gently for about 10–15 seconds before use within your research.In some products, you may notice fine visible particles in the solution — this is not a cause for concern.These particles are due to the fact that the molecules are encapsulated in a protective lipid or polymer coating, designed to provide stability, prevent degradation, and allow controlled release of the active substance.

Zombie Cell Cleanser is intended strictly for research purposes and stands out with its dual-phase mechanism—senolytic elimination and regenerative activation. Its precisely formulated combination of fisetin and MUSE MSC-derived exosomes positions it as an innovative tool in the fields of cellular detox, tissue homeostasis, and modern senolytic biology.

name: YK-11 (Myostatin) | 35mg/1,5ml
description: What Is YK-11? YK-11 is a synthetic compound classified as a Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator (SARM), distinguished by a structure based on dihydrotestosterone (DHT). Developed to explore its effects on muscle mass and androgenic activity, YK-11 stands out as a unique agent
bodyHtml:
What Is YK-11?

YK-11 is a synthetic compound classified as a Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator (SARM), distinguished by a structure based on dihydrotestosterone (DHT). Developed to explore its effects on muscle mass and androgenic activity, YK-11 stands out as a unique agent that combines androgen receptor modulation with potential myostatin inhibition. This dual function differentiates it from other SARMs and makes it a subject of increasing scientific interest in the fields of molecular biology and muscle regulation research.

How Does YK-11 Work?

YK-11 interacts with androgen receptors and activates specific genetic pathways associated with muscle hypertrophy. A key feature of its mechanism is its ability to increase levels of follistatin—a natural protein that suppresses the activity of myostatin. Myostatin is a major regulator that inhibits excessive muscle growth. Through the balanced suppression of this pathway, YK-11 creates favorable conditions for enhanced muscle protein synthesis while maintaining selectivity for androgen receptors. This makes it particularly valuable for studies focused on optimizing muscle function and physiology.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits of YK-11

YK-11 has generated significant interest in research communities due to several observed effects that may be relevant to muscle growth and regulation. These include:

  • Enhanced muscle growth through androgen receptor modulation;
  • Increased follistatin production and subsequent myostatin inhibition;
  • Improved muscle density and pronounced anabolic response;
  • Potential support for strength gains and recovery processes;
  • Tissue-selective activity with minimal systemic impact on other organs.

These effects are under continued investigation through advanced laboratory analyses aiming to deepen the understanding of molecular mechanisms involved in muscle regulation.

YK-11 vs Other SARMs

YK-11 differs from other Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators (SARMs) through its unique DHT-derived structure and its ability to influence follistatin—a natural myostatin inhibitor. This additional mechanism places it in a distinct category when compared to conventional SARMs such as Ostarine (MK-2866), RAD-140, and S23.

Compared to Ostarine, YK-11 demonstrates significantly stronger anabolic potential, albeit with greater need for monitoring and control. While Ostarine is typically favored for longer, lighter research protocols, YK-11 is primarily used in short-term cycles with an intensive focus on muscle growth.

In contrast to RAD-140—also known for its strong anabolic effects—YK-11 offers an added benefit via its ability to upregulate follistatin, a mechanism not found in RAD-140. This gives YK-11 an advantage in studies targeting maximal suppression of myostatin, a key factor limiting muscle development.

When compared with S23, a highly potent SARM associated with suppression of endogenous testosterone, YK-11 provides a more unconventional yet highly effective approach to anabolic processes. Both compounds require precise dosing, but YK-11 shows promise for achieving unique outcomes in protocols aiming to surpass standard hypertrophy limits.

Due to its complex action and distinct mechanism, YK-11 is often incorporated into advanced research protocols where a combined effect of androgenic stimulation and myostatin regulation is desired.

Dosage and Application of YK-11 in Research Protocols

Suggested research protocol: 3 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week off-cycle.

1 unit = 233mcg

Total pen content: 150 units

Possible Side Effects of YK-11

Despite growing interest in its properties, YK-11 must be evaluated with care regarding its safety profile. Based on available research data, potential adverse effects may include:

  • Suppression of natural testosterone production;
  • Androgenic effects with extended use;
  • Limited data on long-term safety.

Maintaining appropriate dosage and strict control over cycle duration are essential to minimize the risk of unwanted effects.

Vitality Complex combines three active ingredients with mutually enhancing biological effects, aimed at rejuvenating the cellular environment, improving energy metabolism, and protecting against oxidative and inflammatory stress. Key Components and Mechanism of Action

Glutathione (600mg)

Glutathione is the main antioxidant in human cells, involved in eliminating toxic metabolites, regenerating other antioxidants (such as vitamins C and E), and protecting mitochondrial structures from oxidative damage. NMN – Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (1500mg)

NMN is a direct precursor to NAD+ – a vital coenzyme that regulates energy metabolism, SIRT enzyme activity, cellular repair, and longevity. Declining NAD+ levels are linked to reduced mitochondrial function, slower regeneration, and increased cellular vulnerability. NMN helps restore this balance.

Resveratrol (500mg)

Resveratrol is a polyphenol with well-documented antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and epigenetic properties. It activates SIRT1 – a longevity gene dependent on NAD+ – and contributes to enhanced metabolic efficiency, stress resistance, and healthy cellular signaling.

Synergistic Effect of the Formula

Vitality Complex is formulated so that each active ingredient complements and enhances the others:

  • Glutathione supports antioxidant defense and creates a stable intracellular environment in which NAD+-dependent processes can function effectively.

The combination provides a comprehensive molecular response that supports energy potential, reduces aging-related damage, and activates mechanisms for cellular adaptation and regeneration.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits

What is Vilon (Lys-Glu)?

Vilon (Lys-Glu) is a peptide bioregulator composed of two amino acids—Lysine (Lys) and Glutamic Acid (Glu). This peptide is known for its ability to interact specifically with thymus cells, which play a critical role in the immune system.

Vilon (Lys-Glu) belongs to the broader classification of peptide bioregulators, substances widely used in biomedical science due to their ability to influence various cellular processes. Peptide bioregulators act as “keys” that unlock specific functions in target cells, allowing them to regulate precise biological processes within the body.

Vilon (Lys-Glu) is particularly significant because it interacts directly with the thymus, an essential immune organ where T-cells (a crucial type of white blood cell) mature and develop.

This peptide works by supporting and regulating thymus cell functions, potentially enhancing immune responses and overall immune system health. Although further research is needed to fully understand all its mechanisms, Vilon (Lys-Glu) is already attracting significant scientific interest for its potential applications in immunology and bioregulation.

Vilon (Lys-Glu) is an important tool in the field of bioregulation, offering great potential for scientific and medical applications.

What are the benefits of the Bioregulator Vilon (Lys-Glu)?

Vilon (Lys-Glu) is primarily used for its influence on the immune system and thymus cells. Here are some of the potential benefits of using this peptide bioregulator:

  • Supports Recovery After Illness or Infection: By boosting immune system activity, Vilon may help accelerate recovery from infections and diseases.
  • Maintains Immune Function During Aging: Vilon (Lys-Glu) supports T-cell activity, helping preserve immune function as the body ages.
  • Promotes Overall Health and Well-Being: By regulating immune system activity, Vilon (Lys-Glu) contributes to better general health and resilience.
  • Regulates Immune System Activity: Vilon (Lys-Glu) may help prevent immune system overactivity, which can be beneficial in managing autoimmune conditions.
  • Reduces Inflammation: By modulating immune function, Vilon (Lys-Glu) may aid in lowering inflammatory processes in the body.

Many of these conditions are directly linked to vascular blockages or damage, so supporting the vascular system can bring significant health benefits.

Vesugen peptide works by promoting the regulation and balance of physiological processes in the body, enhancing vascular function. It may stimulate the formation of new blood vessels (angiogenesis), improve vessel elasticity, and reduce inflammation associated with vascular diseases.

Like other bioregulatory peptides, Vesugen peptide is well tolerated by the body, as it consists of amino acids naturally found in human physiology. However, as with any supplement, it is recommended to use Vesugen under the guidance of a specialist.

  • Reduces Cardiovascular Disease Risk: Supports heart health by lowering the likelihood of conditions such as ischemic heart disease, hypertension, and atherosclerosis.

There are no known reports of negative side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is Tymogen?

Tymogen is a peptide bioregulator that plays a key role in modulating the immune system and maintaining immune balance in the human body. It is found in the thymus gland, a central organ for immune system development, especially in young organisms. Tymogen is crucial for the differentiation and activation of T lymphocytes, which are an essential component of the adaptive immune system.

Tymogen is an immunomodulatory agent developed from peptides, used to stimulate the immune system and strengthen the body's defenses. Its active ingredient is Alpha-Glutamyl-Tryptophan (Sodium Tymogen), a peptide composed of the amino acids glutamine and tryptophan.

Peptides like Tymogen play a significant role in immune system regulation, as they can modulate immune cell activity, stimulate antibody production, enhance resistance to infections, and support the body's regeneration processes.

What are the benefits of Tymogen?

Tymogen is a peptide bioregulator with significant applications in immunology, offering promising health and wellness benefits. Here are some of its key advantages:

  • Strengthening the Immune System: Tymogen plays a crucial role in stimulating the immune system by supporting the development and function of T lymphocytes. This enhances the body's ability to combat viral and bacterial infections, increasing overall resistance to various diseases.
  • Modulation of Inflammatory Processes: This peptide has the ability to regulate inflammatory responses in the body, making it potentially useful in managing chronic inflammatory conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel diseases, and other autoimmune disorders.
  • Support for Recovery After Illness: By stimulating the immune system, Tymogen can accelerate recovery from various illnesses, reducing the duration of disease and improving the patient's overall condition.
  • Potential in Autoimmune Disease Treatment: Tymogen’s ability to modulate the immune system suggests that it could be beneficial in treatment strategies for certain autoimmune diseases, helping restore immune balance and reduce autoimmune activity.

Possible side effects of Tymogen:

Tymogen is generally well tolerated by patients, and side effects are rare. However, some potential side effects that may occur with its use include:

  • Local Reactions at the Injection Site: In forms of Tymogen administered via injection, local reactions such as redness, swelling, pain, or itching at the injection site may occur. These symptoms are usually temporary and resolve without the need for special treatment.
  • Fatigue or Mild Discomfort: Some individuals may experience mild fatigue, weakness, or general discomfort after taking Tymogen. These symptoms are typically short-lived and resolve on their own.
  • Headache: Mild headaches may occur after using Tymogen, though they are generally temporary and can be managed with conventional pain relief methods.

Proper use and dosage of Tymogen:

The dosage and method of administration of Tymogen depend on several factors, including the purpose of use, individual needs, and the person's health condition.

The standard dosage is between 1 mg and 2 mg per day (10 to 20 units), with 1 unit equivalent to 100 micrograms. The usual cycle duration is 10 days. For active infections, an alternative regimen involves taking 5 mg per day for a period of 3 to 5 days.

bodyHtml:
What is Turmeric (Curcumin)?

Curcumin is the active component found in turmeric, an herb from the ginger family. It is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and potentially anticancer properties. Products containing curcumin are frequently used in dietary supplements, cosmetics, and medications.

IV-IM infusion means intravenous (IV) or intramuscular (IM) administration of curcumin. This means that curcumin is administered directly into the circulatory system or muscles through an infusion, which can improve the bioavailability and efficacy of the compound compared to oral intake forms. These methods are generally used in medical settings for treatment or as part of specialised therapies.

What are the benefits of Curcumin (Turmeric)?

Turmeric, the active ingredient of turmeric, has multiple potential health benefits:

  • Anti-inflammatory properties: Curcumin is widely known for its potent anti-inflammatory effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases.
  • Antioxidant properties: Turmeric is a strong antioxidant that helps combat oxidative stress and may protect against cellular damage caused by free radicals.
  • Improvement of brain health: Some studies suggest that curcumin may support brain health by improving cognitive functions and reducing the risk of neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's disease.
  • Support for heart health: Turmeric may improve heart health by reducing inflammation and oxidation, which are significant factors in cardiovascular diseases.
  • Relief of depression symptoms: There is evidence that curcumin may have antidepressant properties and help in relieving symptoms of depression.
  • Potential anticancer properties: Research indicates that curcumin may have anticancer effects, inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and the spread of tumours.
  • Aids in digestion: Turmeric may improve digestion and alleviate symptoms of various digestive disorders.

It is always advisable to consult with a doctor or a qualified health professional before starting to take supplements.

Turmeric in combination with Exosomes:

The combination of curcumin with exosomes represents an innovative area in medicine and biology. Here are some key aspects of this combination:

Exosomes: These are microscopic vesicles released from cells and play a role in cell communication, transporting various molecules such as proteins, RNA, and DNA between cells. They are being widely researched for their potential in areas such as regenerative medicine, immunotherapy, and drug delivery.

Curcumin: It is an active component in turmeric with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and potentially anticancer properties.

Turmeric and Exosomes Combination: Combining curcumin with exosomes may enhance the delivery of curcumin to cells. Exosomes can act as natural transport systems, increasing the stability and bioavailability of curcumin in the body. This can significantly improve the efficacy of Turmeric in targeted therapies, such as in treating inflammatory diseases or cancer.

Potential therapeutic applications: This combination may have applications in areas such as targeted therapy for cancer, treatment of inflammatory diseases, and in regenerative medicine.

Clinical studies and their results:

Curcumin (the active compound in turmeric) has been the subject of several clinical studies due to its potential healing properties, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.

In a study published in the journal "Trials", Turmeric was compared with diclofenac, a standard treatment for osteoarthritis. The study involved 139 patients, divided into two groups: one received curcumin, and the other received diclofenac. The therapy lasted 28 days. The results showed a significant improvement, pain reduction, and better knee function for patients treated with curcumin, comparable to those observed with diclofenac.

Another study analysed the effects of curcumin on patients with ulcerative colitis, a form of inflammatory bowel disease. Patients who regularly took Turmeric along with standard treatment showed significant improvement in symptoms and a reduction in the need for medications. Curcumin proved to be useful in reducing inflammation and improving intestinal function.

Proper Dosage and Administration of Turmeric IV-IM Infusion:

Administered 2-3 times per week. Intravenously at 100 mg per dose for an indefinite period depending on the patient's needs. Intramuscularly at 25 mg per dose, again for an indefinite period depending on the goals.

name: Testolone (RAD-140) | 40mg/1.5ml
description: What Is Testolone (RAD-140)? Testolone, also known as RAD-140, is one of the most widely studied Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators (SARMs), designed to deliver a potent anabolic effect without the severe side effects typically associated with traditional androgenic compounds
bodyHtml:
What Is Testolone (RAD-140)?

Testolone, also known as RAD-140, is one of the most widely studied Selective Androgen Receptor Modulators (SARMs), designed to deliver a potent anabolic effect without the severe side effects typically associated with traditional androgenic compounds. The molecule was engineered to primarily target muscle and bone tissue while maintaining hormonal balance and avoiding stimulation of unwanted receptors.

RAD-140 has been extensively researched for its strong affinity for androgen receptors and its significant potential to promote muscle growth, enhance strength, and accelerate recovery. As such, it has become a preferred compound in studies focused on physical optimization, body recomposition, and hormonal support under various stress and load models.

Mechanism of Action of Testolone (RAD-140)

Testolone selectively binds to androgen receptors, activating specific genes responsible for protein synthesis, muscle regeneration, and metabolic efficiency. This interaction stimulates muscle hypertrophy, increases strength, and supports improved bone density.

One of RAD-140’s key advantages is its ability to produce an anabolic effect comparable to that of testosterone without aromatizing into estrogen or triggering significant androgenic activity in non-target tissues. This makes it suitable for research requiring strong but controlled anabolic stimulation.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits of Testolone (RAD-140)

RAD-140 has been the subject of numerous laboratory studies and research models. Some of the most frequently observed potential benefits include:

  • Significant increase in muscle mass and strength during short to medium-term research protocols;
  • Improved tissue recovery following intense exertion or catabolic stress;
  • Preservation of lean mass during caloric deficit or hormonal imbalance;
  • Enhanced bone density and skeletal integrity;
  • No aromatization, reducing the risk of water retention or hormonal fluctuations.

RAD-140 is widely utilized in experimental models related to sports physiology, post-injury recovery, and physical adaptation under endocrine stress conditions.

Testolone (RAD-140) vs Other SARMs

Testolone (RAD-140) is considered one of the most powerful SARMs, developed to maximize anabolic activity in muscle tissue while avoiding the typical side effects associated with androgenic steroids. This positions it in direct comparison with other leading SARMs such as Ligandrol (LGD-4033), S23, and Ostarine (MK-2866).

Compared to Ligandrol—also known for muscle growth—RAD-140 delivers a more pronounced anabolic response and faster outcomes, especially in short and intensive research settings. Unlike Ligandrol, RAD-140 may also exhibit neuroprotective properties due to its interaction with certain neuroreceptors, making it of interest in cognitive support models.

When compared to S23, Testolone offers a more balanced profile between potency and tolerability. Testolone is frequently chosen in studies where maximum anabolic output, accelerated recovery, and high efficiency in short research cycles are key objectives—without the need for traditional androgenic agents.

Possible Side Effects of Testolone (RAD-140)

Despite these potential benefits, it is important to consult a medical specialist before using Testagen or any peptide bioregulator.

bodyHtml:
What is TB 500?

TB500 is a peptide that is naturally produced in the human body and is also known as Thymosin Beta 4. It is a small protein composed of 43 amino acids. TB500 is also known as Thymosin Beta-4, Thymosin 4, or TB4.

The TB500 peptide is mainly used for medical or sports purposes. Due to its function of enhancing muscle mass and athletic endurance, this peptide is also preferred by many athletes. Additionally, TB500 is frequently used in the treatment of muscle, tendon, or joint injuries.

TB 500 is a peptide that can aid in the quicker recovery of injuries. Its function of stimulating the growth of new blood vessels and muscle tissues can lead to a rapid recovery from injuries and traumas. TB 500 also helps reduce inflammation and pain in the injured areas.

What are the benefits of TB500 peptide?

TB 500 (Thymosin Beta 4) has multiple potential health benefits. As mentioned, it is used for the treatment of various medical conditions such as muscle, tendon, or joint injuries.

Some of the well-known benefits of TB 500 include:

  • Tissue growth and regeneration - TB500 can assist in the growth and regeneration of muscles, tendons, cartilage, and other tissues in the body.
  • Heart health improvement - TB500 can improve heart health and enhance circulation.
  • Skin regeneration - TB 500 can aid in the rapid healing of wounds or injuries by stimulating the growth of new skin.
  • Hair condition improvement - This peptide can enhance hair health and aid in combating hair loss.
  • Immune function enhancement - The TB 500 peptide can improve the body,s immune function and prevent the development of diseases.
  • Metabolism acceleration - This peptide can speed up the body,s metabolism, leading to multiple benefits such as faster fat burning and increased energy levels.
  • Assistance in joint recovery - TB500 can be helpful in joint recovery, which can be beneficial for different types of sports or other injuries.
  • Ageing prevention - The TB500 peptide can help prevent tissue ageing in the body.
  • Nervous system health improvement - Thymosin Beta 4 can improve nervous system health and prevent the development of some diseases.
  • Sports endurance enhancement - It can help improve sports endurance and increase muscle stamina.

TB500 clinical trials and their results:

TB 500 is a small hormonal peptide that has been the subject of multiple clinical trials. The results of these trials show the potential of TB 500 as a therapy for various diseases. Some of these studies indicate that TB 500 may have multiple benefits in the treatment of wounds, muscle traumas, heart diseases, chronic joint diseases, neurological diseases, and others.

One study shows that the application of TB500 peptide in patients with spinal cord trauma can lead to an improvement in motor functions and quality of life. In another study, TB 500 is used to treat patients with chronic joint disease, demonstrating that this peptide can successfully improve joint mobility and reduce inflammation.

Correct administration and dosage of Thymosin Beta 4:

The correct administration and dosage of TB 500 depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered from 500mcg to 1mg three times a week.

The correct dose of TB500 is 20 to 40 units per dose.

Additional instructions for use: Adjust the pen doser by turning it from 20 to 40 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the doser) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The cycle duration with this peptide is 30 to 45 days.

One pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

A TB 500 pen (5mg) will be sufficient for approximately 3 weeks depending on the daily dose.

Examples of calculated units from the TB-500 pen (5mg) equivalent to micrograms:

1 unit = 25mcg.; 5 units = 125mcg.; 10 units = 250mcg.; 16 units = 400mcg.; 20 units = 500mcg.

What other peptides can TB 500 be combined with?

TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4) is a peptide used to stimulate tissue regeneration and rapid recovery after traumas or damage. When combined with other peptides, its effect can be enhanced, accelerating the recovery process. Here are some peptides TB-500 can be combined with:

  • BPC-157 (Body Protective Compound-157) - A peptide used for the treatment of traumas and inflammations, as well as for tissue regeneration. Combining them can create a synergistic effect and speed up the recovery process after traumas.
  • IGF1-LR3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor 1 Long Arginine 3) - An anabolic peptide that stimulates cell growth and recovery. The combination can strengthen regenerative processes and accelerate the recovery of muscles and tissues.
  • GHRP-6 and GHRP-2 - These peptides can also be combined with TB-500 to improve muscle growth and tissue regeneration. They can work together to increase growth hormone levels and accelerate the recovery process.
  • Ipamorelin - This peptide is a selective growth hormone stimulator and is used to support muscle growth and recovery. Combining them can intensify regenerative processes and aid in faster recovery after traumas.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of TB500:

One of the possible side effects of TB-500 is headache. Some users report headaches after administration. This may be due to the dilation of blood vessels.

Another possible side effect of Thymosin Beta 4 (TB500) is nausea. Some people report nausea at the beginning of administration. This may be due to gastrointestinal system stimulation.

To reduce the risk of possible side effects, it is recommended to follow the exact dosage and not abuse it. It is also advisable to consult with a specialist if patients are going to combine TB500 with other medications or supplements.

TB500 can be safe to use if the correct dosage is followed and large amounts or prolonged administration are avoided.

TAD 600 acts as a potent provider of glutathione, which is extremely important for multiple functions in the body. Here is how this product acts at the cellular and molecular level:

TAD 600 provides glutathione in high concentration and in a form easily assimilable by the body, allowing the body to quickly use these molecules to improve health and maintain its functions at an optimal level.

Possible Side Effects of TAD 600 Glutathione:

The supplement TAD600 contains Glutathione and has a positive effect on health. However, the administration of this product may lead to some mild side effects, especially at high dosage or prolonged use.

To avoid side effects from this product, it is important to follow the instructions related to the correct administration and dosage of TAD 600mg.

For detoxification: 3-5 infusions over the course of 7 days, from 1 g to 1.8 g.

Patients should consult a qualified medical professional to ensure that the therapy is appropriate for their health condition and to ensure the safety and efficacy of the treatment.

description: What Is Stenabolic (SR9009)? Stenabolic, also known as SR9009, is a synthetic compound developed to modulate the activity of nuclear receptors REV-ERBα and REV-ERBβ. Although frequently mentioned alongside SARMs, SR9009 is not a SARM; rather, it is a unique REV-ERB agonist—a clas
bodyHtml:
What Is Stenabolic (SR9009)?

Stenabolic, also known as SR9009, is a synthetic compound developed to modulate the activity of nuclear receptors REV-ERBα and REV-ERBβ. Although frequently mentioned alongside SARMs, SR9009 is not a SARM; rather, it is a unique REV-ERB agonist—a class of regulators involved in controlling circadian rhythm, energy metabolism, and inflammatory responses. SR9009 was designed to study molecular mechanisms related to mitochondrial function, lipid homeostasis, and skeletal muscle adaptations under physical stress.

Mechanism of Action of Stenabolic (SR9009)

Stenabolic acts by activating the REV-ERBα receptor, which regulates transcription of genes responsible for mitochondrial biogenesis, energy substrate utilization, and circadian rhythm alignment. Through this modulation, SR9009 enhances cellular oxidative capacity, reduces lipid synthesis, and suppresses inflammation at the molecular level. This results in improved metabolic efficiency, glucose regulation, and increased muscular endurance. Due to its selective mechanism, SR9009 is considered a compound of high interest for studies in metabolism and chronobiology.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits of Stenabolic (SR9009)

SR9009 has been extensively researched in laboratory settings and is associated with a range of potential effects, including:

  • Increased mitochondrial biogenesis and cellular energy efficiency;
  • Enhanced fat oxidation and reduced lipid accumulation;
  • Improved glucose regulation and insulin sensitivity;
  • Support for physical endurance through optimized energy utilization;
  • Potential reduction of inflammatory markers;
  • Modulation of circadian rhythms and cellular metabolic balance.

These effects highlight SR9009’s role as a research compound for investigating chronic metabolic conditions, energy adaptation, and molecular physiology.

Stenabolic (SR9009) vs Other SARMs

Stenabolic (SR9009) is often grouped with SARMs, although it is technically not a SARM. Instead, it is a REV-ERBα agonist involved in regulating circadian rhythms, metabolic function, and mitochondrial activity. Despite this distinction, SR9009 is frequently compared to compounds such as Cardarine (GW501516), Ostarine (MK-2866), and Ligandrol (LGD-4033) due to its role in endurance, lipid metabolism, and recovery-focused research.

Compared to Cardarine (GW501516), both compounds influence metabolic efficiency and fat oxidation. Cardarine activates PPAR-δ receptors, while SR9009 targets REV-ERBα; both encourage the use of fat as an energy source. However, Stenabolic offers a more pronounced impact on circadian regulation, making it unique for research centered on metabolic and sleep rhythm synchronization.

Relative to Ostarine, SR9009 does not demonstrate anabolic effects on muscle mass but supports mitochondrial density and energy efficiency in muscle tissue. While Ostarine focuses on muscle maintenance and development, Stenabolic enhances endurance and metabolic adaptation under stress and load.

When compared to Ligandrol, which has a strong anabolic effect, SR9009 functions as a metabolic modulator rather than a growth stimulant. This positions it as a suitable compound in research protocols that prioritize energy optimization, fat reduction, and improved aerobic capacity over hypertrophy.

Stenabolic holds a distinct position among SARM-like compounds—not by directly activating androgen pathways, but by regulating internal biological rhythms, lipid metabolism, and mitochondrial performance.

Dosage and Application of Stenabolic (SR9009) in Research Protocols

Suggested research protocol: 7 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week off-cycle.

1 unit = 333mcg

Total pen content: 150 units

Possible Side Effects of Stenabolic (SR9009)

Available scientific data suggests that SR9009 has a complex metabolic profile and should be used with caution. Adverse effects observed in research settings may include:

  • Circadian rhythm disruption during prolonged use;
  • Limited data on long-term systemic impact and organ interaction.

Proper dosing and control over the duration of use play a critical role in minimizing potential side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is Somatropin (HGH)?

Somatropin, also known as somatotropic hormone (STH) or human growth hormone (HGH), is a peptide hormone that stimulates growth, cell reproduction, and cell regeneration in the human body.

The production and release of somatotropin are controlled by the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland. Specific stimuli such as sleep, exercise, and stress cause the hypothalamus to send neurotransmitters and peptides to the pituitary gland, which in turn releases Somatropin into the bloodstream.

Somatotropin acts directly on tissues, as well as indirectly through the stimulation of the production of other hormones and growth factors that help bone growth, muscle mass increase, and protein synthesis. In addition, it participates in the metabolism of fats and carbohydrates, helping the body to manage their use.

What are the benefits of Somatropin (Growth Hormone)?

Somatropin (growth hormone) plays a key role in the human body and has multiple benefits:

  • Growth Stimulation: The most known role of somatropin is to stimulate the growth of bones and muscles.
  • Tissue Recovery and Regeneration: Growth hormone aids in tissue recovery after injuries and in cell regeneration capacity, which is important for maintaining healthy skin, bones, and organs.
  • Fat Metabolism: It aids in the breakdown of fats and their use as energy, which can lead to a reduction in body fat.
  • Muscle Mass: Somatropin stimulates muscle growth and increases muscle mass, as well as strengthens muscle function.
  • Carbohydrate Metabolism: It plays a role in managing blood sugar levels, maintaining a normal glucose concentration in the blood.
  • Bone Density Improvement: Somatropin can have a positive impact on bone density, which helps prevent osteoporosis.
  • Cardiovascular Function Improvement: There is evidence that growth hormone can improve the structure and function of the cardiovascular system.
  • Brain Function: Somatropin potentially supports cognitive functions and can protect the brain against damage resulting from trauma or age-related changes.
  • Sleep Quality Improvement: Growth hormone can improve sleep quality, regulating sleep and wake cycles. Peaks in Somatropin levels are often observed during deep sleep.
  • Immune System Support: Somatropin can strengthen the immune system and improve the body's ability to fight infections.
  • Sexual Function and Libido Improvement: Studies show that growth hormone can have a positive impact on sexual function and libido.
  • Mental Clarity and Mood Improvement: Growth hormone can positively influence mental health, improving mood and aiding in mental clarity.

Correct Cycle with Growth Hormone (Somatropin):

The exact cycle, intake, or dosage regimen depends on various factors, including the individual needs of the user, treatment goals, and the patient's body response to the hormone.

It is advisable to take it at least 1 hour before or after eating, in the morning or at night.

A pen contains 30 units.

A Somatropin pen (30IU) at a dosage of 1 unit per day will be sufficient for 30 days. At a dosage of 2 units per day, it will be sufficient for 15 days. At a dosage of 3 units per day, it will be sufficient for 10 days.

User Reviews on Growth Hormone:

For medical indications: Patients often report positive changes in the medical use of growth hormone.

In sports and fitness: In the world of sports and bodybuilding, there is certain misuse of growth hormone, where users often report an increase in muscle mass and a reduction in subcutaneous fat. However, many countries regulate the use of Somatropin due to its potential anabolic effect.

Anti-aging: Some adult users who use somatropin (HGH) for its alleged anti-aging effects, share that they feel improvements in energy levels, skin quality, and overall vitality.

Accessibility and Price: Many express opinions on the high price and limited accessibility of growth hormone.

It is important to note that user opinions should not replace professional advice from specialists.

Possible Side Effects of Somatropin:

Of course, when discussing the side effects of using Somatropin (growth hormone), it is important to highlight that they can vary depending on the dose, the duration of use, and the individual sensitivity of each user. Some of the most common side effects may include:

Mild Swelling: Some people may notice slight swelling, especially in the limbs, due to fluid retention. This is generally transient and normalizes over time or after adjusting the dose.

Muscle or Joint Pain: Mild aches and a feeling of stiffness in the muscles and joints may appear as the body adapts to the increased rate of growth.

Discomfort at Injection Sites: Some patients may experience redness or discomfort at the injection site.

Headache: At the start of a growth hormone cycle, some users may experience mild to moderate headaches.

Feeling of Fatigue: Changes in metabolism may lead to a temporary feeling of fatigue as the body adapts to the growth hormone.

Generally, these side effects are mild and manageable. However, if they appear or intensify, it is important to consult a specialist.

Use of Human Growth Hormone (HGH) - Somatotropin in Sports:

Somatropin is popular in many sports and fitness settings due to its reputation for speeding up recovery, increasing muscle mass, and improving overall physical performance. However, the use of HGH in sports is often the subject of debate and is regulated by sports organisations, including the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA).

Here are some of the main areas where HGH is used in sports:

  • Increased Muscle Mass and Strength: HGH is considered to stimulate muscle growth and help increase muscle strength, which can be an advantage in strength sports.
  • Improved Recovery: Somatropin can promote tissue recovery, which is extremely important for athletes who have intensive training and competitions, as well as for rapid recovery after injuries.
  • Reduction of Subcutaneous Fat: HGH is often associated with its ability to reduce body fat, which can be beneficial for athletes in categories where weight plays a significant role.
  • Anti-aging and Extension of Sports Career: Some athletes believe that HGH can help delay the effects of ageing and extend their sports career, although these claims are often the subject of debate and lack convincing scientific evidence.
  • Increased Endurance and Performance: In some circles, it is claimed that HGH can improve cardiorespiratory function and endurance, which is an advantage in sports involving endurance.

name: SLU-PP-332 | 1.5mg

bodyHtml:
What is SLU-PP-332?

SLU-PP-332 is an experimental peptide researched for its potential to influence metabolic and energy processes at the cellular level. It is a small, next-generation bioactive molecule classified among PAMs (Positive Allosteric Modulators). Primary studies focus on its interaction with natural mechanisms of cellular regulation, physical endurance, and oxidative metabolism.

Under experimental conditions, the peptide is used to study adaptive responses to stress, as well as its effect on mitochondrial efficiency, energy utilization, and recovery processes during intense physical exertion.

What are the benefits of SLU-PP-332?

Scientific interest in SLU-PP-332 stems from its potential to:

  • Enhance energy metabolism, particularly in skeletal muscle
  • Increase physical endurance and resilience during exertion
  • Modulate glucose metabolism and fatty acid oxidation
  • Support adaptive cellular responses under metabolic stress
  • Sustain mitochondrial activity without negatively affecting heart rate

Observations from preclinical studies suggest that SLU-PP-332 may activate mechanisms related to accelerated energy use and recovery, without causing overstimulation or neurotoxic effects.

Clinical trials and findings related to SLU-PP-332:

Currently, SLU-PP-332 remains in the preclinical stage of research. Data from experimental models indicate that regular administration in controlled doses may positively influence:

  • Increased aerobic capacity and VO₂ max
  • Improved mitochondrial activity in muscle tissue
  • Enhanced tolerance to intense physical effort
  • Activation of metabolic pathways similar to those observed with training

The results are promising but require further confirmation in clinical settings.

Proper administration and dosage of SLU-PP-332:

Proper administration and dosage of SLU-PP-332 depend on individual needs and goals. Typically, it is administered in doses of 7 to 10 units twice per day: 7 to 10 units in the morning and 7 to 10 units in the afternoon. A dose of 7 units is recommended for users under 55 kg.

Additional usage instructions: The pen’s dial is adjusted by turning it to 7 or 10 (1 unit equals 1 notch on the dial), and the product is injected into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After the injection, it is advised to wait 10 seconds before withdrawing the needle. Injection site rotation is recommended.

The peptide cycle lasts up to 1 month, followed by a 15-day break.

One pen contains 300 units of 5 micrograms each.

Example conversion of SLU-PP-332 pen (1.5mg) units to micrograms:

1 unit = 5 µg; 5 units = 25 µg; 10 units = 50 µg

Possible side effects of SLU-PP-332:

To date, no serious side effects have been reported when using SLU-PP-332 under preclinical conditions. Possible reactions observed in research models may include:

  • Temporary fatigue or headache at higher doses
  • Mild local sensitivity at the injection site
  • Changes in appetite or energy levels

As with all peptides, side effects depend on dose, body weight, duration of use, and individual sensitivity. Combining with other stimulants is not recommended without clear scientific justification.

name: Skin Glow (GHK-Cu) | 100mg
description: What is Skin Glow (GHK-Cu)? Skin Glow is a product that contains the peptide GHK-Cu, known in the cosmetic industry for its anti-aging properties. GHK-Cu is a bioactive peptide, a tripeptide complex containing glycine-histidine-lysine bound to copper (Cu), hence its other name -
bodyHtml:
What is Skin Glow (GHK-Cu)?

Skin Glow is a product that contains the peptide GHK-Cu, known in the cosmetic industry for its anti-aging properties. GHK-Cu is a bioactive peptide, a tripeptide complex containing glycine-histidine-lysine bound to copper (Cu), hence its other name - "copper peptide," due to the presence of copper in its composition.

GHK-Cu has a proven beneficial effect on the skin, stimulating the production of collagen and elastin, making the skin firmer and more elastic. This peptide enhances cellular regeneration and stimulates the microcirculation of blood in the skin, aiding in the rapid healing of various types of injuries.

Skin Glow is the most effective method for improving the health and beauty of the skin, thanks to the GHK-Cu peptide in its composition. It helps to reduce visible signs of aging such as fine lines and wrinkles, increases skin elasticity and hydration, and contributes to a younger, radiant, and healthy appearance.

The carefully designed formula of Skin Glow with GHK Cu is developed to provide maximum results and the best efficacy for improving skin health, nourishment, and brightness. Skin Glow with GHK-Cu is the perfect choice for enhancing the health and appearance of the skin with its action against ageing signs, brightening the skin, and its elasticity.

What are the benefits of Skin Glow (GHK Cu) Peptide?

Skin Glow with GHK-Cu has numerous beneficial properties for the skin. GHK Cu is composed of glycine, L-histidine, and copper, which act favourably to increase the elasticity and health of the skin. Some of the most important benefits of using Skin Glow with GHK Cu are:

  • Skin Glow helps smooth wrinkles and fine lines, stimulating collagen production.
  • GHK-Cu strengthens the collagen network, stimulating collagen production, which is vital for skin health.
  • Skin Glow with GHK-Cu helps reduce spots and imperfections on the skin.
  • The GHK Cu peptide improves and increases skin elasticity, maintaining its youthful appearance.
  • Skin Glow helps hydrate the skin, making it more hydrated and soft.
  • This product has a beneficial effect on the skin by calming it and reducing redness.
  • Helps to even out skin tone, reducing dark spots, acne scars, and pigmentation.
  • The GHK-Cu peptide promotes rapid cell growth, thereby accelerating the healing of wounds and injuries.
  • Skin Glow with GHK Cu is known for protecting the skin from oxidative stress, thus protecting cells from damage and premature ageing.
  • This extremely effective product helps improve skin quality by nourishing and hydrating it, giving it a fresh, young, and healthy appearance.

Skin Glow with GHK-Cu is a unique product with multiple beneficial benefits for the skin. Its properties to stimulate collagen production, its antioxidant properties, its hydrating action, and skin healing, make it a sought-after and used product by thousands of people who want better, healthier, and more beautiful skin.

Clinical trials of GHK Cu peptide and their results:

GHK-Cu, popularly known as glycyl-histidyl-lysine-copper (Copper peptide GHK-Cu), is a small tripeptide complex consisting of the amino acids glycine, lysine, and histidine bound to a copper ion. This complex is an active ingredient in cosmetic products designed for skin health. Its beneficial action and benefits also make it a product used in some medical applications.

In a clinical trial published in the Journal of Drugs in Dermatology, the results of using GHK Cu are indicated. They demonstrate its positive impact on skin texture, reduction of ageing signs, and improvement of the overall appearance of the skin.

The results of another study published in the Journal of Inflammation Research speak of the anti-inflammatory properties and the beneficial effect in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis of the use of GHK-Cu peptide.

In another study, the positive effect of GHK Cu in increasing the levels of natural growth hormone in the body, muscle mass, and fat is observed. The results of this clinical trial are published in the Journal of Endocrinological Investigation.

In other clinical trials, the results in participants demonstrate the antioxidant properties of GHK-Cu, as well as the positive effect of its use by people with problematic skin.

Correct Administration and Dosage of Skin Glow (GHK Cu):

The correct administration and dosage of Skin Glow depend on the specific needs and objectives of the patient, generally applied at 2.33mg per day.

The correct dosage of Skin Glow is 7 units per day.

Additional instructions for use: Adjust the pen programmer to 7 (1 unit is equal to 1 of the divisions in the programmer) and inject in the abdominal area or the front part of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The duration of the cycle with this peptide lasts 15 days, after which a break of 15 days is necessary and the intake can be resumed. The cycle can be carried out once a month for 15 days.

A pen contains 300 units per 333 micrograms.

A pen of Skin Glow (100mg) will be sufficient for approximately 2-3 months.

Examples of units calculated from the Skin Glow (100mg) pen corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 333mcg.; 7 units = 2.33mg; 10 units = 3.33mg.

What other peptides can Skin Glow be combined with?

Skin Glow (GHK-Cu) is a peptide used to improve the health and appearance of the skin. When combined with other peptides, it can enhance or extend its effect. Here are some peptides with which Skin Glow (GHK Cu) can be combined:

  • Epitalon - It is a peptide used to prolong the life of the body and cellular life. Combining them can help combat the signs of skin ageing and improve its tone and elasticity.
  • NAD+ Pen - It is a coenzyme that plays a key role in cellular metabolism and has the potential to improve cellular health. Combining them can enhance the regenerative processes of the skin and improve its overall condition.
  • 5-amino-1MQ - This peptide is known for its antioxidant properties and its ability to protect cells from damage caused by free radicals. Combining it with Skin Glow can help protect the skin from harmful external factors and maintain its youth.

Here we have only listed a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible Side Effects of Skin Glow (GHK-Cu):

Skin Glow is a cosmetic product that contains the GHK Cu peptide. This product is widely known and appreciated for its properties to stimulate cellular development in the skin and its recovery. Like any product, its use can cause some secondary reactions.

The most common secondary reactions from using Skin Glow with GHK-Cu manifest in slight redness or discomfort on the skin, which is usually observed in more sensitive skins. These symptoms are not dangerous and are short-lived.

In very rare cases, an allergic reaction to GHK-Cu may occur, manifested in an intense irritating rash. In the event of such a symptom, consultation with a specialist is mandatory.

Secondary reactions to the use of Skin Glow with GHK Cu have been observed extremely rarely. The use of this product is beneficial for the skin and its overall appearance. Skin care is one of the most important conditions for a full life, so consultation with a dermatologist or skin specialist is recommended.

description: What is Sermorelin? Sermorelin is a synthetic polypeptide consisting of 29 amino acids, developed to stimulate the release of growth hormone by the pituitary gland. This peptide is a structural analog of the human Growth Hormone-Releasing Hormone (GHRH), which is naturally produc
bodyHtml:
What is Sermorelin?

Sermorelin is a synthetic polypeptide consisting of 29 amino acids, developed to stimulate the release of growth hormone by the pituitary gland. This peptide is a structural analog of the human Growth Hormone-Releasing Hormone (GHRH), which is naturally produced in the body and plays a crucial role in regulating growth hormone (GH) production. This hormone peaks during childhood and youth and gradually decreases with age. A decline in GH levels can lead to various problems such as loss of muscle mass, decreased bone density, and disorders in fat metabolism.

Sermorelin acts as a growth hormone stimulant, helping the pituitary gland (part of the brain system) to release more GH. This process stimulates cell growth, muscle recovery, and the renewal of skin and hair. One of the main advantages of Sermorelin is that it works with the body to naturally increase GH levels, without the need to artificially introduce hormones.

What are the benefits of the Sermorelin peptide?

Sermorelin is a peptide hormone used to stimulate the production of growth hormone (GH) by the pituitary gland. Here are some of the potential benefits of using Sermorelin:

  • Growth stimulation: The most obvious benefit of Sermorelin is its ability to stimulate natural production of growth hormone, which can be beneficial for patients with growth hormone deficiency.
  • Improvement in metabolism: Growth hormone plays a significant role in metabolism, aiding in the breakdown of fats and building muscle mass. Sermorelin can help improve metabolism and body weight management.
  • Improvement in sleep quality: Some studies suggest that Sermorelin can improve sleep quality, which is particularly important as good sleep is critical for recovery and overall health.
  • Increase in energy and endurance: Improvements in growth hormone production can lead to increased energy and physical stamina.
  • Improvement in skin health: Growth hormone has a positive impact on the skin, helping in its elasticity and reducing visible signs of ageing. Sermorelin can have a similar effect.
  • Bone strengthening: Growth hormone is important for maintaining bone strength. Sermorelin can help strengthen bones and reduce the risk of osteoporosis.

Clinical research on Sermorelin and its results:

In adults, growth hormone deficiency can lead to an increase in body fat, a decrease in muscle mass and strength, and a deterioration in quality of life. Research on Sermorelin has examined its ability to improve these parameters. The results have been mixed, with some studies showing improvements in body composition and physical functions, while others find no significant difference.

In the field of anti-aging medicine, Sermorelin has been investigated for its potential benefits in improving quality of life, increasing energy, improving sleep, and other aging-related parameters. 

Proper Administration and Dosage of Sermorelin:

The correct administration and dosage of Sermorelin depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered from 200mcg to 500mcg once a day (before sleep).

The correct dosage of Sermorelin is 8 to 20 units per day (before sleep).

Additional usage instructions: Adjust the pen programmer from 8 to 20 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the programmer) and inject into the abdominal area or the front part of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The duration of the cycle with this peptide lasts up to 4 months.

A pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

A pen of Sermorelin (5mg) will be sufficient for 15-25 days depending on the daily dosage.

Calculated units of a Sermorelin pen (5mg) corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 25mcg; 5 units = 125mcg; 8 units = 200mcg; 10 units = 250mcg; 16 units = 400mcg; 20 units = 500mcg.

What other peptides can Sermorelin be combined with?

Sermorelin is a peptide that stimulates the release of growth hormone by the pituitary gland. It is frequently used to enhance growth functions and stimulate recovery, metabolism, and overall well-being. It can be combined with various other peptides and supplements to enhance desired effects, depending on individual goals. Here are some peptides that can be combined with Sermorelin for different purposes:

  • GHRP-6 or GHRP-2 - These peptides are ghrelin receptor agonists and strongly stimulate the release of growth hormone, further enhancing the effect of Sermorelin. This combination can significantly increase growth hormone levels in the body, leading to improved recovery processes, muscle building, and fat loss.
  • Ipamorelin - This peptide is a selective growth hormone stimulator and can be combined with Sermorelin to improve muscle mass and tissues.
  • CJC 1295 no dac - This combination is used to extend the duration of action of Sermorelin, while enhancing its effectiveness in stimulating growth hormone release. CJC 1295 no dac has a fast action and a short duration, making it ideal for a synergistic effect with Sermorelin.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of Sermorelin peptide:

Like any medication, Sermorelin may have side effects, although not everyone experiences them. The side effects of Sermorelin are usually temporary and may diminish over time as the body adjusts to the medication. Side effects include:

  • Reactions at the injection site: Pain, redness, swelling, or itching at the injection site. These reactions are common in many injectable medications and are usually localised and temporary.
  • Headache: Some people may experience mild to moderate headaches after taking Sermorelin. Generally, these headaches are temporary and can be relieved with standard painkillers.
  • Nausea and vomiting: In some cases, especially at the start of treatment, Sermorelin may cause nausea or even vomiting, which are usually short-lived.
