description: What is Semaglutide? Semaglutide is a medication used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes. It belongs to the incretin class and participates in the production of insulin by the pancreas, helps to reduce blood glucose levels, and promotes the acceleration of metabolism. Semagluti
bodyHtml:
What is Semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a medication used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes. It belongs to the incretin class and participates in the production of insulin by the pancreas, helps to reduce blood glucose levels, and promotes the acceleration of metabolism.

Semaglutide is a new generation medication that successfully controls blood sugar and normalises healthy weight. This peptide aids in the treatment of diabetes and also has a positive effect on the overall health condition of the body. The injectable medication Semaglutide can be combined with other diabetes treatments, supporting their action and having a positive impact on quality of life.

The positive effect of the use of the Semaglutide peptide is observed in the regulation of body weight, as it suppresses appetite, providing the body with a feeling of satiety. It improves blood pressure, blood cholesterol levels, which reduces the risk of developing heart diseases.

What are the benefits of Semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a medication that is an analog of the body's natural incretin hormones, which regulate blood glucose levels. It is used to treat type 2 diabetes, as well as to improve the general health condition of the body. The benefits of using the Semaglutide peptide include:

  • Semaglutide helps to increase insulin production in the body and aids in controlling blood sugar levels.
  • Semaglutide improves liver function, which reduces the risk of fat accumulation in it.
  • This peptide plays a significant role in controlling sugar levels, reducing the risks of developing diabetic complications, kidney damage, and diabetic retinopathy.
  • Semaglutide reduces appetite and signals satiety to the body, which supports healthy weight loss.
  • It helps to improve the general health condition of the body and protects it from other diseases related to diabetes.
  • The use of the Semaglutide peptide helps diabetics maintain control over blood glucose levels, reducing the risk of hypoglycemia.
  • Semaglutide helps diabetics normalise their healthy weight, stimulating the feeling of satiety in the body.
  • Semaglutide reduces blood glucose levels by stimulating insulin secretion by the pancreas.
  • It can improve the lipid profile, reducing levels of "bad" LDL cholesterol and increasing "good" HDL cholesterol.
  • It can help improve insulin sensitivity, which is particularly important for people with prediabetes or insulin resistance.

Semaglutide is not a cure for type 2 diabetes, but a product that can be used as part of the overall treatment and contribute to the improvement of the general condition of the body in patients who lead a healthy and active lifestyle.

Clinical trials of Semaglutide and their results:

The Semaglutide medication has successfully passed all clinical trials, in which its high efficacy and safety in patients with type 2 diabetes were established.

In one of the large clinical trials SUSTAIN 6, which included 3,000 participants with diabetes, the results showed that the use of Semaglutide significantly reduces the risk of cardiac events and strokes in diabetics.

Other clinical trials have demonstrated the positive impact of the Semaglutide peptide in reducing blood glucose levels, stimulating the release of insulin by the pancreas, better glycemic control, and healthy weight regulation in participants.

The summarised results of all clinical trials indicate that the use of Semaglutide has a significant positive effect on the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

Correct Intake and Dosage of Semaglutide:

Semaglutide Dosage:

The dosage of Semaglutide depends on specific conditions, which is why consultation with a qualified specialist is recommended to determine the correct dose and method of administration.

Method of Administration:

Semaglutide is administered via subcutaneous injection once weekly. The initial dose is typically 0.25 mg, which may be increased to 0.5 mg or 1 mg, depending on individual needs. If a dose of Semaglutide is missed, it should be administered as soon as possible, but a double dose should never be taken.

Additional Instructions for Use:

1 unit corresponds to one increment marked on the pen dial (or the number displayed when the dose selector is turned).
 The injection should be performed in the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait for 10 seconds before removing the needle. Rotating the injection site with each administration is recommended.

Information about the Pens:

A Semaglutide 5 mg pen contains 200 units of 25 mcg each. Example unit calculations for Semaglutide 5 mg in mg/mcg:

  • 1 unit = 25 mcg
  • 10 units = 0.25 mg
  • 20 units = 0.50 mg
  • 30 units = 0.75 mg
  • 40 units = 1 mg

A Semaglutide 1 mg pen contains 100 units of 10 mcg each. Example unit calculations for Semaglutide 1 mg in mg/mcg:

  • 1 unit = 10 mcg
  • 10 units = 0.10 mg
  • 20 units = 0.20 mg
  • 25 units = 0.25 mg
  • 50 units = 0.5 mg

Possible Side Effects of Semaglutide:

Semaglutide is a peptide used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes and, like any medication, its use can provoke adverse reactions. The occurrence of side effects is usually the result of incorrect administration of Semaglutide, being rare in patients who follow the prescribed dose.

The possible side effects after using Semaglutide manifest as headaches, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, or slight itching on the skin around the injection site.

The listed possible side effects of using Semaglutide are not severe and generally disappear within a few days. Consulting a specialist is mandatory and following their instructions and dosages will prevent the occurrence of adverse reactions.

name: S23 | 50mg/1,5ml
description: What Is S23? S23 is a synthetic Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator (SARM), developed to support muscle growth and fat reduction with maximum tissue selectivity. It stands out as one of the most potent compounds in its class, exhibiting exceptionally strong binding to androgen
bodyHtml:
What Is S23?

S23 is a synthetic Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator (SARM), developed to support muscle growth and fat reduction with maximum tissue selectivity. It stands out as one of the most potent compounds in its class, exhibiting exceptionally strong binding to androgen receptors and targeted action primarily in skeletal muscle tissue.

Designed for research purposes, S23 has attracted scientific interest due to its ability to maintain high levels of muscle strength and density, even under caloric restriction. It is frequently used in laboratory models focused on body recomposition, muscle recovery, and hormonal regulation.

Mechanism of Action of S23

S23 works by selectively activating androgen receptors, which play a central role in muscle growth, strength, and bone density. Upon binding to these receptors, the compound triggers cellular processes that stimulate muscle fiber development while simultaneously reducing fat mass.

Unlike traditional androgenic compounds, S23 does not convert to estrogen and does not cause water retention or unwanted growth in sensitive tissues. This makes it a relevant research target for studies seeking balanced androgenic activity with controlled effects limited to specific tissues.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits of S23

S23 demonstrates a range of effects that make it valuable in scientific studies related to body composition, recovery, and endocrine balance. These include:

  • Significant increases in muscle mass and strength;
  • Reduction in subcutaneous fat, particularly in the abdominal area;
  • Maintenance of muscle density during caloric deficit;
  • Enhanced muscle hardness and definition;
  • Potential relevance in research related to age-related muscle loss;
  • Suitable for subcutaneous application in a stabilized formula with precisely controlled dosing.

Its balanced action between anabolic potential and minimal hormonal disruption positions it as a preferred molecule for research aimed at physical optimization.

S23 vs Other SARMs

S23 is recognized as one of the most powerful SARMs, with extremely high affinity for the androgen receptor and a strong anabolic-androgenic profile. It is frequently compared with other leading compounds such as Testolone (RAD-140), Ligandrol (LGD-4033), and YK-11 due to its effectiveness in promoting muscle growth and fat loss.

Compared to RAD-140, S23 exhibits stronger androgenic potency but also a higher likelihood of suppressing endogenous testosterone. While RAD-140 offers a balance between anabolic effect and tolerability, S23 is used in studies aiming for maximal muscle stimulation and rapid body transformation, with no compromise in strength.

When compared with Ligandrol, which has a milder profile and is suited for longer research protocols, S23 is more appropriate for short, high-intensity studies where aggressive muscle building and fat burning are primary objectives. However, LGD-4033 may have an advantage in minimizing the risk of hormonal side effects.

Relative to YK-11, both compounds aim for rapid results but act through different mechanisms. S23 works through classical androgen modulation, whereas YK-11 combines androgenic activity with follistatin upregulation and myostatin inhibition. This makes YK-11 more suitable for studies targeting the enhancement of the genetic limit of muscle growth.

S23 is a powerful compound, often selected in advanced research protocols where maximum strength, muscle density, and anabolic response are sought—with the necessity of close monitoring of hormonal status.

Dosage and Application of S23 in Research Protocols

Suggested research protocol: 7 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week off-cycle.

1 unit = 333mcg

Total pen content: 150 units

Possible Side Effects of S23

Despite its high efficacy, S23 has been associated with several side effects, especially with prolonged use or elevated dosing:

  • Temporary suppression of natural testosterone production depending on dose and cycle duration;
  • Increased sensitivity to androgenic stimulation in certain models;
  • Limited long-term data on extended use and systemic impact.

Maintaining optimal dosage and controlling application duration are critical to minimizing potential side effects.

name: Retatrutide | 6/12/20/40mg
description: What is Retatrutide? Retatrutide is an experimental drug in development for the treatment of obesity and related metabolic diseases, such as type 2 diabetes. It acts as an agonist of multiple hormone receptors that regulate appetite and metabolism in the body. The primary goal of
bodyHtml:
What is Retatrutide?

Retatrutide is an experimental drug in development for the treatment of obesity and related metabolic diseases, such as type 2 diabetes. It acts as an agonist of multiple hormone receptors that regulate appetite and metabolism in the body. The primary goal of Retatrutide is to aid in weight loss by reducing appetite, increasing the feeling of satiety, and regulating glucose metabolism.

The mechanism of action of Retatrutide involves interaction with three hormones: GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1), GIP (glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide), and glucagon. These hormones play a key role in appetite control, insulin secretion, and fat breakdown.

The drug is part of a new generation of weight-loss medications being developed with the aim of providing more effective and long-lasting solutions for weight management and metabolic diseases.

What are the benefits of Retatrutide?

This peptide offers several benefits, particularly in the context of weight loss and the management of metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes. Here are the main advantages of its use:

  • Significant weight loss: Retatrutide is designed for individuals with obesity or overweight. Clinical trials have shown that it leads to substantial and sustained weight loss by reducing appetite and increasing the feeling of satiety. In some studies, users have lost up to 24% of their body weight after prolonged treatment.
  • Improved blood glucose control: Retatrutide regulates glucose metabolism, making it especially beneficial for patients with type 2 diabetes. As a GLP-1 receptor agonist, it enhances insulin secretion and improves blood glucose control, reducing post-meal glucose levels.
  • Regulation of appetite and metabolism-related hormones: The drug’s mechanism of action involves activating three hormones—GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon. This helps improve appetite control and fat burning, leading to more effective weight loss.
  • Reduced cardiovascular risk: By promoting weight loss and improving metabolic profile (blood glucose, cholesterol levels), Retatrutide may lower the risk of cardiovascular diseases, which are often associated with obesity and diabetes.
  • Improved lipid profile: The drug may also help reduce levels of “bad” LDL cholesterol and triglycerides, further enhancing overall health.
  • Potential treatment for liver diseases (NAFLD/NASH): Retatrutide is also being studied for its potential benefits in treating non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), both of which are linked to metabolic disorders.

These benefits make Retatrutide a promising therapy for individuals struggling with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and other related metabolic diseases.

Clinical trials of Retatrutide and their results:

The clinical trials of Retatrutide are focused on evaluating its effectiveness for weight loss and the treatment of metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes and obesity. So far, studies have shown promising results, positioning this drug as a potentially effective solution for body weight management.

Phase 1 of clinical trials:

  • Objective: To evaluate the safety, tolerance, and initial efficacy of the drug.
  • Results: In the early phases of the trials, Retatrutide demonstrated a significant effect on weight loss and appetite control. Overweight and obese patients experienced gradual and sustained weight loss without significant side effects.

Phase 2 of clinical trials:

  • Objective: To investigate optimal dosing and confirm initial findings on weight loss and metabolic effects.
  • Study Design: Participants included overweight and obese patients, some of whom had comorbid conditions such as type 2 diabetes.
  • Results: Participants experienced significant weight loss. Depending on the dosage, by the end of the study, patients had lost between 15% and 24% of their body weight after approximately 48 weeks of treatment. Improvements were also observed in blood glucose levels and insulin sensitivity, which are crucial for individuals with type 2 diabetes.
  • Dose-Dependent Effects: Higher doses of Retatrutide led to better results but also increased the frequency of side effects, such as nausea and gastrointestinal issues, which are common with GLP-1 receptor agonists.

Phase 3 of clinical trials:

  • Objective: To confirm the efficacy and safety of Retatrutide in a larger population over a longer period.
  • Focus: This phase also examines the long-term benefits of the treatment, particularly in reducing cardiovascular risk and improving liver function in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH).

Key clinical trial results:

  • Significant Weight Loss: Patients experienced a weight reduction of 15% to 24%, depending on dosage and treatment duration. This makes Retatrutide one of the most effective weight-loss medications in clinical trials to date.
  • Improvement in Metabolic Indicators: The drug has proven effective in lowering blood glucose levels, improving insulin sensitivity, and enhancing lipid profiles.
  • Side Effects: The most common side effects include gastrointestinal issues such as nausea and diarrhea, particularly at higher doses. However, these effects have been reversible and have not led to serious complications.

Retatrutide continues to be studied in various clinical trials to assess its long-term safety and efficacy. Current results suggest that it could become a key treatment for obesity and related metabolic disorders.

Proper dosage and administration of Retatrutide:

Dosage of Retatrutide:

The dosage of Retatrutide may vary depending on the specific protocol and the objectives of the user. The optimal administration parameters are determined according to the conditions of the respective study.

Method of administration:

Retatrutide is typically administered via subcutaneous injection once weekly. A commonly used starting dose is 2 mg, with the possibility of gradual increases (e.g., 4 mg, 6 mg up to 8 mg) depending on the observed effects. If a dose is missed, it may be administered as soon as possible without doubling the next dose.

Possible side effects of Retatrutide:

Retatrutide, like many other medications, may cause some side effects, although they do not occur in all patients. The most common adverse reactions are related to the digestive system, as the drug affects hormones that regulate appetite and metabolism. It is important to note that side effects may be more pronounced at higher doses.

Nausea: One of the most commonly reported adverse reactions when using Retatrutide. Nausea is usually mild to moderate but can be more intense at higher doses. It generally decreases over time as the body adapts to the medication.

Vomiting: Some patients report vomiting, especially at the beginning of treatment or with a rapid dose increase.

Diarrhea or constipation: Changes in the digestive system, including diarrhea or constipation, are also common in patients taking Retatrutide. This may be temporary, but in some cases, a dose adjustment may be necessary.

Fatigue: A feeling of fatigue or weakness may occur, especially in the early stages of treatment.

Increased heart rate: Some patients may experience a slight increase in pulse during physical activity.

It is important to emphasize that most side effects of Retatrutide are reversible and easily manageable. However, patients should be monitored by a doctor during treatment to ensure the safety and effectiveness of the therapy.

name: Resveratrol | 500mg
description: What is Resveratrol? Resveratrol is a natural polyphenol known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and potential anti-aging properties. Known for its beneficial effect on health, it can be found in grape seeds, strawberries, nuts, red wine, and other plant products. Resveratr
bodyHtml:
What is Resveratrol?

Resveratrol is a natural polyphenol known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and potential anti-aging properties. Known for its beneficial effect on health, it can be found in grape seeds, strawberries, nuts, red wine, and other plant products.

Resveratrol is beneficial for health as it has anti-inflammatory and cardiovascular properties, improves metabolism, reduces the risk of diabetes, positively influences metabolic pathways and glucose tolerance. The intake of resveratrol improves heart health by reducing levels of bad cholesterol, increasing levels of good cholesterol, regulating blood pressure, and improving endothelial function.

Resveratrol improves endurance and muscle mass increase, making it also popular among athletes.

It aids in recovery after intense workouts and reduces inflammation and pain. It participates in the production of mitochondria, which help generate energy in the cells. Thanks to this, resveratrol leads to improved athletic achievements, increasing endurance and muscle mass of the athlete.

What are the benefits of Resveratrol?

As one of the most studied phytochemicals, resveratrol is known for its potent antioxidant properties and multiple health benefits, which include:

  • Resveratrol helps to improve heart and vascular system health by reducing levels of "bad" cholesterol and increasing levels of "good" cholesterol.
  • Resveratrol enhances the immune system, protecting the body from infections and diseases.
  • Resveratrol helps to reduce inflammation and has anti-inflammatory properties, which positively affect diseases like arthritis and diabetes.
  • Improves the health and elasticity of the skin and protects against the harmful effects of UV rays.
  • Resveratrol helps to improve sleep quality.
  • Aids in the fight against ageing, slowing down the process. Resveratrol also protects against degenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's.
  • Resveratrol helps to manage blood pressure and improves circulation.
  • Resveratrol improves metabolism and participates in controlling blood sugar and preventing diabetes.
  • Helps to improve brain function, memory, and cognitive abilities.

Clinical studies on Resveratrol and their results:

Resveratrol is one of the most studied and researched phytochemicals, found in large quantities in strawberries, nuts, grape seeds, and other foods. Its multiple benefits and powerful antioxidant properties have been demonstrated through numerous clinical trials.

In one of the largest clinical trials related to resveratrol and its impact on the cardiovascular system, it was shown to improve endothelium functions, the inner layer of blood vessels, and help normalise blood pressure. The results of this study were published in "The New England Journal of Medicine" and provide a new perspective for managing body health.

In another study conducted by scientists in Copenhagen, the results show that resveratrol consumption helps delay ageing processes and improves body functions. During the clinical trial, participants received doses of resveratrol equivalent to those contained in 150 bottles of red wine. An improvement in glucose metabolism, a reduction in inflammation, and an improvement in the cardiovascular system were observed.

Another study published in "Nutrition Research" demonstrates the positive effect of resveratrol on patients with type 2 diabetes. It controls their blood sugar, improves glucose metabolism, and reduces levels of glycated haemoglobin.

Another clinical trial demonstrated the positive impact of resveratrol consumption on the brain functions of older people, improving their memory and concentration.

In the "Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism," the results of another trial demonstrate the positive effect of resveratrol on improving fat and glucose metabolism, as well as reducing insulin levels in patients with metabolic syndrome.

All the clinical trials conducted show the positive benefits of resveratrol for human health and a better quality of life. It is important to highlight that its benefit can be a complement as part of a healthy lifestyle and proper diet.

Proper Administration and Dosage of Resveratrol 500mg:

The product is intravenous, the vial is dissolved and poured into a 100ml bottle of sodium chloride. The maximum intake is 3 times a week at 500mg.

Possible side effects of Resveratrol (contraindications):

Resveratrol is known for its strong antioxidant impact and, like all supplements, it may have some side effects if its dosage is exceeded.

The most common side effects of resveratrol manifest in stomach discomfort, gas, constipation, or diarrhoea. These are not dangerous and usually disappear within a few days.

Although resveratrol can generally be safe for consumption, it is important not to exceed its dosage.

Additionally, Muse Cells can be isolated as SSEA-3 positive cells, a well-known marker for human embryonic stem cells. This marker ensures that the cells are "fresh" and suitable for both research and therapeutic applications.

The exosome spray represents a groundbreaking innovation in health and personal care, offering multiple benefits due to its unique properties. Its ability to accelerate tissue regeneration makes it ideal for wound healing and recovery from injuries. The spray enhances immune system function, providing powerful protection against infections and diseases. It is also being explored for its potential in combatting neurodegenerative diseases, improving the quality of life for patients.

The positive effects on skin health are evident not only in its regenerative properties but also in its ability to rejuvenate appearance. The exosome spray effectively reduces chronic inflammation, alleviating symptoms and contributing to overall well-being. In cases of sports injuries and fatigue, it promotes faster recovery, allowing the body to return to normal activity more efficiently.

Additional benefits include stimulating hair growth, making this product particularly desirable for individuals experiencing hair loss. Lastly, its impact on cognitive function opens new possibilities for enhancing focus, concentration, and memory.

bodyHtml:
What is PT141 (Bremelanotide)?

PT 141 is a peptide developed by Palatin Technologies that acts as an agonist of the melanocortin MC1 receptor, used for the treatment of various sexual dysfunctions and other health issues.

Bremelanotide is the synthetic analog of the melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH), which stimulates melanin production in the skin. PT141 was created as a remedy for sexual dysfunction, and is also used for the treatment of other medical problems.

PT 141 acts as a stimulant of melanocyte receptors and xanthine receptors. This helps to increase libido and sexual desire in both men and women. This peptide helps to improve erectile function in men and assists in the treatment of various types of sexual dysfunctions in women.

Research continues on Bremelanotide PT 141 for its positive impact on depression, mental health, chronic pain, hormonal imbalance, and other health issues. 

What are the benefits of PT 141 peptide (Bremelanotide)?

Bremelanotide PT 141 is a peptide that supports sexual function in women and men. The application of PT 141 has the following benefits:

  • PT 141 improves libido and increases sexual desire in both men and women.
  • PT141 improves erectile function in men and helps improve circulation in the genital organs.
  • The PT141 peptide enhances sexual sensations and increases the achievement of a more pleasurable orgasm.
  • PT 141 does not affect mental health and does not cause a feeling of euphoria.
  • The PT141 peptide is used in the treatment of various sexual dysfunctions in women and men, as an alternative to other pharmaceutical products.
  • PT141 leads to improved self-esteem and confidence during sexual contact.
  • It does not cause adverse effects on the body or psyche of the user.
  • It is useful in female sexual dysfunction, improving the experience and sexual desire.
  • PT 141 has a beneficial effect on post-traumatic stress disorder, reducing the feeling of fear, anxiety, and worry.
  • The PT141 peptide acts quickly, and the effect of its intake is observed within hours.

Clinical trials of the PT 141 peptide and their results:

PT 141 is used to support sexual function in men and women. Numerous clinical trials have demonstrated its positive effect in treating sexual dysfunctions.

In a clinical trial conducted in 2000 by Dr. Hyla Cass, women suffering from hypersexuality disorder participated. The participants were divided into two groups, where the first was treated with PT 141 and the second with a placebo. The results showed that in the women who received the PT 141 peptide, a higher level of sexual desire and greater satisfaction with sexual activity were observed.

In 2004, another clinical study was conducted involving 20 men suffering from erectile dysfunction. With the application of PT 141, a significantly higher level of sexual stimulation, a more durable erection, and an overall improvement in sexual function were observed.

In 2010, a third study on the impact of PT141 was published in the "Journal of Sexual Medicine". In this study, 327 women suffering from hypersexuality disorder participated. With the application of PT-141 in the participants, an improvement in sexual satisfaction, desire, and activity was found.

Correct administration and dosage of PT141:

The dose of the PT141 peptide may vary according to the individual needs of the patient.

Normally, the initial dose is 400 mcg. to 700 mcg. of PT 141. Expected effect from 1 to 6 hours. Administration schedule: 8 subcutaneous units up to 7 hours before sexual contact preferably at night and another 5 units in the morning. Expected effect: in the following 30 hours. Second administration schedule: 10-12 units several hours before sexual contact.

A pen contains 200 units per 50 micrograms.

Examples of calculated units from the PT-141 pen (10mg) corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 50mcg; 5 units = 250mcg; 10 units = 500mcg; 12 units = 600mcg; 15 units = 750mcg.

What other peptides can PT 141 be combined with?

PT-141 (Bremelanotide) is a peptide used to increase sexual desire and improve sexual function in men and women. When combined with other peptides, it can enhance or extend its effect. Here are some peptides with which PT-141 can be combined:

  • Melanotan II - Combining PT 141 with Melanotan II is a popular combination to improve sexual health. This combination can have a synergistic effect, increasing sexual desire and improving erectile function in men and libido in women.
  • Ipamorelin - This peptide is known for its ability to stimulate the release of growth hormone and can be combined with PT 141 to enhance sexual function and increase energy and endurance.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of PT 141:

PT 141 is a pharmaceutical product that has a positive effect on sexual dysfunctions in both men and women. Like any medication, its use can also cause some side effects. These are related to headaches, nausea, skin irritations, and increased blood pressure.

These side effects are mild and generally disappear within a few days. Consulting a specialist upon the appearance of any of these symptoms is advisable.

It is mandatory to follow the prescribed dosage and application instructions from a specialist to avoid more serious side effects.

What is PEG-MGF?

PEG-MGF is a modified form of MGF, making it more resistant to degradation and providing a longer-lasting effect in the body. This peptide has been synthetically created by adding polyethylene glycol (PEG) to the MGF molecule. This modification allows MGF to remain in circulation for a longer period and be more effectively distributed in muscle tissue.

PEG-MGF is used in sports because it enhances muscle growth, improves muscle function, and speeds up recovery after training, offering benefits similar to those of MGF. The PEG-MGF peptide helps improve connective tissue in muscles, strengthening joints and tendons, making it a highly sought-after product among athletes and fighters.

What are the benefits of the PEG-MGF?

PEG-MGF promotes faster muscle mass growth, enhances physical performance, and accelerates muscle recovery after training. Other benefits of using the PEG-MGF peptide include:

  • Muscle Growth: PEG-MGF enhances and increases muscle mass by stimulating the production of new muscle cells.
  • Protein Synthesis: This peptide stimulates protein synthesis, leading to improved muscle endurance.
  • Muscle Recovery: PEG-MGF aids in the repair of damaged muscle cells and speeds up muscle recovery.
  • Increased Strength: It enhances muscle strength by promoting muscle size growth.
  • Cardiovascular Health: The peptide improves cardiovascular function by stimulating the growth of new blood vessels.
  • Bone Density: It supports the growth of new bone tissue, improving bone density.
  • Immune System Support: PEG-MGF plays a role in T-cell production, enhancing immune function.
  • Fat Reduction: It helps reduce body fat by stimulating metabolism.
  • Cognitive Enhancement: This peptide improves cognitive functions, enhancing memory, focus, and concentration.
  • Mental Well-being: PEG-MGF improves sleep quality, reduces stress, anxiety, and depression, and boosts overall mood.

Clinical trials of PEG-MGF and their results:

The PEG-MGF peptide has been studied for the treatment of various diseases, as well as for monitoring its effectiveness on human health and its positive impact on physical performance.

In a clinical trial, the results show that PEG-MGF improves muscle mass and strength in participants with muscle-related diseases.

Another clinical trial follows the impact of PEG-MGF on individuals undergoing intensive training, demonstrating its role in the rapid recovery of muscles after intense physical exercise and workouts.

In one of the studies, a relationship has been demonstrated between PEG-MGF intake and an improvement in the quality of life in participants with bone and heart conditions.

The results of clinical trials prove the positive impact of PEG-MGF intake on enhancing cognitive functions and reducing body fat.

Correct dosage and administration of PEG-MGF 5mg:

The dosage and administration of PEG-MGF (Polyethylene Glycol Mechano Growth Factor) depend on various factors, including the purpose of use, individual needs, and the person's health condition.

The dosage of PEG-MGF may vary based on individual requirements and intended use, but it is generally recommended to take 100-200 micrograms per day. However, this may differ depending on personal factors.

A PEG-MGF pen contains 200 units of 25μg each.

1 unit = 25μg; 2 units = 50μg; 4 units = 100μg; 8 units = 200μg; 12 units = 300μg

Possible side effects of PEG-MGF:

Like any medicinal product or supplement, the use of the PEG-MGF peptide may cause some mild side effects, such as redness or slight pain at the injection site, as well as headaches.

PEG-MGF is a safe and beneficial peptide, and potential side effects are generally observed only when the recommended dosage is not followed. To prevent them, it is essential to adhere to the prescribed dosage and consult a specialist.

Application of PEG-MGF in sports:

PEG-MGF is a biotechnological product used in sports as an effective way to enhance physical performance and athletic capability.

bodyHtml:
What is Pancragen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Trp)?

Pancragen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Trp) is a peptide bioregulator that functions as a synthetic tetrapeptide composed of Lysine (Lys), Glutamic Acid (Glu), Aspartic Acid (Asp), and Tryptophan (Trp). Bioregulators, also known as cytomedins, are used in bioregulatory medicine and biotechnology to enhance the function of specific organs or systems within the body.

Synthesized using the "thin-layer" method in a polypeptide synthesizer, these peptides are designed to mimic natural bioregulatory processes. They function like biological "keys," activating or deactivating specific cellular functions, encouraging the body to restore natural balance and efficiency.

Pancragen is specifically formulated to support pancreatic health. It helps stimulate the pancreas's natural functions, assisting in the production of essential hormones and enzymes that play a key role in blood sugar regulation and digestion.

  • Regulates Blood Sugar Levels: This peptide supports the body's ability to regulate blood sugar, enhancing insulin production in the pancreas.
  • Aids Digestion: Pancragen supports normal digestion by assisting the pancreas in producing digestive enzymes.
  • Promotes Healthy Metabolism: By supporting pancreatic function and digestion, Pancragen contributes to overall metabolic health.
  • Enhances Energy Balance: Insulin, produced by the pancreas, is critical for the body's energy balance, and Pancragen may help in energy management.
  • Boosts Immune Support: By maintaining optimal pancreatic function, Pancragen may contribute to immune system support.
  • Helps Maintain Healthy Cholesterol Levels: Pancragen may support normal cholesterol levels, promoting healthy pancreatic activity.
  • Facilitates Stress Recovery: Since the pancreas plays a role in stress response, Pancragen may help normalize stress-related metabolic reactions and support pancreatic health.

Possible side effects of Pancragen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Trp)

There are no known reports of negative side effects.

Proper intake and dosage of Pancragen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Trp)

The recommended intake for this peptide is 20 units per day (2 mg). One pen lasts for 10 doses or 10 days.

bodyHtml:
What Is Ostarine (MK2866)?

Ostarine, also known as MK2866, is a Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator (SARM) developed for research focused on building and preserving lean muscle mass, enhancing physical strength, and supporting bone structure. It is one of the most extensively studied molecules in its class, known for its well-balanced anabolic effect combined with a low risk of adverse reactions when applied appropriately.

MK2866 was designed for the investigation of conditions associated with muscle loss, including aging, chronic illness, or prolonged immobilization. Thanks to its high tissue selectivity and mild yet effective androgenic activity, Ostarine is widely utilized in research models aimed at physical rehabilitation and body recomposition.

Mechanism of Action of Ostarine (MK2866)

Ostarine works by selectively activating androgen receptors in muscle and bone tissues. This activation promotes protein synthesis, nitrogen retention, and improved metabolic activity involved in the formation and maintenance of muscle fibers.

MK2866 binds to androgen receptors in a way that allows anabolic action without significant impact on other organs such as the prostate. It does not convert to estrogen and does not cause water retention, which contributes to a cleaner body composition throughout the research protocol.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits of Ostarine (MK2866)

Scientific observations from research using Ostarine have highlighted several key potential benefits:

  • Promotion and preservation of lean muscle mass, especially under caloric deficit;
  • Accelerated recovery following physical exertion or catabolic stress;
  • Improved bone density and structural resilience;
  • Support for functional strength and muscular endurance;
  • Suitable profile for longer-term research protocols.

Ostarine is particularly appropriate for studies aimed at minimizing muscle loss and maintaining physical performance during caloric restriction or recovery phases.

Ostarine (MK2866) vs Other SARMs

Ostarine (MK2866) is one of the most widely used and well-researched SARMs, known for its high tolerability, moderate anabolic effect, and suitability for extended research protocols. Due to its balanced profile, it is frequently compared with compounds such as Ligandrol (LGD-4033), Testolone (RAD-140), and S23.

Compared to Ligandrol, Ostarine offers a milder anabolic effect with a lower risk of side effects, particularly during long-term use. Relative to S23—a highly potent SARM with a more aggressive androgenic profile—Ostarine remains a significantly safer and more controllable alternative, often used in initial research protocols or as part of support cycles following stronger compounds.

MK2866 is frequently selected in research settings aimed at improving body composition, reversing catabolic states, and maintaining strength without requiring complex hormonal interventions.

Suggested research protocol: 5 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week off-cycle.

Despite MK2866's favorable safety profile, some side effects have been observed, especially with extended use or higher doses:

description: What is Nicotinamide NAD+? NAD+ is short for nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a type of molecule that is essential for the vital functions of all cells in the body. It acts as a coenzyme that helps transfer energy from food molecules to cellular processes, such as DNA synthesis
bodyHtml:
What is Nicotinamide NAD+?

NAD+ is short for nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a type of molecule that is essential for the vital functions of all cells in the body. It acts as a coenzyme that helps transfer energy from food molecules to cellular processes, such as DNA synthesis and replication.

NAD+ Nicotinamide plays a significant role in regulating ageing, controlling metabolism, and protecting against stress.

Scientists see high potential in its role for treating various diseases and disorders of the nervous system, cancer, and ageing.

Nicotinamide NAD+ is considered to enhance mitochondrial function and increase the energy efficiency of cells, making it a useful tool for improving physical endurance and reducing recovery time after training.

NAD+ for Rejuvenation (Anti-Aging):

NAD+ is increasingly used in various therapies and procedures with a focus on rejuvenation. Here’s how NAD+ aids in rejuvenation:

Fighting skin ageing: NAD+ aids in DNA repair and stimulates the activity of sirtuins – enzymes that regulate various cellular processes related to ageing. This can contribute to maintaining healthy and youthful skin, combating fine lines and wrinkles.

Maintaining energy levels: Supporting cellular energy levels through the maintenance of Nicotinamide helps maintain overall energy levels and can support physical activity and endurance, even in older age.

DNA repair and protection against UV stress: Skin cells are regularly exposed to UV radiation damage, leading to DNA damage. NAD+ supports the work of enzymes that repair damaged DNA and thus helps prevent ageing caused by sun exposure.

Antioxidant protection: Nicotinamide participates in the antioxidant protection of cells, fighting free radicals and preventing oxidative damage that can accelerate skin ageing.

Inflammation and immune protection: With age, the skin becomes more susceptible to inflammation and infections. Nicotinamide can modulate inflammatory processes and support cellular immunity in the skin, providing enhanced protection.

Collagen synthesis: NAD+ can influence collagen synthesis, which is essential for maintaining skin firmness and elasticity, thereby helping to prevent wrinkle formation.

NAD+ is a crucial molecular component in cellular ageing processes and maintaining skin health, aiding in DNA repair, protection against oxidative stress, and maintaining cellular energy and regeneration. It can be a key factor in maintaining a youthful appearance and skin health.

What are the benefits of Nicotinamide NAD+?

NAD+ Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide is a molecule of great importance in the body,s biological processes. It has multiple health benefits and is a crucial factor for cellular processes. Its benefits include:

  • Nicotinamide NAD+ supports the intracellular metabolism of glucose and lipids, which is vital for the energy metabolism of cells.
  • NAD+ regulates the circadian rhythm, important for sleep and the body.
  • Nicotinamide NAD+ increases sports endurance, helping mitochondria produce more energy.
  • Nicotinamide therapy supports the creation of new cells, necessary for DNA synthesis.
  • NAD+ (nicotinamide) supports protein metabolism, breaking down old proteins and aiding in the construction of new ones.
  • NAD+ improves the resilience of neurons responsible for responding to stress.
  • Nicotinamide therapy is useful for the proper functioning of the body and cells in it, and an elevated level of this molecule leads to a longer life span.
  • NAD+ takes care of the proper functioning of the brain, participating in increasing protein metabolism and boosting the energy metabolism of neurons.
  • Nicotinamide NAD+ participates in improving muscle function and increases endurance in active athletes.
  • NAD+ stimulates the production of collagen and other elements necessary for cellular regeneration and, in this way, supports restorative processes in the body.
  • This product has antioxidant properties, which protect cells from damage.
  • Nicotinamide NAD+ participates in improving cellular function by maintaining the health of mitochondria, responsible for energy production in cells. Thus, it improves metabolism and reduces the risk of metabolic diseases.
  • Nicotinamide NAD+ protects cells from oxidative stress, which can damage DNA and other cellular components.

Clinical trials of NAD+ Nicotinamide and their results:

The Nicotinamide molecule plays a crucial role in the proper functioning of the body, participating in many metabolic processes related to health. It positively affects ageing processes and related diseases.

Numerous clinical trials have been conducted and continue to demonstrate the positive effectiveness of NAD+ therapy against diseases such as diabetes, cancer, Parkinson,s disease, Alzheimer,s disease, as well as its positive impact in combating ageing.

In one of the clinical trials, scientists showed that NAD+ therapy improves metabolic function and reduces inflammation in participants with diabetes. In another trial with Nicotinamide NAD+, the improvement of cognitive function in patients with mild cognitive impairment was demonstrated.

Other studies show that the use of Nicotinamide improves the functions of mitochondria and increases the number of mitochondria in cells, aiding in the fight against ageing.

Total: 300 units
1 unit = 4mg
Dosage: 2 times per day, 10 units each time, every other day
Duration: 30 days, followed by 15–20 days off

Duration: 30 days, followed by 15–20 days off

What other peptides can NAD+ be combined with?

NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme that participates in numerous biochemical processes in cells, including energy metabolism. Combining NAD+ with other peptides can be used for various purposes, including improving skin health, stimulating tissue regeneration, and supporting metabolic processes. Here are some of the peptides that can be combined with Nicotinamide:

  • Epitalon: It is a peptide known for its potential anti-aging properties. It stimulates the production of telomerase, an enzyme that helps maintain the length of telomeres in DNA, which can lead to the prolongation of cell life. Combining it can support cellular health and delay ageing processes.
  • 5-amino-1MQ: It is a small molecular inhibitor that blocks the activity of NNMT (nicotinamide N-methyltransferase), an enzyme involved in the metabolism of nicotinamide and can influence the production of NAD+. Inhibiting NNMT can increase nicotinamide levels in cells and improve metabolic functions, making 5-amino-1MQ suitable to combine with NAD+ to stimulate energy efficiency and body weight management.
  • Skin Glow (GHK-Cu): It is a peptide complex containing copper peptide, known for its benefits for the skin, including stimulating the production of collagen and elastin, and improving skin recovery. Combining both products can offer additional benefits for skin health, supporting cellular metabolism and regeneration.

Here we have only listed a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible Side Effects of NAD+:

NAD+ is a molecule that naturally exists in the human body. However, its ingestion in large doses can cause some side effects such as headaches, nausea, diarrhoea, or skin irritations.

Following the recommended doses, the use of Nicotinamide does not provoke side effects.

description: What Is N-Clomiphene? N-Clomiphene (Enclomiphene) is the active isomer of clomiphene citrate—a compound classified as a Selective Estrogen Receptor Modulator (SERM). Unlike the standard clomiphene mix, which contains both E- and Z-isomers, N-Clomiphene represents the pure eutomer
bodyHtml:
What Is N-Clomiphene?

N-Clomiphene (Enclomiphene) is the active isomer of clomiphene citrate—a compound classified as a Selective Estrogen Receptor Modulator (SERM). Unlike the standard clomiphene mix, which contains both E- and Z-isomers, N-Clomiphene represents the pure eutomeric form responsible for stimulating endogenous testosterone production by blocking estrogenic negative feedback in the hypothalamus.

In research settings, N-Clomiphene is studied as a non-steroidal alternative for stimulating the hypothalamic-pituitary-testicular axis (HPTA), especially in cases of secondary hypogonadism. Its selective mechanism and lower risk of estrogenic side effects make it a preferred candidate in protocols focused on hormonal restoration and the maintenance of androgenic function.

Mechanism of Action of N-Clomiphene

N-Clomiphene works by antagonizing estrogen receptors in the hypothalamus, leading to an increased release of gonadotropins—luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)—from the pituitary gland. This stimulation promotes natural testosterone production in the testes without requiring external androgen sources.

Unlike the Z-isomer (Zuclomiphene), which exhibits stronger estrogenic activity and longer retention in the body, N-Clomiphene has a shorter duration of action and provides a more precise hormonal response. This makes it suitable for controlled research protocols with minimal accumulation over time.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits of N-Clomiphene

Research on N-Clomiphene has identified several potential benefits, including:

  • Increased LH and FSH secretion leading to enhanced natural testosterone production;
  • Improved hormonal balance in models of secondary hypogonadism;
  • Fertility preservation in studies where spermatogenesis maintenance is desired;
  • Regulation of estrogen-dominant conditions through central receptor blockade;
  • Lower risk of estrogenic effects compared to traditional clomiphene mixes;
  • Subcutaneous delivery in a stabilized formula ensuring consistent absorption under controlled conditions.

Dosage and Application of N-Clomiphene in Research Protocols

Suggested research protocol: 8-10 units once daily.

1 unit = 300mcg

Total pen content: 300 units

What Is the Difference Between N-Clomiphene and Clomiphene Citrate?

Clomiphene citrate is a racemic mixture composed of two isomers—Enclomiphene (E-isomer) and Zuclomiphene (Z-isomer)—in an approximate 62:38 ratio. Enclomiphene is the biologically active fraction responsible for stimulating gonadotropins (LH and FSH) and triggering endogenous testosterone production. Zuclomiphene, in contrast, has a longer half-life and stronger estrogenic effects, which can contribute to unwanted outcomes such as water retention, mood fluctuations, or hormonal imbalance.

N-Clomiphene is the isolated active form that eliminates the negative actions associated with Zuclomiphene. This makes it more effective and predictable in research settings, particularly in studies focused on preserving the HPTA axis, fertility, and recovery following suppressive cycles. Its shorter half-life allows for better dosing control and a cleaner hormonal response without systemic buildup.

Possible Side Effects of N-Clomiphene

Although N-Clomiphene demonstrates a favorable safety profile, some side effects have been observed, particularly with prolonged use or in individuals with heightened sensitivity:

  • Mild mood changes or irritability;
  • Headaches or tension related to estrogen receptor modulation;
  • Temporary shifts in libido or androgen sensitivity.

Proper dosing and duration control are essential in minimizing the risk and expression of side effects.

name: MOTS-c | 10mg
description: What is MOTS-c? MOTS-c is a peptide molecule discovered by Dr. Ping Ling and a team of scientists from the University of Southern California. This peptide was found in the "power centers" of our cells, which are the mitochondria. MOTS-c 10mg is a relatively new compound that is s
bodyHtml:
What is MOTS-c?

MOTS-c is a peptide molecule discovered by Dr. Ping Ling and a team of scientists from the University of Southern California. This peptide was found in the "power centers" of our cells, which are the mitochondria.

MOTS-c 10mg is a relatively new compound that is still under investigation to determine its full range of potential health benefits. However, scientific research suggests that MOTS-c may provide multiple beneficial effects on the human body.

One of the most well-known effects of this peptide is its role in metabolism regulation. It is considered one of the key molecules responsible for metabolic control, leading to improved metabolic processes in the body. Studies indicate that MOTS-c can enhance glucose tolerance, which may aid in diabetes management.

A study published in the journal Cell Metabolism found that participants who used MOTS-c experienced better muscle function and increased physical endurance compared to the control group. This suggests that MOTS-c 10mg can improve physical stamina and muscle mass. Additionally, MOTS-c is believed to have positive effects on cognitive function and sleep quality. Another study published in Nature Communications showed that participants who received MOTS-c demonstrated better cognitive performance and improved sleep quality.

As a signaling molecule, MOTS-c can communicate with various cells and organs in the body. This peptide may contribute to reducing chronic inflammation and slowing down aging processes, ultimately resulting in a healthier and longer life.

What are the benefits of MOTS-c 10mg?

As mentioned earlier, MOTS-c 10mg is a relatively new and innovative peptide. However, scientific discoveries suggest that this peptide may provide numerous potential health benefits. Here are some of the key advantages of MOTS-c:

  • Regulates metabolism and enhances metabolic processes within the body.
  • Improves glucose tolerance, which may aid in the treatment of diabetes.
  • Supports muscle growth and development, helping to increase muscle mass.
  • Enhances physical endurance and stamina.
  • Reduces chronic inflammation and strengthens the immune system.
  • Improves sleep quality, leading to better rest and recovery.
  • Enhances cognitive functions, including memory and mental clarity.
  • Promotes cardiovascular health and reduces the risk of heart disease.
  • Increases insulin sensitivity, which is crucial for blood sugar regulation.
  • Protects against metabolic diseases, including metabolic syndrome.
  • Improves the body,s resistance to stress, aiding in better adaptation to physical and mental challenges.
  • Boosts mitochondrial function, enhancing cellular energy production.
  • Reduces the risk of age-related diseases and supports healthy aging and longevity.

Clinical trials on MOTS-c and their results:

Although MOTS-c 10mg is a relatively new peptide, numerous clinical trials are being conducted to investigate its efficacy and potential for treating various conditions. Below are some key studies on MOTS-c 10mg and their findings:

  1. One of the first experiments with this peptide was conducted on mice. The study found that mice treated with MOTS-c showed improved metabolism and reduced inflammation compared to the control group.
  2. Another clinical trial on MOTS-c, published in Nature Communications, involved human participants receiving MOTS-c for five days. The results showed that those who received MOTS-c exhibited better cognitive performance and improved sleep quality compared to the placebo group.
  3. A third clinical trial, published in Cell Metabolism, focused on athletes. The study found that athletes who received MOTS-c 10mg experienced better muscle function and increased physical endurance compared to those in the control group.
  4. Diabetes and Weight Loss Study in Mice – Another study, also published in Cell Metabolism, investigated MOTS-c 10mg in diabetic mice. The results showed that MOTS-c 10mg improved blood sugar regulation and promoted weight loss, suggesting potential benefits for diabetes management.

Proper administration and dosage of MOTS-c:

Correct administration and dosage of MOTS-c:

The correct administration and dosage of MOTS-c 10mg depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered at 2.5 mg once every 5 days.

The correct dosage of MOTS-c is 50 units every 5 days (once every 5 days).

Additional usage instructions: Adjust the pen doser by turning it to 50 (1 unit equals 1 division on the doser) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

One pen contains 200 units of 50 micrograms.

One MOTS-c pen (10 mg) will be sufficient for approximately 20 days, depending on the daily dosage.

Example unit calculations from a MOTS-c pen (10 mg) corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 50μg; 5 units = 250μg; 10 units = 500μg; 20 units = 1mg; 50 units = 2.5mg; 60 units = 3mg.

Which other peptides can be combined with MOTS-c?

MOTS-c 10mg is a peptide extracted from mitochondrial DNA that has multiple benefits, including improving glucose metabolism in skeletal muscles, as well as potential applications for treating conditions such as diabetes, obesity, aging, and cardiovascular issues. MOTS-c can be combined with other peptides to enhance its effects, particularly in the context of improving muscle recovery, increasing endurance, and optimizing mitochondrial health.

  • CJC-1295 NO DAC – This peptide is used to stimulate the release of growth hormone (GH) from the pituitary gland. Combining it with MOTS-c 10mg may contribute to enhancing mitochondrial function and regulating hormonal balance.
  • Ipamorelin – This peptide stimulates the release of growth hormone and has been researched for its anti-aging and regenerative properties. The combination of both peptides can improve mitochondrial health and have anti-aging effects.
  • PEG-MGF – This peptide binds to growth factors that stimulate muscle growth and recovery. Combining it with MOTS-c can improve mitochondrial function and promote muscle recovery after exercise.

These are just a few examples of the peptides that can be combined with MOTS-c to enhance its effects.

Possible side effects of MOTS-c:

To date, no side effects have been reported from the use of MOTS-c, but it is still possible that some effects may occur, especially at higher doses or if the recommended dosage and administration guidelines are not followed. Some rarely reported side effects in a few studies include:

  • Headaches.
  • Nausea.
  • Stomach discomfort.

MOTS-c 10mg may be safe for use if the correct dosage is followed, and if large quantities or prolonged use are avoided.

name: MGF Peptide | 5mg
description: What is MGF Peptide? MGF is a peptide hormone, a variant of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), which plays an important role in muscle growth and recovery. This peptide is produced in muscle cells after physical exercise. MGF increases protein synthesis in the body, which stim
bodyHtml:
What is MGF Peptide?

MGF is a peptide hormone, a variant of insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), which plays an important role in muscle growth and recovery. This peptide is produced in muscle cells after physical exercise.

MGF increases protein synthesis in the body, which stimulates the production of new muscle cells. The MGF peptide helps accelerate the muscle recovery process after training and enhances muscle growth itself.

The MGF peptide is used by athletes as a means to promote muscle growth and improve recovery after training. In medicine, it is found as a treatment for muscle injuries and muscle function disorders.

What are the benefits of MGF Peptide?

The MGF peptide hormone offers numerous benefits for a person,s health and fitness, including:

  • MGF peptide increases muscle mass by stimulating the production of new muscle cells.
  • The MGF peptide improves muscle endurance by stimulating protein synthesis.
  • This peptide participates in the rapid recovery of muscles after training and exercises and aids in the recovery of muscle cells.
  • Supports the growth of muscle fibers by activating satellite cells, leading to an increase in muscle mass and strength.
  • MGF peptide improves cardiovascular function by stimulating the growth of new blood vessels.
  • Stimulates the growth of new bone tissue, improving bone density and strength.
  • MGF stimulates T-cell production, leading to an improvement in the immune function of the body.
  • MGF helps reduce body fat by stimulating fat metabolism.
  • The MGF peptide enhances cognitive functions and helps improve memory, concentration, and focus.
  • MGF helps improve sleep quality, reduces stress, and enhances mood.
  • Aids in the regeneration process of damaged muscle cells, which is especially important after injuries or surgical procedures.

MGF Clinical trial results

A clinical trial demonstrates that MGF consumption improves heart function and reduces the risk of cardiovascular diseases.

Another trial observed faster muscle recovery after spinal surgery through MGF peptide consumption.

The results of a clinical study show that MGF peptide consumption increases muscle mass and helps reduce body fat in participants with muscle-related diseases.

In one of the studies, it was observed that MGF peptide enhances immune function and aids in tissue recovery after a stroke.

All clinical trials conducted on MGF peptide demonstrate its beneficial effects on muscle mass, sleep quality, immune function, and other health aspects.

Proper intake and dosage of MGF Peptide:

The proper intake and dosage of MGF depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient. Generally, 200 mcg to 350 mcg is applied once per day.

The correct dosage of MGF is 8 to 14 units per day.

Additional usage instructions: Adjust the pen dial by turning it to 8 or 14 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the dial) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. Rotating the injection site is recommended.

The cycle duration with this peptide lasts around 45 days, after which a 30-day break is required before resuming use.

One pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

One MGF pen (5mg) will last approximately 20 days, depending on the daily dosage.

Calculated units from an MGF pen (5mg) equivalent to micrograms:

1 unit = 25mcg

5 units = 125mcg

8 units = 200mcg

10 units = 250mcg

14 units = 350mcg

What other peptides can MGF be combined with?

MGF (Mechano Growth Factor) is a peptide that is naturally released in muscles after physical exercise and stimulates muscle cell growth and recovery. It is popular in sports and fitness for accelerating recovery, enhancing muscle growth, and increasing muscle strength. Combining MGF with other peptides can enhance these effects. Here are some possible combinations:

  • Ipamorelin: A selective ghrelin receptor agonist, meaning it stimulates the release of growth hormone (GH) similarly to ghrelin (a hormone that regulates appetite and energy distribution). Combining them may offer a synergistic effect in stimulating muscle growth and recovery while increasing natural GH production for improved overall health and recovery.
  • CJC-1295 without DAC (Drug Affinity Complex): A peptide that increases plasma levels of growth hormone (GH) and IGF-1 with prolonged action. The combination of both products can enhance muscle growth and recovery effects, as both peptides act synergistically to promote muscle hypertrophy and recovery.
  • ACE-031: A peptide developed to combat diseases leading to muscle degeneration and weakness. It works by blocking myostatin, a protein that inhibits muscle growth. Myostatin inhibition can significantly increase muscle mass and strength. Combining MGF with ACE-031 may offer an even greater increase in muscle mass and improvement in muscle function, utilizing different mechanisms of action for maximum effect.

This is just a small selection of peptides that can be combined with MGF.

Possible side effects of MGF

Some side effects may occur when taking MGF peptide, as with any medication. These may include:

  • Mild pain, redness, or slight discomfort
  • Rash or itching around the injection site

MGF peptide has been shown to be safe for use, and these symptoms are rare. Following the recommended dosage is mandatory to avoid these adverse reactions.

Use of MGF in sports

MGF is used by athletes primarily to enhance muscle growth and accelerate recovery after training. Athletes may use MGF to achieve several goals:

  • Increase muscle mass
  • Faster recovery after training
  • Accelerate metabolism
  • Faster muscle growth
  • Improve strength and endurance

Many athletes benefit from MGF use, including bodybuilders, weightlifters, football players, and basketball players, as well as athletes who need to improve muscle function and endurance, such as boxers, MMA fighters, etc.

However, the use of MGF in sports may be prohibited by various sports organizations.

description: What is Melanotan II? Melanotan II is a synthetic peptide, similar to the natural melanocyte-stimulating hormone (MSH), which is used to stimulate skin darkening, regulate pigmentation, and can be used to treat some types of sexual dysfunctions. This peptide is injected subcutane
bodyHtml:
What is Melanotan II?

Melanotan II is a synthetic peptide, similar to the natural melanocyte-stimulating hormone (MSH), which is used to stimulate skin darkening, regulate pigmentation, and can be used to treat some types of sexual dysfunctions.

This peptide is injected subcutaneously and, once activated, changes the production of melanin in the skin. MT2 is used as a tanning agent, as when activated, the skin begins to darken more quickly and easily when exposed to the sun.

Melanotan II stimulates melanin receptors in the brain, which helps increase libido and improve sexual function, making it a good means to treat sexual dysfunction, erectile dysfunction, and reduced libido.

What are the benefits of Melanotan II?

The peptide Melanotan II has been shown to have a positive effect on human health. In addition to its useful properties regarding easier skin tanning, its use also has a positive result in the treatment of some types of sexual dysfunctions. The benefits of using Melanotan II include:

  • Melanotan II stimulates the production of melanin in the skin, which facilitates tanning and sun exposure.
  • Melanotan 2 improves sexual functions, increasing libido and enhancing erectile function.
  • This peptide protects the skin from sunburn and harmful UV radiation, as darker skin is less vulnerable.
  • Improves mood and a sense of well-being, increasing endorphin in the body.

The main benefit of using the peptide Melanotan 2 is to stimulate the production of melanin in the skin. This leads to faster and easier darkening, which in turn leads to the prevention of skin damage and ageing due to ultraviolet rays.

Clinical trials of Melanotan II and the results of these:

Melanotan 2 has undergone numerous clinical trials, through which its effectiveness as a tanning agent as well as its positive effect on the treatment of sexual dysfunction has been demonstrated.

In one of the studies, conducted in Australia, it is shown that 95% of the participants who used MT2 for 6 weeks achieved a longer-lasting tan after sun exposure.

In another clinical trial, involving women and men with sexual dysfunctions, the results show that Melanotan II has a positive effect on managing these issues in both sexes.

Correct administration and dosage of Melanotan II (MT2):

The correct administration and dosage of Melanotan depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally applied from 250mcg. to 500mcg. per dose (taken three times a week).

The correct dose of Melanotan is 5 to 10 units three times a week.

Additional instructions for use: Adjust the pen programmer from 5 to 10 (1 unit is equivalent to 1 of the divisions of the programmer) and inject into the abdominal area or the front part of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

A pen contains 200 units per 50 micrograms.

A pen of Melanotan (10mg) will be sufficient for approximately 2-3 months, depending on the daily dose.

Examples of units calculated from a Melanotan (10mg) pen corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 50mcg.; 4 units = 200mcg.; 5 units = 250mcg.; 6 units = 300mcg.; 8 units = 400mcg.; 10 units = 500mcg.

Sample Melanotan tanning cycle:

First week - Three times a week for 8 units.

Second week - Three times a week for 8 units.

Third week - Twice a week for 8 units.

Fourth week - Once a week for 8 units.

Fifth, sixth week, and following - Depending on the degree of tanning.

What other peptides can Melanotan II be combined with?

Melanotan II is a peptide that stimulates the production of melanin in the skin, causing it to darken. When combined with other peptides, it can enhance or extend its effect. Here are some peptides with which Melanotan II can be effectively combined:

  • PT-141 (Bremelanotide) - Is a peptide specifically used to increase sexual desire and enhance sexual function in men and women. When combined with Melanotan II, this combination can increase sexual desire and improve erectile function in men and libido in women.

Here we have only listed a small part of the peptides with which it can be combined.

Possible side effects of Melanotan II:

Melanotan II is a hormonal peptide that is injected subcutaneously and, like any pharmaceutical product, can cause some side effects. Among the side effects observed after using this peptide are headaches, nausea, increased blood pressure, or mild muscle pain.

It is important to note that these discomforts are infrequent and may occur if the recommended doses are not respected and this peptide is abused. To avoid the side effects of Melanotan 2, it is mandatory to follow the recommended dose.

description: A formula for cellular protection, mitochondrial support, and longevity – delivered in a pre-mixed, convenient and precise pen. What is Longevity Pen? Longevity Pen | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a unique, stabilized formula developed with scientific precision and intended for research u
bodyHtml:
A formula for cellular protection, mitochondrial support, and longevity – delivered in a pre-mixed, convenient and precise pen.

What is Longevity Pen?

Longevity Pen | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a unique, stabilized formula developed with scientific precision and intended for research use in mitochondrial biology, redox balance, and cellular longevity. This synergistic combination targets key molecular mechanisms associated with aging and cellular degeneration – including oxidative stress, decreased energy metabolism, and impaired DNA repair.

Each pen contains a precisely dosed blend of Glutathione (600mg) – the body’s primary endogenous antioxidant, Resveratrol (500mg) – an epigenetic modulator activating SIRT1, and NAD+ (100mg) – a vital coenzyme for mitochondrial and cellular function. The formula is pre-mixed and distributed across 300 units of 4mg each, enabling controlled and accurate dosing for research protocols. The pen format ensures ingredient stability, ease of use, and measurement accuracy, making Longevity Pen ideal for protocols focused on cellular rejuvenation and maintaining optimal cellular health – with balanced redox, sufficient energy, and effective repair mechanisms that slow aging and support systemic vitality.

What makes the Longevity Pen formula unique?

Longevity Pen delivers three-phase synergistic support targeting:

  • Detoxification and neutralization of oxidative stress (Glutathione)
  • Activation of longevity-related genes (Resveratrol / SIRT1 activation)
  • Support of cellular energy metabolism and mitochondrial function (NAD+)

This formula not only combines essential molecules for cellular health, but delivers them in a way that allows uniform, sustained, and directed research application.

Core ingredients and mechanism of action

Glutathione (600mg)

Glutathione is the most important endogenous antioxidant. It neutralizes free radicals, regenerates other antioxidants, and plays a central role in phase II liver detoxification. Higher glutathione levels have been linked to enhanced immune response, improved recovery from cellular stress, and increased general cellular resilience.

Resveratrol (500mg)

Resveratrol is a polyphenol shown to activate the SIRT1 gene – linked to cellular stress resistance and extended lifespan in research models. It also has antioxidant effects, supports circulation, and shows potential in modulating inflammatory responses.

NAD+ (100mg)

Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide is a critical coenzyme for mitochondrial function and Sirtuin enzyme activity. NAD+ levels decline with age, resulting in decreased cellular energy, impaired DNA repair, and accelerated aging. Maintaining or boosting NAD+ levels is associated with improved cellular rejuvenation, efficient regeneration, and energy homeostasis.

Synergistic effect of Longevity Pen

The combination of Glutathione, Resveratrol, and NAD+ in Longevity Pen is a targeted formula where each component not only supports but enhances the biological action of the others, creating a highly effective synergy at the cellular level.

  • Glutathione acts as the first line of defense against oxidative stress by neutralizing reactive oxygen species (ROS), which can damage mitochondrial function and accelerate cellular aging. Stable redox balance maintained by glutathione is essential for all cellular compartments, including DNA integrity.
  • Resveratrol activates the SIRT1 gene, which relies directly on NAD+ availability. This relationship forms a positive feedback loop: Resveratrol boosts the efficiency of NAD+-dependent enzymes, which regulate cell regeneration, apoptosis, and energy metabolism.
  • NAD+ acts as a metabolic catalyst essential for ATP production and activation of key DNA-repair enzymes like PARP and the Sirtuin family. Enhanced mitochondrial activity supported by NAD+ is made possible thanks to the antioxidant protection provided by Glutathione.

This triple biochemical link creates a self-sustaining cycle of regeneration, protection, and cellular rejuvenation – designed to optimize the cellular environment and extend functional cell lifespan.

Potential benefits supported by scientific research

In research settings, Longevity Pen has demonstrated potential for:

  • Improving mitochondrial function and cellular energy metabolism
  • Slowing down markers of cellular aging
  • Reducing oxidative stress and inflammation
  • Supporting DNA repair processes
  • Enhancing liver function and general immune health

Dosage and use in research protocols

  • 1 unit = 4mg
  • Total: 300 units per pen
  • Suggested protocol for research: 20 units per day for 15 consecutive days, followed by a 15-day pause

Shake the pen gently for about 10–15 seconds before use within your research.In some products, you may notice fine visible particles in the solution — this is not a cause for concern.These particles are due to the fact that the molecules are encapsulated in a protective lipid or polymer coating, designed to provide stability, prevent degradation, and allow controlled release of the active substance.

The Longevity Pen formula is designed for systemic use in research settings and does not require localized application.

Longevity Pen – Premium class in scientific bioregeneration

With its unique combination of antioxidant protection, mitochondrial activation, and epigenetic modulation, Longevity Pen stands out as a top choice in modern research focused on anti-aging biology and cellular longevity.
