bodyHtml:
What is Livagen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala)?

Livagen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala) is a peptide bioregulator primarily designed to support and enhance healthy liver function. Bioregulators are biologically active substances that regulate metabolic processes in various organs and systems of the body.

Livagen peptide is formulated to match specific peptide sequences found in the liver, with its Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala sequence selected for its ability to interact with the liver and support its functions.

The liver plays a crucial role in numerous biological functions, including processing and detoxifying substances that enter the body, regulating metabolic processes, and producing bilirubin, which aids in the breakdown of old red blood cells.

Livagen peptide is laboratory-manufactured and intended to support liver function, ensuring optimal metabolic activity and overall well-being.

What are the benefits of Livagen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala)?

Livagen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala) is a peptide bioregulator specifically developed to support healthy liver function. Here are some of the key benefits it offers:

  • Improved Liver Function: Livagen supports the liver, helping it perform its essential functions more efficiently.
  • Support for Substance Metabolism: Livagen facilitates the metabolism of various substances in the body, aiding in the conversion of nutrients into energy.
  • Detoxification Support: The liver plays a crucial role in purifying the body from toxins, and Livagen peptide helps optimize this process.
  • Healthy Bile Function Support: The liver produces bile, which assists in fat digestion, and Livagen peptide supports bile production and release.
  • Regulation of Cholesterol Levels: Livagen peptide helps maintain normal cholesterol levels by supporting fat metabolism.
  • Tissue Regeneration Facilitation: The liver has a unique ability to regenerate, and Livagen helps enhance this process.
  • General Health Maintenance: A healthy liver is essential for overall health and well-being, and taking Livagen peptide helps maintain liver function.
  • Support for Healthy Digestion: The liver plays a key role in digestion, including converting food into energy, and Livagen supports these processes.

Possible side effects of Livagen peptide (Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala)

There are no known reports of negative side effects.

Proper use and dosage of Livagen (Lys-Glu-Asp-Ala)

The recommended dosage for this peptide is 20 units per day (2 mg). One pen lasts for 10 doses or 10 days.

name: Ligandrol (LGD-4033) | 40mg/1,5ml
description: What is Ligandrol (LGD-4033)? Ligandrol, also known as LGD-4033, is a potent selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed for research purposes on muscle growth, strength and bone density maintenance. It is considered one of the most effective compounds in its class, es
bodyHtml:
What is Ligandrol (LGD-4033)?

Ligandrol, also known as LGD-4033, is a potent selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed for research purposes on muscle growth, strength and bone density maintenance. It is considered one of the most effective compounds in its class, especially when looking for a significant increase in muscle mass in a short period of time.

LGD-4033 is designed to provide intense anabolic action while maintaining high tissue selectivity. This means that it primarily affects muscle and bone tissue without affecting other sensitive organs and systems. Due to this focus, Ligandrol is often used in research settings for conditions such as sarcopenia, muscle atrophy and other forms of tissue loss.

Ligandrol (LGD-4033) Mechanism of Action:

Ligandrol works by binding to androgen receptors, activating pathways related to protein synthesis and nitrogen retention – key processes for building muscle tissue. At the same time, it supports bone mineral density, which contributes to structural stability and resistance to physical exertion.

Unlike testosterone and other androgen preparations, LGD-4033 does not convert to estrogens, does not retain water, and does not cause hormonal fluctuations. This makes it especially valuable for research purposes when a strong anabolic response is sought without the typical side effects of steroids.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of Ligandrol (LGD-4033):

Research done with Ligandrol (LGD-4033) has demonstrated impressive results related to:

  • Significant increase in muscle mass and physical strength;
  • Improved tissue recovery after training or exercise;
  • Maintenance of muscle volume during caloric deficit or immobilization;
  • Enhanced bone density, making it suitable for patterns associated with bone loss;

Ligandrol is often chosen in studies focusing on strength parameters, functional musculature, and exercise endurance.

Comparison of Ligandrol with other SARMs

Ligandrol (LGD-4033) is often regarded as one of the most potent and well-studied selective androgen receptor modulators in the SARMs category. This puts it in direct comparison with other popular molecules such as Ostarine (MK2866), Testolone (RAD-140) and S23.

Compared to Ostarine, which is considered milder and more suitable for beginner protocols or long-term use, Ligandrol offers a significantly more pronounced anabolic effect in a shorter time. While Ostarine is excellent for maintaining lean muscle mass, LGD-4033 is preferred in models aiming to actively gain lean muscle mass.

Compared to RAD-140, Ligandrol has demonstrated similar strength and bulking ability, but generally with less risk of neuroendocrine irritation. RAD-140 shows potential activity in the central nervous system as well, while Ligandrol remains more focused on muscle and bone tissue.

Compared to S23, which features very high androgenic activity but also almost inevitable testosterone suppression, Ligandrol provides a more balanced profile – strong but with a lower risk of side effects. Therefore, LGD-4033 is often preferred in research protocols where an optimal balance between potency, safety and recovery is sought.

Dosage and administration of Ligandrol (LGD-4033) in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 4 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 266mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of Ligandrol (LGD-4033):

Despite the high effectiveness of LGD-4033, there are observations of some side effects, especially with long-term use or higher doses:

  • Temporary suppression of natural testosterone;
  • Libido or mood changes in certain research models;
  • Individual sensitivity to androgenic activity.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is Laxogenin?

Laxogenin is a plant steroidal sapogenin extracted from Smilax sieboldii (or other plants of the genus Dioscorea) that has attracted scientific interest for its anabolic potential without hormonal influence. Laxogenin does not affect testosterone levels and does not affect androgen receptors. This makes it suitable for studies that aim to increase muscle mass and improve recovery without causing endocrine suppression.

Due to its natural origin and low risk of systemic loading, Laxogenin is used in studies focused on safe muscle maintenance, improved physical function and regeneration.

Mechanism of action of Laxogenin:

Laxogenin exhibits activity through modulation of protein synthesis at the cellular level, without direct interaction with hormone receptors. It is said to affect pathways related to muscle fiber growth and cellular protection, especially in states of stress, exercise or recovery.

Effects similar to anabolic agents have been observed without causing side effects such as hormone suppression, water retention, or changes in estrogen and testosterone levels. This mechanism makes it particularly suitable for long-term protocols and research programs where mild but sustained anabolic activity is required.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of Laxogenin:

Laxogenin is seen as an interesting alternative to more intense compounds, especially in cases where a gentler but effective approach to physical optimization is sought. Its potential benefits include:

  • Improvement of muscle mass and tone, without hormonal changes;
  • Accelerated muscle recovery after exercise;
  • Maintaining strength and endurance in conditions of dieting or high volume training;
  • Increased resistance to physical and cellular stress;
  • Improved adaptation of the body to training regimes;
  • Formula for subcutaneous application, without burdening the digestive system and with optimal absorption.

These characteristics position Laxogenin as an appropriate choice in research aimed at safely improving body composition, recovery and athletic performance.

Dosage and administration of Laxogenin in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 12 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 33.33mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of Laxogenin:

Laxogenin is considered a compound with a good tolerability profile, however mild and individually dependent reactions have been observed:

  • Rare changes in mood or sleep seen with longer use;
  • Minimal stomach upsets, in oral forms (not applicable to the subcutaneous version);
  • Individual variations in effectiveness, according to the purpose of the study.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is KPV?

KPV is a synthetic peptide composed of three amino acids: lysine (K), proline (P), and valine (V), each with specific chemical and biological properties that contribute to the overall activity of the peptide. This peptide is a fragment of the alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH) and has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties.

What is ISRIB (Integrated Stress Response Inhibitor)?

ISRIB (Integrated Stress Response Inhibitor) is one of the latest advancements in the world of nootropic supplements, promising to revolutionize the way we approach brain health and cognitive functions. ISRIB is a small-molecule compound that acts as an inhibitor of the integrated stress response (ISR) in cells. The integrated stress response is a complex cellular mechanism activated in response to various stress conditions, such as oxygen deprivation or DNA damage. This mechanism helps cells adapt by temporarily halting protein synthesis and activating repair processes.

ISRIB (Integrated Stress Response Inhibitor) has been studied for its potential application in treating various conditions, including neurological disorders and brain injuries. Research suggests that it can enhance cognitive function and aid in recovery after brain damage. Its mechanism of action primarily involves restoring normal endoplasmic reticulum function and normalizing protein synthesis in cells, which may lead to improved cellular function and recovery from stress.

  • Immune System Modulation: ISRIB (Integrated Stress Response Inhibitor) could have potential applications in immune system regulation, which may be useful in treating autoimmune diseases and controlling inflammatory processes.

What is Ipamorelin?

Ipamorelin is a synthetic peptide, part of the GHRH (Growth Hormone Releasing Hormones) group of peptides, which act as agonists of the growth hormone receptors. Ipamorelin is used to stimulate the production of growth hormone (GH).

The synthetic peptide Ipamorelin is similar to natural growth hormone, but unlike other GHRH peptides, it does not cause high levels of hyperglycemia - glucose concentration in the blood.

Ipamorelin stimulates the production of growth hormone in the body by binding to the GHRH receptors on the lower right front part of the pituitary gland. Through this action, this peptide helps reduce body fat, improve sleep quality, strengthen bones and joints, and leads to muscle mass growth.

Ipamorelin is used by athletes who, through its consumption, improve their overall physical form and sporting achievements. In addition to this effect, the peptide is also applied in medicine to treat various diseases such as chronic kidney failure and diseases related to low levels of growth hormone.

What are the benefits of the Ipamorelin Peptide?

What is IGF1LR3?

IGF 1LR3 is a form of Insulin-like Growth Factor 1 (IGF-1) that has been modified to prolong the molecule,s lifespan. This modification is called "LR3" because 13 amino acids are added at the end of the molecule, thanks to this modification.

IGF 1 LR3, similar in structure to the naturally occurring IGF-1 in the body, plays an extremely important role in the growth and development of cells in the body. IGF 1 LR3 has a more potent action than natural IGF-1 because it prolongs the molecule and has a more lasting effect in the body. It stimulates the growth of muscles, bones, and other tissues, and aids in their recovery.

IGF1 LR3 affects cells through specific receptors, activating intracellular signalling pathways. This action helps increase protein synthesis, improves glucose absorption, and stimulates cell division.

IGF-1LR3 is commonly used by athletes and bodybuilders, as it has anabolic properties, contributing to increased muscle mass, endurance, and faster recovery after workouts.

What are the benefits of IGF 1 LR3 Peptide?

bodyHtml:
What is Ibutamoren (MK-677)?

Ibutamoren, also known as MK-677, is a compound that acts as a ghrelin receptor agonist and growth hormone (GH) secretion stimulator. Unlike SARMs, Ibutamoren does not interact with androgen receptors, but instead mimics the action of the hormone ghrelin and activates the pituitary gland, leading to increased secretion of growth hormone and IGF-1 (insulin-like growth factor).

The compound is the subject of intensive research aimed at improving sleep, increasing muscle mass, supporting recovery processes and maintaining youth in various physiological conditions. MK677 is a popular choice when the goal is to increase the activity of the GH–IGF-1 axis.

Mechanism of action of Ibutamoren (MK677):

Ibutamoren stimulates growth hormone secretion by activating ghrelin receptors (GHS-R) in the hypothalamus and pituitary gland. This leads to a natural increase in GH and IGF-1 levels in the body, which activates processes such as protein synthesis, cell repair and tissue regeneration.

MK677 does not disrupt cortisol or other hormone levels and has the advantage of sustainably maintaining high growth hormone levels for 24 hours. Due to this characteristic, it is preferred for research purposes aimed at recovery, regeneration and anti-aging protocols.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of Ibutamoren (MK677):

Based on research and observations, Ibutamoren shows the following potential benefits:

  • Stimulate growth hormone and IGF-1 naturally;
  • Increase in muscle mass and density, even without changing the training regime;
  • Improved recovery of tissues and tendons;
  • Better quality and depth of sleep, through the influence on sleep phases;
  • Potentially improved bone density and locomotor function;
  • Preservation of lean musculature in caloric deficit or old age.

MK677 is a preferred molecule for protocols aimed at regeneration, hormonal maintenance and optimization of recovery in various physiological conditions.

Comparison of Ibutamoren (MK677) with other SARMs

Ibutamoren (MK677) is often placed in the same category as SARMs due to its use in research protocols for muscle growth and recovery, but it is not technically a SARM. Instead, MK677 is a ghrelin receptor agonist that stimulates the natural release of growth hormone (GH) and IGF-1 without interacting with androgen receptors. This makes it unique compared to molecules like Ligandrol (LGD-4033), Testolone (RAD-140) and Ostarine (MK2866).

Compared to Ligandrol, which acts directly on androgen receptors to increase muscle mass, MK677 works by increasing growth hormone, resulting in slower but more complete recovery, improved sleep and support for tissue regeneration. While LGD-4033 is preferred for aggressive muscle building, MK677 is used for long-term support and hormonal stabilization.

Compared to RAD-140, which provides a strong anabolic effect and short-term muscle response, MK677 acts more gently, but enhances recovery, sleep and supports tendons, skin and joints through IGF-1 activation. It does not lead to testosterone suppression and can be used in extended research cycles without the need for hormone balance afterwards.

Compared to Ostarine, which is also used for muscle maintenance, MK677 has a broader effect – not only on muscle, but also on sleep, bone density and overall recovery. While MK2866 acts at the receptor level in muscle, MK677 stimulates the entire GH–IGF-1 endocrine axis.

Ibutamoren is often combined with other compounds in research models when aiming for more complete regeneration, improved sleep and hormonal balance, without aggressive androgenic stimulation.

Dosage and administration of Ibutamoren (MK677) in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 7 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 333mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of Ibutamoren (MK-677):

Despite the good tolerability profile, there are observations of some side effects, especially with prolonged use or higher doses:

  • Increased appetite, characteristic of the activation of ghrelin receptors;
  • Mild water retention, especially at higher doses;
  • Transient fatigue or sleepiness when starting the protocol.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

  • Speeds Up Recovery: Enhances post-workout recovery, reducing fatigue and improving muscle repair after physical exertion.
  • Strengthens the Immune System: HCG plays a role in the production of T-cells, contributing to a stronger immune response.
  • Enhances Female Fertility: HCG improves fertility in women by stimulating ovulation and supporting ovarian function.
  • Improves Sperm Quality: HCG enhances sperm production and motility, increasing male fertility.
  • Used in Medical Treatments: HCG is prescribed for conditions like cryptorchidism, hypogonadism, and some types of cancer, helping to regulate hormonal imbalances and alleviate specific medical conditions.

Clinical trials of HCG Choriomon 5000 IU and their results:

A study published in The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism by Oxford Academic is a double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized trial examining the impact of HCG Choriomon on muscle strength and physical function in adult men with partial androgen deficiency due to aging. Participants in the study received a dose of 250 μg (5000 IU) of HCG Choriomon twice per week.

The primary objective was to determine whether HCG Choriomon could increase muscle strength, particularly in the knee and shoulder areas, while improving overall physical function and activity levels. The study focused on men over 60 years old with testosterone levels below a specific threshold.

Participants were divided into two groups: one received the actual dose of HCG Choriomon, while the other received a placebo. Muscle strength measurements were conducted using dynamometry, a method for assessing strength in specific muscle groups. Additionally, other physical function indicators such as balance, mobility, and overall activity levels were evaluated.

Clinical trials involving HCG Choriomon for treating low testosterone levels have demonstrated that this method effectively increases testosterone levels in the body. This is particularly useful for men with low testosterone due to hypothalamic, pituitary, or testicular dysfunction.

The clinical trial results show improvements in testosterone levels and related symptoms in men. These symptoms may include reduced sexual desire, lower energy levels, mood disturbances, decreased muscle mass, and loss of strength, among others.

Proper administration and dosage of HCG Choriomon 5000 IU:

The dosage and method of administration of HCG Choriomon (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) depend on several factors, including the purpose of administration, individual needs, and the person's health condition.

Generally, the Choriomon 5000 pen is administered in doses of 1000 IU (20 units) every two days. Since one Choriomon 5000 pen contains 100 units, it is sufficient for five administrations of 1000 IU each.

When Choriomon 5000 IU is used as therapy for certain medical conditions, the dosage may vary depending on the specific treatment being administered.

Possible side effects of Choriomon 5000:

HCG Choriomon is a medicinal product with proven effectiveness in stimulating ovulation in women and treating certain conditions in men. Like any medication, some side effects may occur.

One of the most commonly reported side effects of HCG Choriomon use includes pain at the injection site, headaches, and breast tenderness. These side effects are generally observed when the recommended administration guidelines are not followed.

HCG Choriomon 5000 has been proven to be effective and safe for use when the recommended dosage and administration period are followed under specialist supervision.

name: GW0742 | 50mg/1,5ml
description: What is GW0742? GW0742 is a synthetic peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPAR-δ) agonist investigated as a potential regulator of metabolic and energy processes. Structurally related to GW501516, GW0742 exhibits higher selectivity and affinity for PPAR-δ, making it
bodyHtml:
What is GW0742?

GW0742 is a synthetic peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPAR-δ) agonist investigated as a potential regulator of metabolic and energy processes. Structurally related to GW501516, GW0742 exhibits higher selectivity and affinity for PPAR-δ, making it a valuable research target targeting the regulation of lipid and glucose metabolism, energy balance, and muscle oxidation. Due to its specific activity, the compound is used in a laboratory environment to analyze molecular mechanisms related to mitochondrial function, metabolic flexibility and physical endurance.

GW0742 Mechanism of Action:

GW0742 binds selectively to PPAR-δ receptors – nuclear receptors involved in the regulation of the expression of genes related to energy metabolism. Activation of these receptors leads to stimulation of fatty acid oxidation, improvement of mitochondrial activity and increase of energy efficiency in muscle tissue. Furthermore, GW0742 modulates glucose homeostasis and affects the lipid profile without directly affecting the hormonal axis. It is this mechanism that makes it particularly interesting in scientific research focused on metabolic diseases, endurance training and energy adaptation.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of GW0742:

GW0742 has been the subject of a number of analyzes in which the following potential effects have been observed:

  • Increased fat burning by stimulating β-oxidation;
  • Increased mitochondrial activity and energy efficiency in muscles;
  • Improved glucose sensitivity and glycemic control;
  • Potentially supporting physical endurance;
  • Anti-inflammatory modulation through regulation of PPAR-δ dependent pathways;
  • Maintaining a healthy lipid profile.

Due to these observations, GW0742 is frequently included in protocols for the study of metabolic disorders, sports physiology and cardiometabolic mechanisms.

Comparison of GW0742 with other SARMs and metabolic agonists

GW0742 is a synthetic PPAR-δ (peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta) agonist that is not a SARM, but is often grouped with them due to its similar use in metabolic regulation, lipid control, and endurance research protocols. It is most commonly compared to Cardarine (GW501516), Stenabolic (SR9009) and sometimes to lighter SARMs such as Ostarine (MK2866) when combined for body recomposition purposes.

Compared to Cardarine, GW0742 has a higher affinity for the PPAR-δ receptor, making it more potent in models investigating fat oxidation and improvement of mitochondrial function. Both molecules promote the use of fat as a primary energy source, but GW0742 is often preferred in more targeted metabolic studies, especially when a more selective effect on energy metabolism in muscle tissue is sought.

Compared to Stenabolic (SR9009), which acts by activating REV-ERBα and affecting circadian rhythms, GW0742 is more focused on the deep regulation of lipid metabolism and glucose homeostasis, without directly affecting the biological clock. While SR9009 improves energy capacity and endurance through mitochondrial activity, GW0742 does so by activating metabolic genes responsible for fatty acid oxidation.

In the context of SARMs such as Ostarine or Ligandrol, which affect muscle mass through androgen receptors, GW0742 stands out as a completely non-hormonal metabolic modulator suitable for studies where the goal is fat burning, improved insulin sensitivity and metabolic flexibility.

Dosage and administration of GW0742 in research protocols:

Recommended study schedule: 5-6 units once daily for 4-6 weeks, followed by a 2-4 week rest period.

1 unit = 333mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of GW0742:

While GW0742 shows promising results, it is important to consider its safety profile. Its observed negative effects include:

  • Changes in lipid metabolism during long-term use;
  • Lack of long-term data on chronic exposure;
  • Adverse interactions with other PPAR-modulating compounds.

Adherence to the optimal dosage and control of the duration of application play a key role in limiting the occurrence of side effects.

description: What is Glutathione + Methylene Blue? Glutathione + Methylene Blue | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a stabilized, high-concentration formula that combines two biologically active molecules with complementary effects – Glutathione (2000mg) and Methylene Blue (30mcg). Each vial contains 300
bodyHtml:
What is Glutathione + Methylene Blue?

Glutathione + Methylene Blue | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a stabilized, high-concentration formula that combines two biologically active molecules with complementary effects – Glutathione (2000mg) and Methylene Blue (30mcg). Each vial contains 300 units, pre-dosed for precise research applications aimed at supporting mitochondrial function, modulating the cellular redox environment, and regulating neurometabolic mechanisms.

Thanks to the pre-mixed and stabilized components, the formula offers high systemic bioavailability, dose consistency, and chemical stability, making it especially suitable for long-term use in systemic protocols requiring reliability in each application cycle.

What makes this formula unique?

The combination of Glutathione – the main endogenous antioxidant – and Methylene Blue – a well-studied redox modulator and mitochondrial electron transporter – represents a dual-level approach to cellular protection and energy metabolism. The formula doesn’t just combine two active ingredients, but is carefully designed to ensure targeted biological synergy that impacts key processes related to cellular function and metabolic balance.

  • Improved cellular redox balance: Glutathione neutralizes free radicals and keeps the antioxidant system in an active state, while Methylene Blue recycles electrons in the mitochondria and prevents excessive ROS production.
  • Support for mitochondrial efficiency and stability: Methylene Blue functions as an alternative electron acceptor in the electron transport chain, especially under cellular stress or mitochondrial dysfunction. Glutathione, in turn, protects the mitochondrial membrane from peroxidation and maintains its integrity.
  • Modulation of neurological and cognitive processes: Methylene Blue demonstrates the ability to cross the blood-brain barrier and enhance brain function by supporting neurotransmitter balance, energy efficiency, and reduction of neuroinflammation—especially in combination with the antioxidant defense provided by Glutathione.
  • Protection from oxidative stress and inflammatory damage: The synergy between the two components allows for simultaneous elimination of accumulated oxidative byproducts and stabilization of the cellular environment, resulting in better cellular adaptation and resilience under external or metabolic stress.

Unlike standard antioxidant products that focus solely on neutralizing free radicals, this formula addresses both the cause (mitochondrial dysfunction) and the consequences (oxidative damage). This makes it functionally more advanced, biochemically more effective, and clinically more promising.

Key Components and Mechanism of Action

Glutathione (2000mg)

Glutathione plays a central role in neutralizing free radicals, regenerating other antioxidants (such as vitamins C and E), and participating in phase II liver detoxification. Studies show that higher glutathione levels are associated with better cellular resilience, immune function, and metabolic regulation, especially under chronic oxidative stress.

Methylene Blue (30mcg)

Methylene Blue is a small molecule that acts as an alternative electron acceptor in the mitochondrial chain, enhancing ATP production, especially in damaged or stressed cells. Additionally, research links it to neuroprotective properties, improved cognitive function, enhanced mitochondrial respiration, and reduced ROS (reactive oxygen species) production.

Synergistic Effect of the Formula

The combination of Glutathione and Methylene Blue is precisely formulated to:

  • Allow Glutathione to provide baseline antioxidant and detoxifying protection
  • Enable Methylene Blue to enhance electron transport and mitochondrial energy efficiency

This dual-component formula promotes sustainable ATP production, reduces inflammatory processes, and supports metabolic adaptation, especially under cellular stress or age-related changes.

Scientifically Supported Potential Benefits

Within research protocols, the Glutathione + Methylene Blue formula may demonstrate potential for:

  • Reducing oxidative stress and cellular damage
  • Improving mitochondrial function and energy metabolism
  • Supporting neurological health and cognitive clarity
  • Regulating inflammatory response and cellular homeostasis
  • Detoxification and recovery after oxidative load

Dosage and Application in Research Protocols

Recommended research protocol: 30 units once daily for 20 days, followed by a 20-day break before resuming the cycle.

Total pen content: 300 units

Shake the shane gently for about 10–15 seconds before use within your research.In some products, you may notice fine visible particles in the solution — this is not a cause for concern.These particles are due to the fact that the molecules are encapsulated in a protective lipid or polymer coating, designed to provide stability, prevent degradation, and allow controlled release of the active substance.

The formula is intended for systemic use in research protocols and does not require localized application.

name: GHRP 6 | 5mg
description: What is GHRP6? GHRP6 is part of the group of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) peptides and stimulates the release of growth hormone (GH). In medicine, it is used for various health issues related to low levels of growth hormone. The peptide GHRP6 is popular among athletes
bodyHtml:
What is GHRP6?

GHRP6 is part of the group of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) peptides and stimulates the release of growth hormone (GH). In medicine, it is used for various health issues related to low levels of growth hormone.

The peptide GHRP6 is popular among athletes as a doping agent because it contributes to muscle mass increase, aids in fat reduction, and improves overall physical indicators.

GHRP6 acts as an agonist of ghrelin receptors in the pituitary gland of the brain, which helps in the release of growth hormone from the anterior part of the pituitary. It has low affinity for somatostatin receptors, which enhances its effectiveness in stimulating the release of growth hormone.

GHRP-6 increases protein synthesis in muscle cells, aids in faster recovery after training, and improves cardiovascular function, contributing to better muscle mass and physical indicators. The use of this peptide also improves sleep quality.

What are the benefits of GHRP 6?

GHRP6 (Growth Hormone-Releasing Peptide-6) is a peptide hormone responsible for stimulating the growth and development of growth hormone by the pituitary. It helps in fat reduction, improves metabolism, and regulates carbohydrates in the body. The benefits of using the GHRP6 peptide include:

  • GHRP6 helps increase endurance, improves cardiovascular function, aids in muscle mass increase, and leads to an improvement in overall physical indicators during training.
  • The GHRP6 peptide aids in burning fats more easily, reducing lipogenesis in the body.
  • It helps in improving bone density and healing, reducing the risk of osteoporosis.
  • This peptide improves sleep quality, increasing its duration and helping to sleep more peacefully, reducing the sensation of fatigue and stress.
  • The GHRP6 peptide improves mood, reduces anxiety, and aids in combating depression.
  • GHRP 6 participates in enhancing the immune system, stimulating the production of immune cells, and improving immune function.
  • It stimulates muscle mass increase and helps the body recover more quickly after physical exertion.

Clinical Trials of GHRP6 and its results:

The peptide GHRP6 stimulates the release of growth hormone by the pituitary, making it popular among athletes as a doping agent. In medicine, it is used as treatment for various diseases and management of different health issues.

In a clinical trial with diabetic patients, it was found that the application of GHRP6 improves glucose metabolism and reduces insulin resistance.

In another clinical trial with participants diagnosed with pulmonary insufficiency, the effect of GHRP6 was observed over six months on respiratory function, reporting an improvement in their oxygen metabolism and an increase in their physical endurance.

Currently, clinical trials are being conducted with patients with cardiovascular diseases and brain traumas, showing to date a positive impact on patients by the application of GHRP6.

Correct Administration and Dosage of GHRP6:

The correct administration and dosage of GHRP6 depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered at 400mcg per day (divided into two doses of 200μg).

The correct dose of GHRP6 is 8 units in the morning and 8 units at night.

Additional instructions for use: Adjust the pen dispenser by turning it to 8 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the dispenser) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The cycle duration with this peptide is 4 to 6 months.

A pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

A GHRP6 (5mg) pen will be sufficient for approximately 13-15 days depending on the daily dose.

Examples of calculated units from the GHRP-6 (5mg) pen equivalent to micrograms:

1 unit = 25mcg; 4 units = 100mcg; 6 units = 150mcg; 8 units = 200mcg; 10 units = 250mcg.

What other peptides can GHRP6 be combined with?

GHRP-6 (Growth Hormone-Releasing Peptide-6) is a peptide that also stimulates the release of growth hormone by the pituitary. When combined with other peptides, it can enhance its effect on muscle growth, fat reduction, and general health status. Here are some peptides with which GHRP6 can be combined:

  • CJC-1295 No DAC - This combination is popular because GHRP-6 stimulates the release of growth hormone by the pituitary, while CJC-1295 No DAC enhances this process. This can lead to a significant increase in growth hormone levels, resulting in better results in terms of muscle mass and fat loss.
  • Ipamorelin - This peptide is also a growth hormone stimulator and is often used in combination with GHRP-6. Combining them can complement and enhance the effects of GHRP-6 on muscle growth and fat reduction.
  • IGF1-LR3 (Insulin-like Growth Factor 1 Long Arginine 3) - An anabolic peptide associated with the stimulation of cell growth, including muscles. Combining it with GHRP-6 can increase the anabolic effects and enhance muscle growth.
  • Sermorelin - A peptide that stimulates the pituitary to release growth hormone. The combination can improve the effects on muscle growth, endurance, and recovery.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of GHRP6:

GHRP6 is used both in sports as doping and in the treatment of various diseases. It is safe and effective for use, but incorrect dosing and the use of excessive amounts can cause some side effects.

The most common side effects of the application of GHRP6 are related to pain, irritation, or redness at the injection site. These symptoms are not dangerous and disappear within a few days.

Other observed side effects from the use of GHRP6 include headaches, nausea, increased appetite, and increased body weight. These symptoms are also not dangerous and do not require special treatment, but should be recorded in the patient,s medical history.

Use of GHRP6 in sports:

Many athletes use GHRP6 to improve physical indicators and increase muscle mass. It is commonly used to achieve the following objectives:

  • Increase in muscle mass.
  • Improvement of endurance.
  • Acceleration of glycogen recharging.
  • Reduction of fats.
  • Improvement of sleep.
  • Acceleration of recovery.

bodyHtml:
What is GHRP 2?

GHRP 2 is a synthetic peptide that stimulates the release of growth hormone (GH) from the anterior part of the pituitary gland in the brain. It is part of the growth hormone-releasing peptide (GHRPs) family, acting on the G protein-coupled receptor and increasing growth hormone production.

GHRP 2, also known as "pralmorelin," was developed to treat GH deficiencies, but its effectiveness in increasing muscle mass and improving endurance has also made it popular among athletes.

GHRP 2 is part of the ghrelin peptide group, which is responsible for increasing appetite. This makes this peptide also useful for people who want to increase their body weight.

What are the benefits of GHRP 2?

The use of the GHRP 2 peptide offers many benefits to the body and health, the most common being:

  • GHRP2 leads to an increase in muscle mass by stimulating the production of growth hormone.
  • The GHRP 2 growth hormone-stimulating peptide helps reduce body fat.
  • Improves sleep quality by reducing feelings of stress and anxiety and enhancing the feeling of calm during sleep.
  • GHRP2 improves oxygen metabolism and increases the energy the body uses during exercise and workouts, thus increasing the body,s endurance.
  • GHRP 2 stimulates growth hormone, which leads to the strengthening of the body,s immune function, increasing the body,s resistance to infections and diseases.
  • GHRP2, by stimulating growth hormone, helps in the rapid healing of injuries, burns, and bruises.
  • It stimulates collagen production in the body, thus improving skin, hair, and nails.
  • The peptide improves brain functions, memory, concentration, and generally acts positively on cognitive functions.
  • GHRP 2 helps reduce inflammation levels in the body and facilitates the healing of joints and muscles.
  • Accelerates metabolism, aiding in the burning and reduction of body fats, which in turn improves the figure.

Clinical trials of GHRP 2 and their results:

GHRP 2 is a peptide used as a component in various products to increase growth hormone. Its efficacy and safety have been established through several clinical trials.

The results of a clinical trial demonstrate that the use of GHRP2 leads to a significant increase in growth hormone production in the body.

Other studies show that GHRP2 has a positive impact on endurance, immune function, sleep quality, and overall quality of life. The use of GHRP2 offers significant health and physical capacity benefits to its users.

Correct administration and dosage of GHRP2:

The correct administration and dosage of GHRP 2 depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered at 400mcg per day (divided into two doses of 200mcg).

The correct dose of GHRP 2 is 8 units in the morning and 8 units at night.

Additional instructions for use: Adjust the pen doser to 8 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the doser) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The duration of the cycle with this peptide is 4 to 6 months.

A pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

A GHRP-2 pen (5mg) will be sufficient for approximately 13-15 days depending on the daily dosage.

Examples of calculated units of the GHRP2 pen (5mg) equivalent to micrograms:

1 unit = 25mcg; 4 units = 100mcg; 6 units = 150mcg; 8 units = 200mcg; 10 units = 250mcg.

What other peptides can GHRP-2 be combined with?

GHRP 2 (Growth Hormone-Releasing Peptide-2) is a peptide that stimulates the release of growth hormone by the pituitary gland. When combined with other peptides, it can enhance its effect on muscle growth, fat reduction, and general health status. Here are some peptides with which GHRP2 can be combined:

  • Ipamorelin - A peptide that stimulates the release of growth hormone by the pituitary gland. Combining it with GHRP2 can complement and enhance the effects of growth hormone, aiding in muscle growth and fat reduction.
  • IGF1-LR3 (Insulin-Like Growth Factor 1 Long Arginine 3) - Combining GHRP2 with IGF1-LR3 can increase muscle growth and improve overall health. IGF1-LR3 is a potent anabolic peptide produced as a result of the action of growth hormone and can complement the effects of GHRP2.
  • Sermorelin - The combination can enhance the effects of GH on muscle mass, endurance, and recovery processes. This combination can also complement their effects on fat loss and improving overall health status.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of GHRP 2:

Every pharmaceutical product or supplement, along with all the health benefits and overall well-being of the person, may cause some side effects when consumed.

Some of the most common adverse reactions from the use of GHRP-2 are manifested in headaches, nausea, vomiting, muscle and joint pains, increased appetite, and redness of the skin at the injection area. These side effects are extremely rare and usually disappear within a few days.

With correct administration and adherence to the recommended dosage, GHRP 2 is safe to use, and side effects do not manifest.

Use of GHRP2 in sport:

GHRP2 is used to improve physical indicators in professional sports and increase muscle mass. It can raise the levels of growth hormone (GH), which is a key factor for muscle development and endurance.

The use of GHRP 2 can achieve faster results and observe an increase in muscle mass, improved endurance, and recovery speed after training.

In addition, GHRP2 can help burn fats, especially in the abdominal area, which can be beneficial for athletes who need strong and healthy muscles, but at the same time must maintain low body fat levels.

bodyHtml:
Gc MAF (Gc Protein derived Macrophage Activating Factor)

The treatment with GcMAF is an effective method for strengthening the immune system, based on the activation of macrophages. Approaching treatment for bacterial and viral infections, autism, and autoimmune diseases. This innovative therapy is geared towards stimulating the body's natural defense mechanisms, enabling macrophages to actively identify and eliminate cancer cells and other pathologically changed cells. Through this approach, GcMAF aids the fight against diseases on a cellular level, offering promising perspectives for the treatment of various types of cancer and improving overall health condition.

What is Gc-MAF (Macrophage Activating Factor)?

GcMAF, known as a macrophage activating factor derived from Gc protein, is a key natural substance in the human body, prompting macrophages to attack cancer cells and invasive agents such as bacteria and viruses. Significant health issues like cancer, HIV, and viral hepatitis can lead to a depletion of GcMAF, thus weakening the immune system's defenses and facilitating the unchecked spread of diseases. This substance plays a vital role in maintaining immune balance, helping to neutralize pathogens and malignant cells, which is critically important for disease prevention in the body.

How does Gc MAF work?

Activation of Macrophages: GcMAF stimulates macrophages – a type of white blood cells that devour and destroy cancer cells, viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. This enhances the immune system’s ability to identify and eliminate harmful agents.

Enhancement of Immune Response: Through the activation of macrophages, GcMAF facilitates the enhancement of the overall immune response of the body. This includes increasing the production of antibodies and other vital cytokines, which aid in combating infections and preventing the spread of diseases.

Regulation of the Immune System: GcMAF assists in restoring the balance in the immune system, which is especially important in autoimmune diseases and chronic conditions where the immune system may react excessively or inadequately.

Acceleration of Recovery: It aids the healing process in the body after infections or other diseases, speeding up the elimination of pathogens and the restoration of affected tissues.

Synergy with Other Therapies: Gc MAF can be used in combination with other types of treatment, such as targeted therapies, without diminishing their effectiveness. In some cases, it can even enhance their action by improving the immune response of the organism.

It is important to note that while there are encouraging data on the potential of Gc-MAF, the scientific community continues to research its effectiveness and safety in various diseases. For this reason, therapy with GcMAF should be undertaken under the supervision of a qualified medical specialist.

What are the main goals of the therapy with GcMAF?

  • Improving the well-being and quality of life.
  • Restoring the patient to a better health condition, enabling engagement in regular activities.
  • Enhancing the effects of other therapies.
  • Restoring the immune system.
  • Increasing the number of monocytes (macrophages) and their activation to destroy cancer cells, viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens in the body.
  • Accelerating the process of maturation of dendritic cells.

For which conditions can Gc-MAF therapy be beneficial?

  • Cancerous Diseases: GcMAF stimulates macrophages to identify and destroy cancer cells, which can help in preventing the spread of cancer and support the effectiveness of other therapies.
  • Viral Infections: The therapy is used to combat viral diseases such as HIV and hepatitis, enhancing the body's ability to fight viruses.
  • Chronic Infections: It may improve responses of the immune system in chronic bacterial and viral infections, which traditional treatments struggle to control.
  • Autoimmune Diseases: Gc-MAF is being investigated for its potential to regulate the immune system and to reduce inflammation in autoimmune conditions, although further studies are needed.
  • Neurological Diseases: Preliminary evidence suggests that Gc MAF can improve neurological functions in conditions like autism and chronic fatigue, aiding in restoring normal immune function.

It is important to note that while there are promising results in some studies, the efficacy and safety of GcMAF are still being researched, and therapy should only be undertaken after consultation with a qualified medical specialist.

Administration and Dosage of Gc-MAF:

One unit of a 3600 ng pen is equal to 12 ng. One unit of a 6000 ng pen is equal to 20 ng. One unit of a 12000 ng pen is equal to 40 ng. Storage conditions: Between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.

Dosage and administration for autism:

First week: 300 ng. 3 times per week.
From the second week until the end of treatment: 600–700 ng. 3 times per week.
Duration of intake: 6 months.
The dose can be increased to 1200–1500 ng depending on the patient’s immune responses.
To be combined with VITAMIN D3 from 2000 IU to 10000 IU daily.

Dosage and administration for cancer patients:

First week: 300 ng. 2 times per week.
Second week: 600–700 ng. 2 times per week.
From the third week until the end of treatment: Between 1200 ng and 1500 ng. 2 times per week.
To be combined with VITAMIN D3 from 2000 IU to 10000 IU daily.

Examples: 300 ng = 25 units ; 600 ng = 50 units ; 1200 ng = 100 units

name: Exosomes from Muse MSC Stem Cells, Derived from Placenta (Wharton’s Jelly) – 100 Billion
description: What are Exosomes? Exosomes are extracellular vesicles generated by cells, carrying nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, and metabolites. They mediate both short- and long-range intercellular communication in health and disease, influencing various aspects of cellular biology. Exosom
bodyHtml:
What are Exosomes?

Exosomes are extracellular vesicles generated by cells, carrying nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, and metabolites. They mediate both short- and long-range intercellular communication in health and disease, influencing various aspects of cellular biology.

Exosomes are membrane-bound extracellular vesicles that vary in diameter. Research has shown that exosomes are secreted by most cell types, including immune cells (B cells, T cells, mast cells, dendritic cells), neuronal cells, epithelial cells, endothelial cells, embryonic cells, cancer cells, and mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs).

The term “extracellular vesicle (EV)” broadly encompasses several types of vesicles, including exosomes, microvesicles, and apoptotic bodies. However, the term “exosome” specifically refers to vesicles that are formed within multivesicular bodies (MVBs).

Exosomes carry vital information and macromolecules from their cell of origin, playing a crucial role in intercellular communication. These macromolecules include various proteins, enzymes, transcription factors, lipids, extracellular matrix proteins, receptors, and nucleic acids.

Our focus is the production of a pharmaceutical-grade exosome preparation for personalized therapy, compliant with European Regulation No. 726/2004 and Directive No. 2001/83/EC— Exosomes derived from Muse MSC Stem Cells.

All other exosomes derived from blood cells, other cell types, or human fluids have no relevance to regenerative medicine and do not contribute to the self-renewal process. Instead, they carry only laboratory data about ongoing biological processes within the living organism.

Patients should seek treatment with exosomes derived from stem cells, rather than exosomes of unknown origin, to achieve a real therapeutic effect.

The application of exosome therapy is prescribed by a physician and can be administered intravenously, intramuscularly, or subcutaneously. The treatment goals and protocols are determined at the discretion of the treating physician.

What is the stem cell secretome?

In scientific terms, the secretome refers to the collection of all substances secreted by stem cells into the extracellular environment. This includes microvesicles, exosomes, proteins, cytokines (cellular messengers), hormone-like substances, and immunomodulatory factors.

Modern research suggests that the effects of stem cells observed in clinical trials are not solely due to the cells themselves but also to the vesicles, protein molecules, and other bioactive compounds such as cytokines that they release. These substances, secreted into the extracellular space, are collectively referred to as the secretome, as the process of their release is known as secretion. However, which specific components of the secretome drive the actual therapeutic effects remains largely unknown.Our exosomes are derived from donor-derived Muse MSC (mesenchymal stem cells).

Exosomes, averaging 50–100 nanometers in diameter, are a subgroup of extracellular vesicles (EVs). The biogenesis of exosomes begins in endosomes, where interactions with other intracellular vesicles and organelles shape their final molecular composition. Their diverse contents include nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, amino acids, and metabolites, which often reflect their cellular origin.

Exosomes derived from mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have demonstrated therapeutic benefits comparable to cell therapy, particularly in regenerative and neovascularization processes, as well as in their anti-apoptotic, anti-remodeling, and anti-inflammatory effects. Compared to their parent cells, exosomes offer several advantages, including lower immunogenicity and the absence of tumor formation risk. Recently, new strategies have been developed to enhance the efficacy and stability of exosome-based therapies. These include preconditioning exosomes before transplantation, utilizing MSC-derived exosome extracts, and employing exosomes as targeted drug delivery systems.

Exosomes derived from mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) exhibit immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects, which help reduce neural tissue damage. The immunomodulatory effects of MSC-derived exosomes are primarily attributed to the interaction of exosomal miRNAs. These exosomes are capable of transforming macrophages from M0 and M1 phenotypes into the M2 phenotype, which is associated with tissue repair and anti-inflammatory responses. Additionally, MSC-derived exosomes increase the secretion of M2-associated cytokines, such as TGF-β and IL-10, while reducing the levels of M1-associated cytokines, including IL-6, IL-12, and TNF-α.

Over the past few decades, exosomes derived from mesenchymal stem cells (MSC-Exs) have gained significant attention as a therapeutic tool in regenerative medicine. Exosomes are a type of extracellular vesicles (EVs) that play a crucial role in cell-to-cell communication through various processes, including stress response, aging, angiogenesis, cellular differentiation, and signaling.

In summary, MSC - Exosomes can serve as an intelligent drug delivery approach by transporting exogenous chemicals and biomolecules for regenerative medicine, even without the use of stem cells.

MSC - Exosomes have many potential therapeutic advantages compared to synthetic nanoparticles, liposomes, single molecules, and cells. These advantages arise from their unique beneficial properties, such as smaller size, lower complexity, lack of a nucleus (thus preventing neoplastic transformation), enhanced stability, easier production, longer storage, and the potential to be loaded with proteins, small molecules, or RNA for biomolecule delivery.

MSC - Exosomes can also be modified to display various antibodies or surface receptors, facilitating the targeted transfer of therapeutic payloads to specific organs, tissues, and cells. Furthermore, MSC - Exosomes can accommodate multiple types of biological molecules, allowing them to participate in various therapeutic approaches simultaneously, which cannot be achieved with conventional small molecules.

This is why we examine the recent advances in the molecular mechanisms of exosomes in regenerative medicine and exosome research, as well as explore the potential therapeutic applications of exosomes in tissue regeneration following disease recovery, injury, or chronic conditions.

What is exosome therapy?

Exosome therapy involves the use of exosomes—small vesicles—for intravenous, intramuscular, or subcutaneous administration, approved in accordance with European Regulation No. 726/2004 and Directive No. 2001/83/EC.

These exosomes contain a variety of biomolecules, including proteins, nucleic acids, and lipids, which can be used to target specific cells and trigger a desired response. This innovative medical treatment is being explored for various potential applications.

Exosome therapy is gaining increasing popularity, and we are the only provider within the European Union offering the production of medicinal products for personalized treatment, manufactured under European Directive No. 2001/83/EC, specifically for individual patients.

Many medical professionals believe that exosomes hold therapeutic potential, based on research that suggests a link between the health benefits of mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy and exosome-based treatments.

Exosomes are naturally released from mesenchymal stem cells, and MSCs produce the highest quantity of exosomes among all cell types in the human body.

Potential therapeutic applications : 

Stem cells are being researched for their potential use in a wide range of medical treatments, including the repair and regeneration of damaged tissues and organs. Exosomes, on the other hand, are being studied as a delivery system for therapeutic molecules targeting specific cells in the body. They have been proposed as a potential treatment for various conditions, including autoimmune diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, cardiovascular diseases, and many others.

Why is interest in exosome therapy growing?

According to a 2016 study conducted by James R. Edgar and colleagues, an increased interest in exosome therapy can be observed for several reasons : 

Exosomes are believed to provide a means for intercellular communication and the transmission of macromolecules and signals between cells in the human body. 

Exosomes are attributed roles in the distribution of proteins, lipids, mRNA, miRNA, and DNA.

Exosomes are assumed to be useful drug vectors since they are composed of cellular membranes rather than synthetic polymers and, as such, could be tolerated without side effects by the host.

What are exosomes?

Exosomes are nanoparticles derived from cell membranes that contain a rich array of signaling molecules – microRNA, mRNA, lipids, and proteins. They are a natural means of communication between cells and play a key role in maintaining physiological stability.

Scientific research shows that exosomes actively participate in processes related to repair, regeneration, and cellular adaptation to stress factors.

Biological role of exosomes

The main function of exosomes is to transmit molecular signals between different cells and tissues. They can activate regenerative mechanisms, support angiogenesis, and influence the immune system.

Their importance positions them as a key subject of research, covering both regenerative medicine and the processes of cellular aging.

Uniqueness of Muse MSC exosomes

Exosomes from MUSE MSC (Multilineage-differentiating Stress-Enduring Stem Cells) stand out for their resistance to cellular stress and their ability to maintain functional activity even under unfavorable conditions.

Their stable profile positions them as an advanced generation of biological carriers with potential in various areas of precision and personalized therapy. Compared to exosomes from other sources, Muse MSC demonstrate:

  • Higher capacity for cellular regeneration.
  • Improved resistance to oxidative stress.
  • Greater stability in molecular composition.
  • Enhanced efficiency in intercellular communication – providing more precise and targeted transfer of signaling molecules.
  • Richer protein and RNA profile – containing diverse bioactive components essential for regenerative mechanisms.
  • Strong anti-apoptotic potential – supporting cellular resilience and reducing cell death under stress.
  • Broader spectrum of effects – influencing more cellular pathways related to repair and longevity.
  • High biocompatibility – natural origin that minimizes the risk of adverse interactions.

Mechanism of action of exosomes

Exosomes act as mediator nanoparticles that transfer key signaling molecules between cells. Their interaction with the cell surface and intracellular mechanisms occurs in several main ways:

  • Surface receptors – bind to membrane receptors and trigger cascades of signals that regulate processes such as proliferation, differentiation, and repair.
  • Endocytosis – are internalized by cells and release their contents inside, modifying metabolic and genetic mechanisms.
  • Membrane fusion – upon direct contact they transfer their lipids, proteins, and RNA molecules into the cytoplasm of the cell.

Through these pathways, exosomes deliver regulatory factors that can alter gene expression, improve the cellular response to stress, and support regeneration. This mechanism makes them a key tool for maintaining cellular plasticity and tissue repair.

Exosomes and cellular communication

As natural molecular mediators, exosomes maintain coordinated intercellular signaling – a process essential for tissue homeostasis and systemic balance. They play an active role in:

  • Synchronizing cellular responses – coordinating the reactions of different cell populations.
  • Maintaining tissue homeostasis – balancing tissue growth, repair, and degradation.
  • Coordinating repair processes – supporting regeneration in response to damage and stress.

In scientific research, exosome-mediated cellular communication is considered a fundamental basis for future biomedical applications and novel therapeutic approaches.

Key benefits of exosomes according to research

Accumulated scientific data highlight that exosomes – and particularly those derived from Muse MSC (Multilineage-differentiating Stress-Enduring Stem Cells) – demonstrate a wide spectrum of biological effects, making them a valuable tool for studies related to cellular repair, regeneration, and longevity.

  • Regeneration and repair – exosomes support the processes of repairing damaged tissues by transferring signaling molecules that stimulate cellular activity and renewal. This makes them a subject of research in regenerative biology, where mechanisms to activate the body’s natural repair capacities are being sought.
  • Anti-aging potential – one of the most promising directions is their role in slowing cellular aging. By reducing oxidative stress and limiting damage to DNA and proteins, exosomes are studied as a factor capable of maintaining cells in a “functionally younger” state for a longer period of time.
  • Support of cellular longevity – Muse MSC exosomes stand out for their potential to extend the functional lifespan of cells by enhancing their resilience to stressful and unfavorable conditions – a key aspect in longevity research and maintaining cellular health.
  • Immunomodulation – exosomes play a crucial role in maintaining a balanced immune response. They can reduce excessive inflammatory activity while supporting the body’s defense mechanisms. This property is especially valuable in research focused on chronic inflammation and autoimmune reactions.
  • Improved cellular resilience – thanks to their stable composition, Muse MSC exosomes help cells withstand oxidative stress and unfavorable conditions. This is a key factor in studies on aging and longevity.
  • Cellular plasticity and adaptability – exosomes promote the ability of cells to change and adapt to new conditions, which is critical for tissue repair, regeneration, and maintaining a dynamic cellular environment.

Muse MSC exosomes are regarded as molecular mediators of rejuvenation and repair, combining regenerative and anti-aging potential. They open new perspectives for research in the field of cellular health, longevity, and the possibilities of slowing down the biological processes of aging.

bodyHtml:
What is Esafosfina 5g 50ml?

Esafosfina 5g 50ml is a medication intended to be used in infusions, whose main active ingredient is phosphocreatine. This is a compound naturally found in the human body and plays a key role in the process of storing and supplying energy to cells.

In our body, phosphocreatine helps muscles maintain sufficient energy to function effectively, acting as a quick-release energy reservoir. In case of physical exertion, phosphocreatine quickly provides the necessary energy to the muscles.

Esafosfina 5g 50ml is used in medicine to treat conditions related to lack of energy or pathological changes in cells that lead to a phosphocreatine deficit. This medication can help restore the normal energy balance in cells and improve the overall functioning of the body in diseases or conditions that cause a decrease in phosphocreatine levels.

It is important to note that, like any medication, Esafosfina must be administered under the supervision of a qualified medical professional. This ensures that the treatment is appropriate for the specific patient and that any potential side effects are monitored and controlled properly.

What are the benefits of Esafosfina 5g 50ml?

Esafosfina 5g/50ml is a medication with significant benefits related to maintaining and improving the healthy functioning of cells in the body. The main benefits of taking this medication are:

  • Increased energy balance of cells: Phosphocreatine, the main active ingredient of Esafosfina 5g 50ml, plays a key role in the energy metabolism of cells.
  • Improvement of muscle function: Esafosfina 5g/50ml helps to improve the overall functionality of muscles by providing quick-release energy during physical exertion.
  • Support in muscular dystrophy: Esafosfina 5g 50ml can be used in the treatment of muscular dystrophies, where maintaining the energy level in the muscles is important.
  • Aid in heart diseases: Esafosfina can be useful in some heart diseases, where the energy metabolism in cardiac muscle is compromised.
  • Recovery after intense workouts or sports competitions: Esafosfina 5g/50ml can be useful for athletes who want to improve their recovery after intense physical efforts.
  • Management of conditions related to exhaustion: Esafosfina 5g 50ml can help in conditions that lead to general exhaustion or a decrease in energy levels.
  • Maintenance of the health of the nervous system: Phosphocreatine is important for energy metabolism in nerve cells and the intake of Esafosfina can support the functioning of the nervous system.
  • Maintenance of metabolic processes in the body: Esafosfina can help maintain normal metabolic processes in the body.
  • Maintenance of general body health: By improving energy metabolism, Esafosfina can maintain health and general well-being.
  • Improvement of vital functions in chronic diseases: Esafosfina can be used as part of a comprehensive treatment for chronic diseases, helping to maintain energy levels and the overall functioning of cells in the body.

It is important to emphasise that, despite the benefits of Esafosfina, any medication must be taken under medical supervision. Always consult a medical professional before starting a new treatment.

Administration and correct dosage of Esafosfina 5g/50ml:

The Esafosfina 5g/50ml product is an intrusive therapy, which means it is administered via infusion or injection.

Correct dosage: As with all medical products, the dose of Esafosfina 5g/50ml will depend on the specific needs of the patient and the advice of the treating physician. In general, it is recommended that the dose be determined based on the patient's weight and specific situation.

Application: Since Esafosfina is an intrusive therapy, it is generally administered via infusion or injection, which must be performed by qualified medical personnel.

Monitoring of results: When taking Esafosfina 5g/50ml, it is important to regularly review the patient's condition and monitor any changes. If any adverse reaction is observed or if the patient shows no improvement, the doctor may change the dosage or stop the treatment.

Follow the instructions: Esafosfina 5g 50ml must be taken exactly as directed by the treating physician. The patient should not change the dose or the method of administration without prior consent from their health specialist.

Possible side effects of Esafosfina 5g 50ml:

Like any medication, Esafosfina 5g 50ml may cause some side effects. Although they are generally rare and mild, it is important to be informed and consult a medical professional immediately if you notice any unusual symptoms after taking the medication. Here are some of the side effects that may occur:

  • Skin problems: Some patients may experience skin reactions, such as redness, burning sensation, or discomfort at the infusion site.
  • Headache: Some patients report mild headaches after taking Esafosfina 5g 50ml.
  • Nervous symptoms: Rarely, some patients may experience temporary nervous symptoms, such as excitement or nervousness.
  • Irregularities in heart rhythm: In rare cases, Esafosfina may cause mild changes in heart rhythm.
  • Digestive problems: Some patients may experience digestive problems, such as gas or diarrhoea.
  • Fatigue or weakness: In rare cases, Esafosfina may cause a feeling of fatigue or weakness.

If you observe any side effects, it is advisable to consult a medical professional. It is always important to follow the instructions of your health specialist.

bodyHtml:
What is Epitalon?

Epithalon (also known as Epithalon or Epithalon) is a peptide used in anti-aging medicine (ANTI-AGE). It is a synthetic analog of a naturally occurring peptide called Epithalamin, which is produced in the pineal gland of the brain.

Epitalon has been researched for its potential to stimulate telomerase, an enzyme that aids in the maintenance and elongation of telomeres in cells. Telomeres are structures at the ends of chromosomes that protect genetic material and are associated with the ageing process.

Epitalon is believed to have anti-aging and antioxidant effects, although scientific research in this area is still limited and more studies are needed to confirm its effects.

How does Epithalon work?

Epitalon acts by influencing various biological processes at the cellular level, with its main mechanism of action considered to be the stimulation of telomerase production, an enzyme that participates in the maintenance and elongation of telomeres at the ends of chromosomes. Here is a more detailed view of Epitalon,s mechanism of action:

Stimulation of telomerase: Telomeres are protective DNA sequences at the ends of chromosomes that shorten with each cell division, leading to cellular ageing. Epitalon stimulates the activity of telomerase, the enzyme responsible for adding DNA sequences to telomeres, which helps preserve their length and prevent cellular ageing.

Antioxidant effects: Epitalon may have antioxidant properties, meaning it helps reduce oxidative stress in cells caused by free radicals. This can protect cells from damage and improve their overall health.

Regulation of circadian rhythm: Epitalon may influence the circadian rhythm, the body,s internal clock that regulates sleep and wakefulness. This can improve sleep quality and the overall regulation of physiological processes.

Enhancement of immune function: Epithalon may stimulate the immune system, strengthening the body,s ability to fight infections and diseases.

Potential impact on hormonal balance: Epitalon may influence various hormones in the body, helping to maintain hormonal balance and optimise various body functions.

What are the benefits of Epitalon?

Epitalon is the subject of research and discussion in the field of anti-aging medicine (ANTI-AGE), associated with several potential benefits:

  • Telomere elongation: Telomeres are the ends of chromosomes that shorten with each cell division, leading to cellular ageing. Epithalon is supposed to stimulate the activity of telomerase, an enzyme that lengthens telomeres, potentially delaying ageing at the cellular level.
  • Improvement in cellular regeneration: This peptide may stimulate processes that help cells recover and renew, which is important for maintaining the health of various tissues and organs.
  • Anti-aging effects: Through telomere elongation and improved cellular regeneration, Epitalon may help reduce the visible and physiological effects of ageing.
  • Improved sleep: Epitalon may influence the circadian rhythm and improve sleep quality, which is important for overall health and well-being.
  • Antioxidant properties: It may help combat oxidative stress, which is a key factor in the ageing process and the development of chronic diseases.
  • Enhancement of immune function: Epitalon may stimulate and strengthen the immune system, helping the body fight infections and diseases.
  • Reduction of the risk of neurodegenerative diseases: Potential protection of brain cells may reduce the risk of diseases.
  • Protection of the cardiovascular system: May support cardiovascular health by reducing inflammatory processes and improving metabolic functions.
  • Improvement of hormonal balance: Epithalon may have an impact on various hormones in the body, helping to maintain hormonal balance.
  • Reduction of inflammation: Epitalon,s potential anti-inflammatory properties help reduce chronic inflammation, associated with many diseases.

It is important to note that despite these potential benefits, scientific research on Epithalon is still in its early stages and many of the claims about its benefits need deeper studies. Consulting a specialist before its use is recommended.

Administration and correct dosage of Epitalon:

The administration and correct dosage of Epitalon depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered from 3mg to 5mg once a day, although the dose may be increased to 10mg.

The correct dosage of Epitalon is 30 to 50 units per day.

Additional usage instructions: Adjust the pen programmer by turning it from 30 to 50 (1 unit is equivalent to 1 of the divisions on the programmer) and inject into the abdominal area or the front part of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The duration of the cycle with this peptide lasts 15-20 days, followed by a break of about 15 days.

A pen contains 200 units of 100 micrograms.

A pen of Epitalon (20mg) will be sufficient for approximately 5-10 days depending on the daily dosage.

Examples of units calculated from an Epitalon (20mg) pen corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 100mcg; 5 units = 500mcg; 10 units = 1mg; 30 units = 3mg; 40 units = 4mg; 50 units = 5mg.

What other peptides can Epitalon be combined with?

Epitalon is a peptide used to stimulate the length of telomeres in human cells and is associated with ageing processes. When combined with other peptides, synergistic effects can be achieved that enhance the overall health and skin benefits. Some of the peptides that can be combined with Epitalon include:

  • NAD+ Pen - Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) is a molecule that plays an important role in cellular metabolism and is associated with energy processes in cells. Combining them can support cellular recovery and enhance anti-aging effects.
  • 5-amino-1MQ - This peptide is associated with mechanisms of metabolism regulation and may have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Combining both peptides can reinforce anti-aging and cell-protective effects.
  • Skin Glow (GHK-Cu) - Is a peptide known for its regenerative and antioxidant properties for the skin. Combining this peptide with Epithalon can improve overall skin health and protect against premature ageing.

Here we have only listed a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of Epitalon:

Despite the limited data available on Epitalon, some mild to moderate side effects have been reported as a result of its use, especially with incorrect dosage.

Mild reactions at the injection site: May cause redness, mild pain, or discomfort at the injection site.

Changes in sleep: Some users report changes in sleep, including difficulties sleeping or excessive sleepiness.

Possible hormonal changes: Epithalon may affect some hormone levels, which could lead to mood changes or other hormone-related changes.

Mild feeling of fatigue: A feeling of fatigue or mild weakness may appear, especially in the early stages of use.

It is important to note that these side effects may not manifest and may vary in each user.

bodyHtml:
What is Ecdysterone?

Ecdysterone is a natural plant ecdysteroid extracted primarily from plants such as Spinacia oleracea (spinach) and Rhaponticum carthamoides (leucea). Also known as 20-hydroxyecdysone, this compound is part of a group of phytosteroids that naturally support plant development and defense. In the scientific and sports community, Ecdysterone is gaining popularity due to its potential to stimulate muscle growth and recovery without negatively affecting hormonal balance.

Unlike androgenic compounds, Ecdysterone does not interact with androgen receptors and does not affect testosterone or estrogen levels. This makes it suitable for protocols seeking to improve body composition, strength and recovery, without the risk of hormonal suppression or systemic side effects.

Mechanism of action of Ecdysterone:

Ecdysterone works by activating protein synthesis in muscle tissue, mainly through pathways related to PI3K/Akt signaling – a known mechanism involved in cell growth and regeneration. Unlike anabolic steroids or SARMs, it does not bind to androgen receptors, which eliminates hormonal risks, yet it has shown an anabolic effect in some laboratory and preclinical studies.

This mechanism is considered "androgen-independent anabolism" in which muscle mass is maintained or increased without hormonal fluctuations. Because of this, Ecdysterone is preferred in research protocols with a focus on natural strength stimulation and recovery.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of Ecdysterone:

Research and laboratory observations indicate a number of possible benefits associated with the use of Ecdysterone under controlled conditions:

  • Increase in lean muscle mass, without effect on the hormonal profile;
  • Improved muscle strength and endurance during exercise;
  • Accelerated recovery of muscle fibers after training
  • Support of protein synthesis, without suppression of testosterone;
  • Anti-inflammatory activity supporting adaptation after stress.

Ecdysterone is considered one of the most promising non-androgenic molecules in the field of sports physiology and recovery.

Dosage and Administration of Ecdysterone in Research Protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 15 units once daily for 4–8 weeks, followed by a 3–5 week rest period.

1 unit = 16.66mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 300 units

Possible side effects of Ecdysterone:
