bodyHtml:
What is DSIP (Delta-sleep-inducing peptide)?

DSIP (Delta-sleep-inducing peptide) is a peptide known for its ability to induce deep and restorative sleep, also known as delta sleep. DSIP was first discovered in the 1970s and is characterised by the following properties:

Structure and origin: This peptide is composed of several amino acids and is classified as a neuropeptide, meaning it acts on the central nervous system.

Sleep regulatory effects: The main function of the peptide is to promote and enhance deep sleep. It is known for its ability to increase delta waves during sleep, which are associated with restorative and deep sleep.

Potential therapeutic applications: Research covers its potential application in various conditions, such as sleep disorders, stress, chronic pain, and even addiction withdrawal.

Mechanism of action: Although its exact mechanism of action is not yet fully understood, it is believed to affect neurotransmitters and neurochemical pathways in the brain that regulate sleep and stress.

Delta sleep peptide represents an interest in the context of alternative methods for treating sleep disorders and stress management.

What are the benefits of Delta sleep inducing peptide?

DSIP (sleep inducer) is associated with a number of potential benefits, although it is important to note that many of these benefits still require more extensive scientific research. Based on the available information, some of the benefits of DSIP include:

  • Improvement of sleep quality: DSIP is mainly known for its ability to promote deep and restorative sleep, which is especially beneficial for people with sleep disorders.
  • Reduction of stress and anxiety: It is presumed to have a calming effect, which can help reduce stress and anxiety.
  • Antioxidant properties: Some studies suggest it may have antioxidant effects, which help combat oxidative stress in the body.
  • Relief from chronic pain: Delta sleep inducing peptide is being investigated for its potential application in chronic pain management.
  • Regulation of endocrine functions: It may have a positive impact on the endocrine system, regulating hormonal levels.
  • Improvement of the immune system: Some reports indicate that DSIP may have a positive impact on the immune system.
  • Addiction management: There is preliminary data suggesting that DSIP may help in the treatment of certain types of addictions.
  • Normalisation of blood pressure: The peptide may contribute to normalising blood pressure in people with hypertension.
  • Regulation of circadian rhythm: It may help regulate the body's "internal clock," which is important for overall health and well-being.
  • Improvement of concentration and memory: Some studies suggest that DSIP may have a positive effect on cognitive functions.

Clinical trials of DSIP (sleep inducer) and their results:

Clinical trials of DSIP (Delta-sleep-inducing peptide) are still in early stages, so general information about the results is limited. Some key aspects include:

Some of these studies indicate that delta sleep peptide may improve sleep quality, increasing the duration of deep sleep and the overall state of rest. Additionally, there is data suggesting it may reduce symptoms of stress and anxiety, which would be beneficial for people with such conditions.

Research also examines the impact of the peptide on hormonal levels, especially those related to stress and sleep, as well as its antioxidant properties, which may have health benefits and resistance to oxidative stress.

There is preliminary evidence that DSIP may help in managing chronic pain and improving cognitive functions such as concentration and memory. Some studies also focus on its potential impact on the reproductive system. Despite these promising results, it is important to emphasise that research is still in its early stages and further studies are needed to better understand the efficacy and safety of DSIP in use.

Correct Administration and Dosage of DSIP:

The correct administration and dosage of Delta sleep inducing peptide depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered from 250mcg to 450mcg once a day.

The correct dosage of DSIP is 10 to 18 units per day.

After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The cycle duration with this peptide lasts from 1 to 2 months.

A pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

A DSIP pen (5mg) will be sufficient for 15-20 days depending on the daily dosage.

Thus, if the cycle was 4 weeks, the rest period after would also be 4 weeks.

Possible side effects of DSIP Peptide:

The possible side effects of using DSIP (sleep inducer) are not yet fully clarified due to the limited scientific research available. However, based on the available information, the use of DSIP may include some side effects, including:

Headaches or fatigue: Some users may experience headaches or a feeling of fatigue, especially at the beginning of use.

Hormonal changes: Since DSIP can affect hormonal levels, there is the possibility of some mild hormonal changes.

Additionally, as with any supplement or medication, the appearance of an allergic reaction in some users is possible. Consultation with a specialist is recommended before using DSIP.

description: What is Curcumin Pen? Curcumin | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a biologically active, high-concentration formula containing 200mg of curcumin in a pre-blended research-grade pen. Each pen delivers 300 units of 666 micrograms each, allowing for precise dosing and controlled, high-level app
bodyHtml:
What is Curcumin Pen?

Curcumin | 3ml Pre-Mixed Pen is a biologically active, high-concentration formula containing 200mg of curcumin in a pre-blended research-grade pen. Each pen delivers 300 units of 666 micrograms each, allowing for precise dosing and controlled, high-level application.

The Curcumin Pen formula is specially developed to overcome the limitations of traditional oral curcumin forms, which suffer from poor absorption, rapid metabolism, and instability in systemic circulation. With a stabilized pen format and exact dosing, high systemic bioavailability is achieved – essential for maximum research efficacy.

What makes Curcumin Pen unique?

Curcumin, the active polyphenolic component of the Curcuma longa plant, has been the subject of thousands of scientific studies due to its wide-ranging effects. When formulated in a stable form and applied in a controlled way, Curcumin Pen shows potential for:

  • Regulation of chronic inflammation (via NF-κB, COX-2, and TNF-α modulation);
  • Reduction of oxidative stress (via Nrf2 pathway activation and antioxidant enzyme support);
  • Cellular health support and tissue repair mechanisms;
  • Immunomodulation and protection from metabolic dysfunction.

Biochemical properties and mechanism of action

Anti-inflammatory activity

Curcumin inhibits key inflammatory mediators such as NF-κB, IL-6, TNF-α, and COX-2, making it highly valuable in research on chronic inflammatory conditions, including autoimmune diseases and neurodegenerative processes.

Antioxidant regulation

Curcumin is a strong neutralizer of free radicals and activates the Nrf2 pathway, increasing the production of glutathione, superoxide dismutase (SOD), and catalase – all essential for cellular homeostasis and protection from oxidative damage.

Epigenetic and cellular protection effects

Studies show that Curcumin Pen can modulate the expression of genes involved in apoptosis, cellular proliferation, and intracellular signaling. This epigenetic action makes it useful in research focused on aging, cancer, and tissue regeneration.

Recommended dosage and research cycle

  • 1 unit = 666 micrograms
  • Total: 300 units / 200mg total curcumin
  • Suggested research protocol: 20 units daily for 15 consecutive days, followed by a 15-day rest period before a new cycle

Scientifically supported research applications

Curcumin Pen combines stability, high absorption, and precise dosing, making it suitable for studies related to inflammation, oxidative stress, and cellular regulation. The formula allows targeted action in the following areas:

  • Chronic inflammatory and autoimmune conditions: Due to its ability to modulate inflammatory pathways such as NF-κB, COX-2, and cytokines like TNF-α and IL-6, Curcumin Pen is suitable for studies on systemic inflammation, rheumatoid arthritis, ulcerative colitis, and other autoimmune disorders.
  • Oxidative stress and antioxidant response: Curcumin Pen can be used to monitor the effects of Nrf2 activation and the induction of endogenous antioxidant enzymes like superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase, and glutathione peroxidase – assessing cellular resistance to oxidative damage.
  • Metabolic disorders and insulin sensitivity: Research shows that curcumin may influence glucose tolerance, insulin sensitivity, and lipid profiles – making it valuable in models of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic syndrome.
  • Neuroprotection and cognitive function: Curcumin Pen crosses the blood-brain barrier and is included in studies on neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s. It shows potential in reducing neuroinflammation and supporting neurotrophic factors like BDNF.
  • Cellular aging and epigenetic regulation: Curcumin modulates gene expression related to aging and cellular proliferation, including inhibition of HDAC and DNMT enzymes. These effects make Curcumin Pen useful in research into the epigenetic mechanisms of cellular youth and longevity.

description: What is Cardarine (GW501516)? Cardarine, also known as GW501516, is a compound of the group of PPAR-δ (peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta) agonists. Although it is often mentioned alongside SARMs, it represents a separate class of compounds focused on the regulation
bodyHtml:
What is Cardarine (GW501516)?

Cardarine, also known as GW501516, is a compound of the group of PPAR-δ (peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta) agonists. Although it is often mentioned alongside SARMs, it represents a separate class of compounds focused on the regulation of energy metabolism. GW501516 was developed to study metabolic mechanisms that govern fat burning, glucose balance and physical endurance.

Cardarine is gaining serious popularity in scientific circles due to its ability to influence mitochondrial activity and fatty acid oxidation, thereby supporting the body's adaptation to increased physical activity and caloric deficit. Its profile makes it a valuable target in research related to improving metabolic efficiency and cardio-respiratory endurance.

Cardarine (GW501516) Mechanism of Action:

Cardarine works by activating PPAR-δ receptors – regulators responsible for controlling the expression of genes involved in fat metabolism, glucose utilization and cellular energy. Activation of these receptors leads to increased fat burning and improved ability of cells to use oxygen efficiently.

In addition, GW501516 supports the shift of energy needs from carbohydrates to fat, which is particularly important in studies related to endurance and body composition control. Cardarine does not affect androgen receptors, which makes it suitable for studies in which it is necessary to avoid hormonal influence.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of Cardarine (GW501516):

Cardarine has been the subject of a number of studies in which the following potential effects have been observed:

  • Increased fat burning by activating β-oxidation;
  • Improved energy efficiency and aerobic endurance;
  • Optimization of glucose metabolism and insulin sensitivity;
  • Supporting physical activity in caloric deficit;
  • Preservation of muscle mass while simultaneously reducing fat;
  • Non-hormonal profile, no suppression of testosterone or androgenic activity;
  • Suitable for subcutaneous use, with a stabilized formula for controlled absorption.

These characteristics make GW501516 suitable for studies related to improving athletic endurance, body weight control, and energy regulation.

Comparison of Cardarine (GW501516) with other SARMs and metabolic modulators

Cardarine (GW501516) is a synthetic PPAR-δ receptor agonist that is used in research protocols aimed at burning fat, increasing endurance, and improving metabolic efficiency. Although often mentioned alongside SARMs, Cardarine does not interact with androgen receptors, but instead modulates energy metabolism by activating specific nuclear receptors.

Compared to GW0742, another PPAR-δ agonist, Cardarine has a lower selectivity but a better studied profile. GW0742 is more potent at the receptor level, but Cardarine is more widely used in research models, particularly related to sports physiology, long-term activity and glucose control. Cardarine has been successfully applied in laboratory settings to assess lipid metabolism without directly altering the hormonal profile.

Compared to Stenabolic (SR9009), which affects REV-ERBα receptors and circadian rhythms, Cardarine acts more centrally on fat metabolism and energy utilization, particularly in skeletal muscle. SR9009 shows synergistic potential with Cardarine, but in contrast does not activate the PPAR pathway directly. Therefore, Cardarine remains preferred in studies focusing on sports endurance and lipid control.

In the context of SARMs like Ostarine or Ligandrol, which target muscle growth, Cardarine serves as a complementary compound – with a different mechanism, but a strong role in body recomposition protocols. It does not stimulate androgenic activity, does not suppress testosterone and can be used alone or in combination for maximum metabolic efficiency.

Dosage and administration of Cardarine (GW501516) in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 5 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 266mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of Cardarine (GW501516):

Despite the potential of Cardarine, there are observations of some side effects, especially with prolonged use or higher doses:

  • Insufficient long-term data related to chronic exposure;
  • Changes in the lipid profile under certain conditions;
  • Individual reactions.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is BPC 157?

BPC 157, short for "Body Protective Compound-157," is a synthetic peptide that has garnered significant attention in the fields of scientific medical research and sports science. This peptide fragment, composed of seventeen amino acids, is known for its potential properties to stimulate tissue regeneration and healing.

This peptide is characterised by its ability to influence various cellular processes and mechanisms in the body. One of the most important features of BPC 157 is its association with angiogenesis - the process of forming new blood vessels. This aspect is crucial in aiding tissue regeneration and rapid recovery after injuries.

BPC 157 is studied in the context of various medical scenarios, including injuries to joints, muscles, and tendons, as well as chronic inflammatory diseases. Preliminary studies highlight its potential to facilitate and accelerate tissue recovery and regeneration processes.

What are the benefits of BPC157?

This peptide is associated with a number of promising properties that could be beneficial in medical practice and sports science. Some of these include:

  • Healing of injuries: BPC157 is being investigated for its potential to speed up the regeneration and healing processes of wounds. This aspect can aid in recovery after tissue injuries, including those of joints, muscles, and tendons.
  • Improvement of chronic diseases: Studies suggest that BPC 157 may have the potential to reduce inflammatory reactions and symptoms associated with chronic diseases. This can contribute to alleviating pain and improving the quality of life for patients.
  • Support for gastrointestinal health: It improves the healing of ulcerations and other gastrointestinal problems, preventing and treating inflammations in the gastrointestinal tract.
  • Stimulation of blood vessel growth: BPC 157 aids in the process of angiogenesis, i.e., the formation of new blood vessels. This aspect is essential for improving circulation and supplying nutrients and oxygen to tissues.
  • Improvement after surgical interventions: Studies show that BPC157 can help in rapid recovery after surgical interventions. This peptide has demonstrated significant potential in improving regeneration processes, which is particularly valuable in the postoperative period, thus reducing recovery time and improving patients, overall well-being.
  • Protection of organs and tissues: BPC 157 is related to the protection of various organs and tissues, including the liver and the heart, from damage and inflammation. This aspect can contribute to the optimal functioning of important organs.
  • Joint improvement: BPC157 helps improve joint health by stimulating the healing processes of tendons and cartilaginous tissues.
  • Anti-inflammatory properties: This peptide may exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which help reduce the inflammatory response in the body.
  • Improvement of recovery speed after training: For athletes, BPC 157 has benefits related to accelerating recovery after intensive workouts, which can contribute to reaching fitness goals more quickly.
  • Support for bone health: BPC 157 influences bone healing and stimulates the growth of new bone tissue.

Clinical trials of the BPC 157 peptide and their results:

Early clinical trials focus on the potential of BPC-157 for healing injuries and improving tissue regeneration. The results of these studies observe an acceleration in wound healing and injuries in muscles, joints, and tendons. This peptide demonstrates its ability to stimulate cellular processes related to the growth of new tissues and the formation of blood vessels, assisting in faster recovery after injuries.

Additional clinical trials are aimed at understanding the potential benefits of BPC157 for people with chronic diseases and inflammations. The results indicate the peptide,s potential to contribute to the reduction of inflammatory processes in the body and relief of associated pain. This aspect can have a significant impact on patients with conditions such as arthritis, inflammatory liver diseases, and other similar conditions.

In relation to sports science, study results focus on assessing the possibilities of improvement in physical endurance and recovery speed after intensive workouts. Some studies report faster recovery of muscles and joints after workouts with the application of BPC-157.

Correct administration and dosage of BPC 157:

The correct administration and dosage of BPC 157 depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, usually applied from 400 mcg. to 500 mcg. once daily.

The correct dose of BPC157 is 16 to 20 units per day.

Additional instructions for use: Adjust the pen doser by turning it to 16 or 20 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the doser) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The cycle duration with this peptide is 1 to 3 months.

One pen contains 200 units of 25 micrograms.

A BPC157 pen (5mg) will be sufficient for 12-13 days depending on the daily dosage.

Examples of calculated units from the BPC-157 pen (5mg) equivalent to micrograms:

1 unit = 25mcg; 5 units = 125mcg; 10 units = 250mcg; 16 units = 400mcg; 20 units = 500mcg.

What other peptides can BPC157 be combined with?

BPC-157 is a peptide used to improve injury recovery, enhance wound healing, and support gastrointestinal tract integrity. It can be combined with several other peptides and supplements to enhance the overall effect or target specific health issues. Here are some examples of peptides and their potential synergy with BPC157:

  • TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4) - A peptide used to improve injury recovery, enhance mobility, and reduce inflammation. Combining both can offer potent regenerative potential, especially for the treatment of muscle, tendon, and joint injuries.
  • GHK-Cu - A peptide that aids in skin regeneration, stimulates collagen and elastin production, and supports wound healing. Combining them can improve skin recovery, as well as accelerate wound healing and scar reduction.
  • Ipamorelin - This peptide is used to stimulate the natural release of growth hormone by the pituitary gland. Combining them can help achieve an overall improvement in health and recovery.
  • KPV - The combination can help improve the healing and regeneration of the mucous lining of the gastrointestinal tract, reduce inflammation, and improve blood circulation in that area.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Application of BPC 157 in sports:

Here are the benefits that the BPC 157 peptide can offer to athletes:

  • Acceleration of injury recovery: BPC157 can stimulate the healing of various tissues, including muscles, tendons, ligaments, and even bones. This makes it potentially useful for athletes recovering from strained muscles, torn tendons, or other traumatic injuries.
  • Reduction of inflammation: BPC-157 can help reduce inflammatory processes, which are often the result of intensive training or injuries. In this way, it can contribute not only to rapid recovery but also to improving the overall condition and comfort of the athlete.
  • Improvement of flexibility and mobility: By promoting tissue regeneration, BPC157 can help increase joint flexibility and mobility, which is essential for preventing future injuries and enhancing sports performance.
  • Quick recovery after workouts: Intensive training sessions can lead to muscle fatigue and microtraumas. BPC-157 can facilitate the rapid recovery of muscles, allowing athletes to increase the frequency and intensity of their workouts.
  • Improvement of gastrointestinal function: BPC157, originally isolated from gastric secretion, shows promising results in assisting gastrointestinal tract health and function. This is particularly important for athletes who may experience gastrointestinal problems due to intensive training regimens, stress, or dietary habits. Improving gastrointestinal function can contribute to better nutrient absorption and overall well-being, which is critical for optimising sports performance and recovery.

Possible side effects of BPC 157:

Although BPC 157 is studied as potentially beneficial, it should be noted that even in cases where side effects have been observed, these are generally minimal and temporary. This peptide is considered relatively safe, but it is still important to consider possible side effects:

Mild gastrointestinal symptoms: Some people may experience mild discomfort symptoms such as nausea or mild stomach pains.

Mild pain or redness at the injection site: When applying BPC 157 by injection, mild pain or redness may occur around the application site.

By following the correct dosage and avoiding prolonged use, BPC157 is safe for use.

bodyHtml:
What is ARA 290?

ARA 290 is a peptide derived from the erythropoietin (EPO) hormone, which is responsible for stimulating the production of red blood cells.

ARA 290 is a small peptide molecule developed as an anti-inflammatory agent. This peptide is also used to treat various conditions such as diabetic neuropathy, chronic kidney disease, and others.

ARA 290 peptide has been developed as an analog of the non-hematopoietic EPO protein, which is used to stimulate red blood cell production. It binds to erythropoietin receptors (EPO), acting as an immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory agent, rather than directly stimulating red blood cell production.

What are the benefits of the ARA 290?

The use of the ARA 290 peptide provides the following benefits for the body and overall health:

  • ARA290 helps with pain and neuropathic symptoms resulting from diabetic neuropathy, alleviating pain and improving nerve function.
  • ARA 290 is used to enhance cognitive functions and reduce inflammatory processes associated with Alzheimer's disease.
  • The peptide ARA 290 improves kidney function and reduces inflammation associated with chronic kidney disease.
  • This peptide has anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in combating inflammation caused by certain diseases.
  • The use of ARA 290 is associated with minor side effects and low toxicity.
  • ARA 290 peptide reduces inflammation and controls symptoms in sarcoidosis, improving lung function and reducing inflammatory markers.

Clinical trials of ARA290 and their results:

The ARA290 peptide has been the subject of multiple clinical trials that demonstrate its efficacy and safety.

One of the largest clinical trials involved 204 participants with diabetic neuropathy. The results show that ARA 290 peptide therapy led to a significant improvement in neuropathic pain and helped reduce the symptoms of the condition.

In another study, 90 people with fibromyalgia were involved. A significant reduction in pain and a positive improvement in quality of life were observed after the administration of ARA 290.

The results of another clinical trial, involving 290 participants, demonstrated that ARA 290 improves glucose metabolism in the brain, protects the nervous system from damage, and accelerates wound healing.

All the clinical trials conducted so far on ARA 290 peptide provide promising results for the treatment of various diseases.

Proper use and dosage of ARA290 16mg:

The ARA290 peptide is a medication used to treat various health conditions. Proper administration and dosage of this product are crucial for achieving optimal therapeutic effects and reducing the risk of adverse reactions.

The recommended dosage of ARA290 is 3 mg to 4 mg daily (30-40 units), with each unit corresponding to 80 mcg. The cycle duration can vary depending on the specific health condition being treated and the individual needs of the patient, but it is generally administered for up to 2 months.

Possible side effects of ARA 290:

The ARA290 peptide is used to treat various diseases. Like any medication, its use may cause some side effects.

The most common adverse reactions to ARA290 are a slight pain or discomfort at the injection site as a reaction to the peptide.

In very rare cases, the administration of ARA 290 peptide may cause a slight increase in blood pressure or blood sugar levels. These side effects are temporary, usually resolve quickly, and do not require discontinuing treatment.

Allergic reactions to ARA290, such as skin rashes, breathing difficulties, or swelling, are extremely rare. If any of these symptoms occur, treatment should be discontinued, and consultation with a specialist is mandatory.

ARA 290 is a safe peptide with minimal risk of side effects. To avoid these, it is recommended to consult with a specialist prior to use, especially if taking other medications.

description: What is Andarine S4? Andarine (S4) is a selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed to maintain and increase muscle mass, improve strength and support bone structure, without the typical side effects associated with traditional androgenic compounds. The compound was on
bodyHtml:
What is Andarine S4?

Andarine (S4) is a selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed to maintain and increase muscle mass, improve strength and support bone structure, without the typical side effects associated with traditional androgenic compounds. The compound was one of the first SARMs developed for scientific research and continues to be among the most researched molecules in this class.

Andarine demonstrates moderate anabolic action, with high selectivity for muscle and bone tissue, avoiding a strong impact on the prostate and other sensitive systems. This makes it suitable for research protocols focused on body recomposition, recovery after muscle loss and maintenance of physical strength in a reduced hormonal background.

Mechanism of action of Andarine S4:

Andarine S4 binds to androgen receptors in muscle and bone tissue, where it activates genes responsible for protein synthesis and mineral density. Unlike traditional androgen preparations, Andarine does not significantly affect other tissues, such as the prostate, and is not converted to estrogen.

The molecule has a relatively short half-life, which allows finer control of dosage and research cycles. Its action profile is balanced – strong enough to observe effects on muscle mass, but also light enough to be suitable for shorter or more moderate protocols.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of Andarine S4:

The following potential effects have been observed in scientific and laboratory studies:

  • Increase in lean muscle mass, especially with deficiency or immobilization;
  • Improving physical strength and muscle density;
  • Maintenance of bone mineralization and resistance;
  • Optimizing body composition while simultaneously maintaining muscles;
  • Appropriate selectivity to androgen receptors, without strong impact on other systems;
  • Subcutaneous formulation stabilized for easy and accurate dosing.

These properties make Andarine S4 the preferred choice in laboratory settings where a controlled effect on muscle and bone function is sought, without risks of unwanted hormonal interactions.

Comparison of Andarine S4 with other SARMs

Andarine (S4) was one of the first SARMs developed and remains well known for its balanced anabolic effect, moderate potency and relatively short half-life. Due to these characteristics, S4 is often compared to Ostarine (MK2866), Ligandrol (LGD-4033) and S23, occupying an intermediate position between the mild and more potent SARMs.

Compared to Ostarine, Andarine shows a stronger effect on physical strength and muscle tissue density, but also with a higher risk of side effects, such as temporary visual disturbances - one of the most distinctive aspects of S4. While Ostarine is preferred in long-term and maintenance research protocols, S4 is used in more intense cycles to increase functional strength and muscle relief.

Compared to Ligandrol, Andarine has a weaker anabolic effect, but also a shorter duration of action, which allows for more precise dosage adjustment. LGD-4033 outperforms S4 in gaining lean mass, while S4 has shown excellent results in protocols focused on preserving muscle tissue in a caloric deficit and improving density and definition.

Compared to S23, Andarine is significantly safer, with less suppression of endogenous testosterone, but also with a more moderate anabolic effect. S23 often requires close monitoring and post-protocol hormonal support, while S4 has been successfully administered under more lightly controlled conditions.

Dosage and administration of Andarine S4 in research protocols:

Recommended study schedule: 3 units twice daily (6 units total per day), for 2–4 weeks, followed by a 4–6 week rest period.

1 unit = 266mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of Andarine S4:

Despite its widespread use in laboratory models, there are observations of some side effects, especially with prolonged use or higher doses:

  • Changes in the perception of colors (yellowish tint) - reversible when the intake is stopped;
  • Temporary suppression of natural testosterone in longer cycles;
  • Individual sensitivity to androgen stimulation.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is AICAR?

AICAR (5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide) is an experimental pharmaceutical used to improve glucose metabolism and increase endurance.

AICAR activates the metabolic enzyme AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), which regulates glucose and fat metabolism in cells. It stimulates the production of the primary energy currency of cells, ATP, by increasing glucose consumption in cells.

AICAR is used as a medication to treat several metabolic disorders, such as metabolic syndrome, diabetes, and others. It is also used in the sports field to improve endurance, providing an energy boost to athletes, making their training sessions longer and more intense. This is why AICAR has been banned by the World Anti-Doping Agency.

What are the benefits of AICAR 50 mg?

The AICAR 50 mg medication offers multiple health and fitness benefits for users, including:

  • Improves cellular insulin sensitivity, a key hormone for regulating glucose metabolism, making it useful for treating diabetes and other metabolic diseases.
  • Stimulates mitochondrial production in muscles, increasing the muscles, ability to produce energy, which leads to improved physical endurance.
  • Protects cells from oxidative stress and reduces the risk of damage to cell membranes and DNA, while also protecting cells from aging and diseases.
  • Has anti-inflammatory properties and helps reduce inflammatory reactions in the body.
  • Improves heart and vascular function, reducing the risk of heart disease.
  • Stimulates nerve cell growth, which may assist in the treatment of neurological diseases.
  • Helps reduce body fat and improves overall physical fitness.

Clinical trials of AICAR and their results:

AICAR 50 mg is a small molecule that stimulates the action of AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK). Known as a "miracle drug" for improving metabolism, increasing endurance, and enhancing muscle function.

In one of the clinical trials conducted, the results showed the effectiveness of AICAR in making the body convert fat into energy. This leads to weight loss and improved metabolism, benefiting individuals suffering from diabetes and metabolic syndrome.

A study published in the journal Cell Metabolism reported that taking AICAR 50 mg led to significant improvements in muscle function, increasing endurance and muscle mass.

The clinical trials conducted with AICAR 50 mg demonstrate promising results for its application in improving metabolism, muscle function, and endurance.

Proper use and dosage of AICAR:

The correct use and dosage of AICAR 50 mg depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient. Generally, it is administered at 10 mg to 20 mg once daily.

The correct dosage of AICAR is 20 to 40 units per day.

Instructions for use: Adjust the pen dial by turning it from 20 to 40 (1 unit equals 1 division on the dial) and inject into the abdominal area or the front of the thigh. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

The cycle duration for this peptide is 15 to 20 days.

One pen contains 100 units of 500 micrograms.

One AICAR pen (50 mg) will be sufficient for approximately 5 days, depending on the daily dosage.

  • HGH Fragment 176-191: A short fragment of human growth hormone used to reduce fat. Combining it with AICAR can amplify metabolic effects and promote fat loss.
  • IGF-1LR3: A peptide that stimulates muscle growth and may improve recovery. Combining these peptides can help increase muscle mass and accelerate post-training recovery.
  • BPC-157: A peptide known for its restorative and regenerative properties, especially in the context of soft tissue injuries and inflammation. Combining it with AICAR can support recovery from physical exertion and injuries.

These are just a few examples of the peptides that can be combined with AICAR 50 mg to enhance its effects.

Possible side effects of AICAR:

AICAR 50 mg is an experimental medication with many potential health and fitness benefits. It acts as a metabolism stimulant, and, like any medication or supplement, adverse reactions are possible.

The most common adverse reactions when taking AICAR 50 mg include headaches, stomach discomfort, and digestive disturbances. These side effects are generally not dangerous and typically disappear quickly.

In very rare cases, changes in mood or sleep patterns have been reported as side effects of AICAR use.

To avoid adverse reactions, it is recommended to follow the correct dosage of AICAR and avoid prolonged use.

Use of AICAR in sports:

AICAR 50 mg is used in sports as a potential means to improve physical endurance and increase muscle mass, but its use is prohibited by the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA).

AICAR has the ability to enhance endurance and accelerate metabolism, leading to improved physical stamina, increased muscle mass, and faster recovery after workouts.

Although the use of AICAR is banned in sports, there are reports that it is used by some athletes, including professionals in endurance sports, with the aim of improving stamina.

name: ACP‑105 | 35mg/1,5ml
description: What is ACP‑105? ACP-105 is a synthetic selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed to provide a pronounced anabolic effect with significantly limited systemic effects on organs sensitive to androgen stimulation. The compound represents one of the most innovative molec
bodyHtml:
What is ACP‑105?

ACP-105 is a synthetic selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed to provide a pronounced anabolic effect with significantly limited systemic effects on organs sensitive to androgen stimulation. The compound represents one of the most innovative molecules in its class and features a high affinity for receptors in skeletal muscle and bone tissue without activating other hormonal pathways that could lead to adverse reactions.

ACP-105 has attracted the attention of the scientific community with promising results related to increases in lean muscle mass, improvements in bone density, and restoration of functional strength in models undergoing muscle atrophy or hormone deficiency. Due to its precise molecular structure and high tissue selectivity, ACP-105 is considered as a potential research tool in the fields of sarcopenia, osteoporosis and physical rehabilitation.

Mechanism of action of ACP‑105:

ACP-105 binds with high selectivity to androgen receptors in specific tissues, particularly skeletal muscle and bone. After binding, it activates the transcription of genes responsible for muscle protein synthesis, cell regeneration and mineral density. Its mechanism is built in such a way as to avoid systemic androgenic activity – for example on prostate tissue – by focusing on anabolic processes without accompanying side effects characteristic of classical hormonal preparations.

An additional advantage of ACP-105 is that it does not interact with systems responsible for the production of estrogens or other hormones, which minimizes the risk of secondary hormonal deviations. This allows its application in research models aimed at studying isolated effects on the musculoskeletal system without interfering with the overall endocrine regulation.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of ACP‑105:

Data from preclinical and laboratory observations indicate that ACP-105 has potential in the following research areas:

  • Stimulation of muscle hypertrophy with preserved low androgen load;
  • Improvement of bone structure and density, especially in models with induced osteopenia;
  • Aiding regeneration after muscle damage or mass loss;
  • Improved functional strength and load resistance;
  • High tissue selectivity, with limited impact on other organs;
  • A stable formulation for subcutaneous administration, ensuring a predictable pharmacokinetic profile.

Thanks to these characteristics, ACP-105 is used in scientific models that aim to examine the possibilities of maintaining musculoskeletal function in conditions of aging, immobilization or hormonal deficiency.

Comparison of ACP-105 with other SARMs

ACP-105 is a selective androgen receptor modulator that features high receptor selectivity and moderate anabolic action, with minimal impact on non-target tissues. Although less known than leading molecules such as Ligandrol (LGD-4033), Ostarine (MK2866) and S23, ACP-105 is seen as a balanced alternative for studies requiring a lower androgen load and good tolerability.

Compared to Ostarine, ACP-105 offers similar anabolic activity, but with a possibly faster onset of effect, according to some preclinical observations. Both molecules are suitable for maintaining lean or immobilized muscle mass, and ACP-105 may have a slight advantage in short-term protocols where a moderate but distinct result is sought.

Compared to Ligandrol, ACP-105 is less pronounced in pure anabolic effect, but also with a lower risk of suppressing the hormonal axis. While LGD-4033 is preferred in aggressive muscle-oriented protocols, ACP-105 is more commonly used in supportive research related to recovery, mobility, and bone structure, especially in higher sensitivity models.

Compared to S23, which is extremely potent and often leads to testosterone suppression, ACP-105 is a significantly more gentle molecule, without the need for intensive post-protocol hormonal control. It is suitable for laboratory conditions where anabolic efficiency is sought with minimal systemic risk.

Dosage and administration of ACP-105 in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 5 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 233mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of ACP‑105:

Within the existing observations, ACP-105 shows a good tolerability profile. However, under certain conditions the following reactions can be reported:

  • Temporary suppression of endogenous androgen production;
  • Variable individual sensitivity to receptor stimulation;
  • Lack of sufficient data on safety with long-term use.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is ACE 083?

ACE-083 is an experimental drug developed by Acceleron Pharma for the treatment of muscular and neurological diseases.

ACE083 is a modified recombinant protein with enhanced activity in muscle tissues. It acts as an inhibitor of the protein myostatin, which controls muscle growth and development. ACE 083 enhances function in diseases such as muscular dystrophy and promotes muscle growth.

The peptide ACE083 activates insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) for muscle cells, which are responsible for the development and growth of muscle tissues. Its use leads to faster muscle mass increase and improved functional capabilities.

What are the benefits of the ACE 083 peptide?

ACE-083 is a peptide that stimulates hypertrophy and strength of certain muscle groups and has multiple benefits, which include:

  • ACE-083 enhances muscle mass by acting as an inhibitor of the protein myostatin, which controls muscle growth and development.
  • The peptide ACE-083 improves functional capabilities in people with muscular and neurological diseases.
  • It helps improve quality of life by enhancing the functional capabilities of the muscles.
  • ACE-083 reduces muscular weakness, which is a symptom of muscular and neurological diseases.
  • ACE083 reduces inflammation in the muscles, protecting them from muscular weakness and atrophy.
  • It prevents muscle injuries resulting from physical activity, as well as in the presence of neurological and muscular diseases.
  • The peptide ACE 083 improves blood circulation and oxygen supply to the muscles, leading to better muscle endurance and energy.
  • This peptide has a positive effect on muscle coordination in muscular and neurological diseases.
  • ACE083 aids in muscle recovery after an injury, enhancing muscle regeneration.

Clinical trials of ACE 083 and its results:

ACE-083 is a medicinal product used to treat some muscular diseases. Many clinical trials have demonstrated its beneficial effect.

In 2019, the results of Phase 2 clinical trials of the peptide ACE-083 were published, investigating its action on the rare genetic disease Charcot-Marie-Tooth (CMT), which affects the nervous system and muscles. The study involved 70 people diagnosed with this disease. The results show a significant improvement in muscle mass and functional capabilities of the participants after the application of ACE-083.

The following year, 2020, Acceleron Pharma announced results related to patients with focal muscular atrophy. During a clinical trial, the efficacy of ACE 083 was monitored in two phases related to this disease. The results demonstrate that the peptide improves muscle mass and function in participants suffering from muscular atrophy and weakness in specific parts of the body.

In the clinical trials, no serious adverse reactions were observed in the participants, giving confidence to doctors and scientific teams about the beneficial effect and safety of using ACE083.

Correct Administration and Dosage of ACE 083 10mg:

The correct administration and dosage of ACE-083 depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered at 350mcg (three times a week).

The correct dose of ACE-083 is 7 units, three times a week.

Additional usage instructions: Adjust the pen programmer by turning it to 7 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the programmer) and inject intramuscularly into the areas you want to develop. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

Cycle duration: 40 days.

A pen contains 200 units of 50 micrograms.

A pen ACE-083 (10mg) will be sufficient for approximately 8 weeks, depending on the daily dose.

Example calculated units from an ACE-083 (10mg) pen corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 50mcg; 5 units = 250mcg; 7 units = 350mcg; 10 units = 500mcg.

What other peptides can ACE 083 be combined with?

ACE-083 is a peptide designed to increase muscle mass and strength by blocking myostatin, a protein that limits muscle growth. Some of the popular combinations with peptides may include:

  • IGF-1LR3: is a hormone that plays a key role in muscle growth. Combining them can enhance the effect of increasing muscle mass and strength.
  • TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4): is a peptide that stimulates the rapid recovery of tissues, including muscles and joints. Combining both peptides can achieve a faster and more effective recovery after sports injuries or other types of injuries.
  • GHRP-6 (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide-6): is a peptide that stimulates the production of growth hormone (GH) by the pituitary gland. Combining both products can increase muscle development and strength due to the higher concentration of growth hormone in the body.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of ACE 083:

ACE 083 is an innovative medicinal product used to treat various muscular diseases. This medicine stimulates muscle growth, enhancing the efficacy of local genetic growth factors.

Like any medicine, medicinal product, and supplement, the administration of ACE083 can also cause some side effects. These manifest as headaches, mild pain, or redness around the injection site, and a feeling of fatigue. These side effects are not dangerous and usually disappear within a few days as symptoms of the body,s adaptation.

ACE-083 is safe for use, as long as the recommended dosage is respected.

Application of ACE-083 in sports:

A large part of professional athletes use ACE-083 as an aid to their professional achievements. Although the peptide is banned in professional sports, they benefit from its potent action on muscle mass.

name: ACE-031 | 1.66mg
description: What is ACE-031? ACE-031 is a peptide that is a synthetic branched segment of the myostatin receptor (ActRIIB). In the human body, myostatin plays a key role in regulating muscle growth, acting as an inhibitor. This means that in the presence of myostatin, muscle development and
bodyHtml:
What is ACE-031?

ACE-031 is a peptide that is a synthetic branched segment of the myostatin receptor (ActRIIB). In the human body, myostatin plays a key role in regulating muscle growth, acting as an inhibitor. This means that in the presence of myostatin, muscle development and growth are limited.

The active ActRIIB receptor binds to myostatin, preventing its action. ACE031, as a segment of this receptor, mimics this process. When administered into the body, ACE-031 "traps" free myostatin before it can bind to its receptors on the surface of muscle cells. Thus, the peptide prevents the action of myostatin in the body.

It is important to note that ACE 031 is the subject of studies and research for its potential applications in various areas of medicine and sports.

What are the benefits of ACE031 Peptide?

  • Assistance for muscle growth: By blocking the action of myostatin, the ACE 031 peptide can stimulate an increase in muscle mass.
  • Improvement of muscle strength: Studies suggest that increased muscle mass can lead to improvements in muscle strength.
  • Potential for the treatment of muscle diseases: ACE 031 has been researched for its possible use in the treatment of muscle diseases such as muscle atrophy and dystrophies.
  • Improvement of metabolism: The peptide can have a positive impact on metabolism, increasing muscle mass and potentially improving the body,s ability to burn fats.
  • Improvement of insulin sensitivity: The increase in muscle mass and improved metabolism can lead to an improvement in insulin sensitivity, which is important for managing diabetes.
  • Possible reduction of the risk of cardiovascular diseases: The improvement of muscle tone and metabolism may contribute to the reduction of the risk of cardiovascular diseases.
  • Acceleration of recovery after training: ACE 031 may help the rapid recovery of muscles after intense physical activity, which is especially important for athletes.
  • Improvement of bone density: The effects of ACE031 on muscles may also have a positive impact on bones, increasing their density and reducing the risk of osteoporosis.
  • Reduction of fat: Although its main action is related to increasing muscle mass, ACE031 may also contribute to the reduction of body fat.
  • Potential improvement in physical function and mobility: The increase in muscle mass and strength can improve overall physical function and mobility, especially in older people or individuals with muscle diseases.
  • Improvement in certain conditions of the cardiovascular system: Thanks to its possible action on muscle mass and metabolism, ACE 031 may have a beneficial effect on the cardiovascular system.

Clinical Trials of ACE 031 and its results:

ACE031, a widely studied peptide with potential to stimulate muscle growth, has been the subject of several clinical trials to determine its efficacy, safety, and potential applications. Here is a brief summary of some of these studies and their results:

Trial in healthy volunteers: In one of the first trials of ACE 031, conducted in healthy volunteers, it was found that administration of the peptide led to an increase in muscle mass and improvement of muscle function.

Muscular dystrophy: Clinical trials in people with Duchenne muscular dystrophy showed that administration of ACE 031 could lead to an improvement in muscle function and a slowdown in the progression of the disease.

Safety and tolerability: Several studies have examined the safety profile of ACE031. Although most volunteers reported good tolerability, some mild side effects were also observed.

Osteoporosis and bone density: Research indicates that ACE 031 could have a beneficial effect on bone density and potential for the treatment of osteoporosis. However, this possibility requires additional studies.

Loss of muscle mass with age: Some studies aim to determine if ACE 031 could be used as a potential treatment for age-related loss of muscle mass and strength.

The results of the clinical trials of the ACE 031 Peptide are promising, but it is important to emphasise that further extensive and long-term research is necessary to determine the full potential and safety of the peptide.

Correct Use and Dosage of ACE031:

The correct use and dosage of ACE031 depend on the specific needs and goals of the patient, generally administered at 1 to 3 mcg per kilogram of body weight.

Example of ACE 031 dosage for a 90 kg user, considering 2 mcg per kilogram of body weight:

90 kg x 2 mcg = 180 mcg daily, which is equivalent to 11 daily units (considering one unit equals 16.6 mcg).

Example of ACE 031 dosage for a 75 kg user, considering 2 mcg per kilogram of body weight:

75 kg x 2 mcg = 150 mcg daily, which is equivalent to 9 daily units (considering one unit equals 16.6 mcg).

Additional usage instructions for a 90 kg user (2 mcg per kilogram of body weight): Adjust the pen dial by turning to 11 (1 unit equals 1 of the divisions on the dial) and inject. After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle.

The duration of the cycle with this peptide varies from 15 to 20 days depending on the needs and goals of the user.

A pen contains 100 units of 16.6 micrograms.

An ACE 031 pen (1.66 mg) will be sufficient for approximately 9 days depending on the daily dosage.

Examples of units calculated per ACE031 pen (1.66 mg) corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 16.6 mcg; 5 units = 83 mcg; 8 units = 132.8 mcg; 9 units = 149.4 mcg; 11 units = 182.6 mcg; 14 units = 232.4 mcg.

What other peptides can ACE-031 be combined with?

ACE031 is a peptide designed to support muscle growth by inhibiting myostatin, a protein that limits muscle growth. Combining ACE 031 with other peptides can increase the overall effect on muscle growth, endurance, and recovery. Here are some peptides that are frequently combined with ACE031:

  • Ipamorelin: This peptide is a GHRP (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide) and helps to stimulate the release of growth hormone. Combining them can enhance the overall effect on muscle growth and recovery.
  • CJC-1295 without DAC (Drug Affinity Complex): This is a peptide that increases plasma levels of growth hormones. The version without DAC has a shorter half-life, allowing for a more controllable increase in growth hormone. Combining them can accelerate muscle growth.
  • MGF (Mechano Growth Factor): Stimulates the growth of muscle cells and aids in the recovery process after training. Combining them can increase recovery and muscle growth capabilities.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible Side Effects of ACE 031:

Like any active substance, supplement, or medication, ACE 031 can cause some side effects. It is important that each user is informed and consults with a specialist before taking it. Here are some of the possible side effects:

Skin reactions: Some users have reported redness or mild irritation at the injection site.

Headache: In some cases, mild headaches may occur after taking ACE 031.

Muscle aches: Temporary muscle pains or weakness may occur, especially after the first doses.

Fatigue: Some users have reported fatigue after starting therapy with ACE 031.

Mild stomach discomfort has also been rarely associated with taking the peptide.

If you have doubts or experience symptoms, it is advisable to consult a specialist or stop taking the peptide.

Use of ACE-031 in sports:

In the world of sports, ACE031 is attractive to many athletes and fitness enthusiasts due to its potential properties. This is how ACE-031 is used in the sports context:

  • Increase in muscle mass: The main reason many athletes turn to ACE 031 is its ability to stimulate muscle growth. This is crucial for weightlifters, bodybuilders, and other athletes who are looking to increase their muscle mass.
  • Performance improvement: With the increase in muscle mass and strength, athletes can achieve better performance in their discipline, improving their personal records and achievements.
  • Recovery after injuries: ACE 031 can help speed up the recovery process after muscle injuries or surgeries, which is essential for professional athletes.
  • Improvement in endurance: Although the main focus is on increasing muscle mass, some users also report an improvement in endurance during training and competitions after taking ACE031.
  • Optimization of body composition: Many seek to reduce body fat percentage while increasing their muscle mass. ACE-031 can help in this aspect, contributing to achieving a more defined and toned appearance.
  • Support during intensive training cycles: Athletes who are preparing for competitions or have particularly intense training periods often look for ways to maintain or even increase their muscle mass and strength. ACE031 can offer such support.

ACE031 is used in sports because of its series of promising properties related to muscle growth and overall physical performance. However, consultation with a specialist is recommended before starting the intake of this peptide.

bodyHtml:
What is AC-Selank-NH2?

AC-Selank-NH2 is a modified version of the Selank peptide, designed to have better bioavailability and a more prolonged therapeutic effect. Selank itself is a synthetic analog of the tetrapeptide Tuftsin, which is a natural immunomodulator in the body. AC-Selank-NH2 has been developed with the goal of enhancing and extending the benefits of the original Selank.

In its structure, AC-Selank-NH2 includes specific amino acids that contribute to its unique properties and functions. This peptide has been developed using modern biotechnological methods, making it an example of innovation in the field of peptide therapy.

AC-Selank-NH2 is the subject of increasing interest in the scientific and medical communities due to its potential and varied applications in the field of health and personal well-being.

What are the benefits of AC-Selank-NH2?

AC-Selank-NH2, as a modified version of the Selank peptide, is associated with a number of potential benefits that make it of interest in various areas, especially in the context of psychoneurological health and general well-being. Some of these benefits include:

  • Improvement of cognitive functions: It can enhance cognitive abilities such as memory and concentration.
  • Antistress properties: It has shown potential to reduce stress levels and aid in stress response management.
  • Anxiolytic effects (anti-anxiety): It is suggested to help reduce anxiety, making it potentially useful for the treatment of anxiety disorders.
  • Mood enhancement: It may have a positive effect on mood, making it researched in the context of treating mild to moderate depressive states.
  • Strengthening of the immune system: Due to its immunomodulatory properties, AC-Selank-NH2 can enhance the functioning of the immune system.
  • Sleep improvement: It can help in regulating sleep and improving the quality of rest.

It is important to note that while AC-Selank-NH2 shows promising results, scientific research on it is still at an early stage and requires further studies to confirm these benefits.

Clinical Trials of AC-Selank-NH2 and its results:

These trials focus on investigating the efficacy, safety, and potential applications of AC-Selank-NH2 in human therapy. Based on the research conducted, the peptide has shown promising results in several key areas:

Efficacy in managing stress and anxiety: Initial results indicate that AC-Selank-NH2 may be effective in reducing symptoms of stress and anxiety.

Impact on cognitive functions: Research has examined the potential improvement of cognitive functions such as memory and concentration.

Mood improvement: Some studies suggest a positive effect on mood and emotional state.

Safety and tolerability: Early clinical trials have also focused on the safety profile of AC-Selank-NH2, with no serious side effects reported to date.

Despite these promising initial results, it is important to emphasise that this peptide still requires additional and extensive clinical studies to clarify its full therapeutic potential. Such research is key to determining efficacy, dosage, safety, and potential applications in medical practice.

Correct Administration and Dosage of AC-Selank-NH2:

The correct administration and dosage of AC-Selank-NH2 depend on the specific needs and objectives of the patient, generally administered from 250 to 500 micrograms per day.

The correct dose of AC-Selank-NH2 is 5 to 10 units per day. (it is recommended to take it at night)

After injecting the product, wait 10 seconds before removing the needle. It is recommended to rotate the injection site.

A pen contains 200 units of 50 micrograms.

A pen of AC-Selank-NH2 (10mg) will be sufficient for approximately 20-30 days, depending on the daily dose.

Example units calculated from an AC-Selank-NH2 (10mg) pen corresponding to micrograms:

1 unit = 50mcg; 5 units = 250mcg; 7 units = 350mcg; 10 units = 500mcg; 15 units = 750mcg.

What other peptides can AC-Selank-NH2 be combined with?

Combining the peptide AC-Selank-NH2 with other peptides or nootropic components represents a strategy to enhance cognitive functions, stress management, and general mental well-being. This practice is based on the possible synergistic effects that can arise from combining different active ingredients focused on improving brain functions and mental health.

  • Nootropics Booster (AC-Semax-NH2) - This combination focuses on enhancing cognitive functions and increasing energy level. Nootropics Booster (AC-Semax-NH2) has a known nootropic effect and can be combined with AC-Selank-NH2 to further enhance cognitive functions and stress management.
  • Nootropic P21 - This combination may be aimed at overall improvement of cognitive functions, combining the anxiolytic properties of AC-Selank-NH2 with the nootropic effects of Peptide P21. This can have a positive impact on memory, attention, and cognitive processes.

Here we have listed only a small part of the peptides that can be combined.

Possible side effects of AC-Selank-NH2:

Mild reactions at the injection site: If AC-Selank-NH2 is administered by injection, it may cause temporary reactions such as redness, pain, or swelling at the injection site.

Changes in sleep: Mild changes in sleep patterns may occur.

Mild fatigue or headache: Some users may experience mild fatigue or headache after taking AC-Selank-NH2.

Stomach discomfort: In rare cases, mild stomach discomfort may appear.

Its use is recommended after a medical consultation.

bodyHtml:
What is AC-262536?

AC-262536 is a selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) that is of scientific interest due to its ability to stimulate muscle growth and maintain physical strength without strongly affecting other androgen-sensitive organs. It is considered one of the mildest compounds in the SARMs group, with a potential anabolic effect combined with low androgenic activity.

The molecule was created to offer an alternative to classic androgen preparations, focusing on maintaining muscle mass, especially in conditions where tissue loss is observed - for example, aging, reduced activity or caloric deficit. AC-262536 has a balanced action and a good profile for research protocols related to physical recovery and body composition.

Mechanism of Action of AC-262536:

AC-262536 works by selectively binding to androgen receptors, resulting in the activation of anabolic processes in muscle tissue without triggering the receptors associated with unwanted effects on the prostate or other non-target areas.

The compound shows about 60% of the anabolic effect of testosterone at a significantly lower androgenic load. This makes it particularly suitable for laboratory studies in which an effect on muscle function is sought without hormonal fluctuations. At the same time, processes such as conversion to estrogens or water retention are not observed, which keeps the body composition cleaner and more stable.

Potential scientifically supported benefits of AC-262536:

AC-262536 has been studied in a number of laboratory settings where the following potential effects have been observed:

  • Stimulation of muscle growth and strength, with limited systemic impact;
  • Preservation of lean muscle mass during deficiency or immobilization;
  • Improvement in muscle endurance and tone at light to moderate loads;
  • Low likelihood of estrogenic reactions, fluid retention, or hormonal side effects;
  • Suitable for more delicate research models where moderate but supportive anabolic action is desired.

Its flexibility makes it particularly suitable for studies aimed at achieving a balance between muscle maintenance and safety.

Comparison of AC-262536 with other SARMs

AC-262536 is a lesser-known SARM, but it occupies a specific niche in research protocols aimed at achieving an anabolic effect with the lowest possible systemic risk. The molecule is structurally designed to provide a moderate effect on muscle and bone tissue, without strong androgenic stimulation. It is often compared to Ostarine (MK2866), ACP-105 and Ligandrol (LGD-4033), especially when looking for more gentle approaches to recovery or maintenance.

Compared to Ostarine, AC-262536 demonstrated a similar safety profile, but generally with a weaker anabolic effect. While Ostarine is well established in research related to preserving muscle mass in a deficit, AC-262536 is often used in restorative models where minimal body loading is sought – including longer term regimens.

Compared to ACP-105, AC-262536 is even milder in action, making it suitable for maintenance cycles, initiation phases, or combination protocols where the goal is to minimize the impact on the hormonal axis. ACP-105, on the other hand, provides more noticeable anabolic stimulation, but at a slightly higher androgenic load.

Compared to Ligandrol, which is many times more powerful, AC-262536 is positioned as a gentle alternative, without significant risks of suppression or hormonal imbalance. Instead of aggressive growth, AC-262536 provides a mild, controlled stimulation, which is especially suitable when combined with other molecules such as Ibutamoren or Ecdysterone.

Dosage and administration of AC-262536 in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 5 units once daily for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 233mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of AC-262536:

Although AC-262536 is considered one of the safer compounds among SARMs, there are observations of some side effects, especially with prolonged use or higher doses:

  • Temporary suppression of testosterone production, depending on the duration of intake;
  • Individual sensitivity to androgen stimulation, especially in more sensitive models;
  • Limited long-term data.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

bodyHtml:
What is 9-Me-BC?

9-Me-BC (9-methyl-β-carboline) is a compound of the beta-carboline group that has been intensively studied in the context of neuroprotection, cognitive function and regulation of dopamine activity. The molecule is structurally close to natural metabolites in the brain and exhibits the potential to affect the dopaminergic system in a selective and modulatory manner, without direct stimulation.

Unlike classic psychostimulants, 9-Me-BC does not deplete dopamine, but supports its restoration and long-term stabilization. This makes it interesting for research protocols targeting cognitive performance, motivation, concentration and maintenance of healthy neural function.

Mechanism of action of 9-Me-BC:

9-Me-BC acts through several parallel mechanisms. The primary effect is modulation of the dopamine system – stimulating the growth and function of dopaminergic neurons without causing dopamine depletion. In addition, the compound exerts a neuroprotective effect by reducing oxidative stress and affecting enzymes involved in cellular repair.

Research suggests that 9-Me-BC can increase the expression of neurotrophin-related genes and improve mitochondrial function in brain tissue. This complex but balanced effect on neurons positions it as a promising molecule in research related to brain function and protection.

Potential science-backed benefits of 9-Me-BC:

Laboratory analyzes indicate a number of potential benefits of 9-Me-BC administration in a controlled research setting:

  • Improving dopamine activity and receptor sensitivity;
  • Increasing concentration, motivation and alertness;
  • Neuroprotective effect - reduction of oxidative stress in the brain;
  • Stimulation of the growth of neuronal branches (dendritogenesis);
  • Possible support for mental fatigue and cognitive decline.

Due to these properties, 9-Me-BC is used in protocols investigating neurological recovery, maintenance of cognitive acuity, and adaptation to mental stress.

Dosage and administration of 9-Me-BC in research protocols:

Recommended study regimen: 5 units once daily (in the morning), for 4–6 weeks, followed by a 2–4 week rest period.

1 unit = 23.33mcg.

Total quantity in pen: 150 units

Possible side effects of 9-Me-BC:

Despite the favorable neurotropic profile of 9-Me-BC, some side effects have been observed, especially at higher doses or sensitivity to dopamine changes:

  • Insomnia or nervousness, especially when taken in the late hours;
  • Headache or tension;
  • Changes in mood, with prolonged use.

Compliance with the optimal dosage and control over the duration of the application play a key role in limiting the manifestation of side effects.

name: 5-Amino-1MQ | 100mg
description: What is 5-Amino-1MQ? 5 Amino 1MQ is a chemical compound that falls within the category of molecules known as inhibitors. This particular molecule has been synthesized to stop or limit the action of the NNMT enzyme (N-methyltransferase), which is involved in a series of biochemica
bodyHtml:
What is 5-Amino-1MQ?

5 Amino 1MQ is a chemical compound that falls within the category of molecules known as inhibitors. This particular molecule has been synthesized to stop or limit the action of the NNMT enzyme (N-methyltransferase), which is involved in a series of biochemical reactions in the body, one of its main functions related to the metabolism of nicotinamide (a form of vitamin B3).
